-- ImageEmit  -  Emit/Animate/Update for ImageLabel emitters.
-- 2D screen-space motion + flipbook (own Heartbeat branch, Type="ImageLabel").
-- Position = (Speed*direction + envVel) * dt; Acceleration + Drag drive envVel.

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local ScreenHost = require(script.Parent.ScreenHost)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

return function(Particle)

-- Dedup keyed on Image asset ID so a noisy emit (rate=100/s) prints once per session.
local _warnedSheets = {}

-- Parent priority: EmitParent > the parent clone's copy of the source Gui (nested-driven) >
-- nearest _PartIcleEmit ancestor (ImageLabel-in-ImageLabel clone walk) > ScreenHost.
local function resolveImageParent(data, source, emitCtx)
	if data.EmitParent then return data.EmitParent end
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if map and source and source.Parent and map[source.Parent] then return map[source.Parent] end
	if source then
		local cur = source.Parent
		while cur and cur ~= game do
			if cur:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then return source.Parent end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
	end
	return ScreenHost.get()
end

-- Sorted Decal children of ImageFlipbooks (numeric name).
local function gatherFlipbookDecals(folder)
	if not folder then return nil end
	local list = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") then table.insert(list, child) end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		local an, bn = tonumber(a.Name), tonumber(b.Name)
		if an and bn then return an < bn end
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)
	return #list > 0 and list or nil
end

-- Fire-and-forget PreloadAsync; ContentProvider de-dupes.
local function preloadEmitAssets(data, decals)
	local assetList = {}
	if decals then for _, d in ipairs(decals) do table.insert(assetList, d) end end
	if data.Image and data.Image ~= "" then table.insert(assetList, data.Image) end
	if #assetList == 0 then return end
	task.spawn(function() pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, assetList) end)
end

-- Yielding PreloadAsync on first emit per RT. Memoized on Particle._preloadedAssets
-- so subsequent emits of the same source skip the yield.
local function preloadAndWait(particle, rt, data, decals)
	if not particle or not rt then return end
	local cache = particle._preloadedAssets
	if not cache then return end
	if cache[rt] then return end
	local assetList = {}
	if decals then for _, d in ipairs(decals) do table.insert(assetList, d) end end
	if data.Image and data.Image ~= "" then table.insert(assetList, data.Image) end
	cache[rt] = true  -- mark before yield so concurrent emits don't double-wait
	if #assetList == 0 then return end
	pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, assetList)
end

-- Frame index per FlipbookMode. OneShot/PingPong scale across Lifetime; Loop uses framerate;
-- Random picks one per interval (per-pData state). StartRandom only affects Loop.
local function resolveFrame(pData, n, elapsed)
	if n <= 0 then return 0 end
	local mode = pData.FlipbookMode
	local frame
	if mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot then
		local t = pData.LifeTime > 0 and math.min(1, elapsed / pData.LifeTime) or 1
		frame = math.min(math.floor(t * n), n - 1)
	elseif mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.PingPong then
		local t = pData.LifeTime > 0 and math.min(1, elapsed / pData.LifeTime) or 1
		local cyc = t * 2
		if cyc <= 1 then frame = math.floor(cyc * n) else frame = math.floor((2 - cyc) * n) end
		frame = math.max(0, math.min(frame, n - 1))
	elseif mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Random then
		local fr = pData.FlipbookFramerate or 24
		local interval = (fr > 0) and (1 / fr) or 1
		local intervalIdx = math.floor(elapsed / interval)
		if pData._lastRandomInterval ~= intervalIdx then
			pData._lastRandomInterval = intervalIdx
			pData._currentRandomFrame = math.random(0, n - 1)
		end
		frame = pData._currentRandomFrame or math.random(0, n - 1)
	else -- Loop (default)
		local raw = elapsed * pData.FlipbookFramerate + (pData.FlipbookStartOffset or 0) * n
		frame = math.floor(raw) % n
	end
	if pData.FlipbookReverse then frame = n - 1 - frame end
	return frame
end

-- Decals: swap .Image; Spritesheet: shift ImageRectOffset across a grid.
-- lastFrame dedup: skip the property write when frame index hasn't changed.
local function applyFlipbookFrame(pData, elapsed)
	if not pData.FlipbookFramerate or pData.FlipbookFramerate <= 0 then return end
	if pData.FlipbookSource == "Decals" and pData.FlipbookDecals then
		local n = #pData.FlipbookDecals
		if n == 0 then return end
		local frame = resolveFrame(pData, n, elapsed)
		if frame == pData._lastFlipbookFrame then return end
		pData._lastFlipbookFrame = frame
		local dec = pData.FlipbookDecals[frame + 1]
		if dec and dec.Texture then pData.VisualPart.Image = dec.Texture end
	elseif pData.FlipbookSource == "Spritesheet" then
		local cols = math.max(1, pData.GridCols or 1)
		local rows = math.max(1, pData.GridRows or 1)
		local total = cols * rows
		local frame = resolveFrame(pData, total, elapsed)
		local sheet = pData.SheetSize
		if not sheet then return end
		if frame == pData._lastFlipbookFrame then return end
		pData._lastFlipbookFrame = frame
		local fw, fh = sheet.X / cols, sheet.Y / rows
		pData.VisualPart.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(fw, fh)
		pData.VisualPart.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((frame % cols) * fw, math.floor(frame / cols) * fh)
	end
end

-- Forward-integrate 2D motion over Lifetime and return final (endX, endY, endVelX,
-- endVelY). Mirrors UpdateImageLabel's per-frame math (Speed graph × 100 + Accel
-- × 100 + Drag decay), at coarse 60-step granularity. Used to seed InvertMotion's
-- spawn pose: position = end-pos, EnvVel = end-vel. Negative-dt integration then
-- retraces the forward trajectory exactly (accel-driven motion only reverses
-- correctly when starting EnvVel is the forward end-state, not zero).
local function _simulateForward2D(data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
	local steps = 60
	local stepDt = lifetime / steps
	local accelX = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).X
	local accelY = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).Y
	local drag = data.ImgDrag or 0
	local posX, posY = 0, 0
	local envX, envY = 0, 0
	for s = 1, steps do
		local t = s / steps
		local speed = 0
		if data.ImgSpeed then
			speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, data.ImgSpeed, seeds.ImgSpeed) * 100
		end
		envX += accelX * 100 * stepDt
		envY += accelY * 100 * stepDt
		if drag > 0 then
			local decay = math.max(0, 1 - drag * stepDt)
			envX *= decay; envY *= decay
		end
		posX += (speed * dirX + envX) * stepDt
		posY += (speed * dirY + envY) * stepDt
	end
	return posX, posY, envX, envY
end

-- Expose so Engine.luau's AnimateLoop replay can re-seed end-state per cycle.
Particle._computeImageLabelEndState = function(_self, data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
	return _simulateForward2D(data, dirX, dirY, lifetime, seeds)
end

-- Build pData from data; shared by Emit + Animate.
local function buildImageLabelPData(data, visual, item, isAnimate)
	-- One walk + sort of ImageFlipbooks per emit; reused by frame-0 setup + pData stamp.
	local flipbookDecals = gatherFlipbookDecals(data.ImageFlipbooks)
	-- EmissionAngle: 0=right, 90=up, 180=left, 270=down. GUI Y is inverted.
	local ea = data.ImgEmissionAngle or 90
	local sp = data.ImgSpreadAngle or 0
	local angle = ea + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * sp
	local rad = math.rad(angle)
	local dx, dy = math.cos(rad), -math.sin(rad)
	-- InvertMotion: spawn at trajectory's END position + flip dt sign per frame so
	-- motion retraces backward to the original start. Don't flip dx/dy  -  velocity
	-- direction stays forward; the dt sign is what reverses traversal.

	local safeLife = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLife <= 0 then safeLife = 0.001 end

	local seeds = {
		ImageTransparency      = data.ImageTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImageTransparency) or {},
		BackgroundTransparency = data.BackgroundTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.BackgroundTransparency) or {},
		ImgSpeed               = data.ImgSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgSpeed) or {},
		ImgRotSpeed            = data.ImgRotSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgRotSpeed) or {},
		SizeScaleX             = data.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeScaleX) or {},
		SizeScaleY             = data.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeScaleY) or {},
		Timescale              = data.ImgTimescale and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ImgTimescale) or {},
	}

	local initialRot = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ImgRotRange or NumberRange.new(0))
	local baseSize = data.ImgSizeUDim or UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)

	-- Frame 0 sample to avoid pop.
	if data.ImageTransparency then visual.ImageTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.ImageTransparency, seeds.ImageTransparency) end
	if data.BackgroundTransparency then visual.BackgroundTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.BackgroundTransparency, seeds.BackgroundTransparency) end
	if data.ImageColor3 then visual.ImageColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.ImageColor3) end
	if data.BackgroundColor3 then visual.BackgroundColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.BackgroundColor3) end
	visual.Image = data.Image or ""
	visual.ScaleType = data.ImgScaleType or Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
	visual.ResampleMode = data.ImgResampleMode or Enum.ResamplerMode.Default
	visual.AnchorPoint = data.ImgAnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	visual.ZIndex = data.ImgZIndex or 1
	visual.Rotation = initialRot
	local sx0 = data.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SizeScaleX, seeds.SizeScaleX) or 1
	local sy0 = data.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SizeScaleY, seeds.SizeScaleY) or 1
	visual.Size = UDim2.new(baseSize.X.Scale * sx0, baseSize.X.Offset * sx0, baseSize.Y.Scale * sy0, baseSize.Y.Offset * sy0)
	visual.Position = data.ImgPosition or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

	local framerate = 10
	if data.ImgFlipbookFramerate then framerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ImgFlipbookFramerate) end

	-- StartRandom is Loop-only (resolveFrame ignores FlipbookStartOffset for
	-- OneShot / PingPong / Random). One shared start frame for visual setup +
	-- Loop runtime offset so the first Heartbeat doesn't snap to a different frame.
	local mode = data.ImgFlipbookMode or Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop
	local applyStartRandom = data.ImgFlipbookStartRandom and mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop
	local startFrame = 0
	local startFrameOffset = 0

	-- Sheet size missing → whole-sheet render. Decals mode ignores SheetSize.
	local sheetSize = data.SheetSize

	-- Frame-0 flipbook setup so first tick isn't stuck on base Image.
	local source = data.ImgFlipbookSource or "Decals"
	-- Spritesheet mode silently no-ops both crop paths when SheetSize is nil (HTTP fetchAndStamp
	-- pending, denied, or worker 404). Warn once per asset so user gets an actionable diagnostic
	-- instead of staring at a full-sheet emit.
	if source == "Spritesheet" and not sheetSize and data.Image and data.Image ~= "" and not _warnedSheets[data.Image] then
		_warnedSheets[data.Image] = true
		Log.warn(string.format("Part-Icles: Spritesheet flipbook  -  sheet dimensions unknown for %s. Emit will render full sheet until dimensions resolve.", data.Image))
	end
	if source == "Decals" then
		-- Reset lingering Spritesheet crop.
		visual.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(0, 0); visual.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		if flipbookDecals and #flipbookDecals > 0 then
			local n = #flipbookDecals
			if applyStartRandom then
				startFrame = math.random(0, n - 1)
				startFrameOffset = startFrame / n
			end
			local dec = flipbookDecals[startFrame + 1]
			if dec and dec.Texture and dec.Texture ~= "" then visual.Image = dec.Texture end
		end
	elseif source == "Spritesheet" and sheetSize then
		local cols = math.max(1, data.ImgGridCols or 1)
		local rows = math.max(1, data.ImgGridRows or 1)
		local total = cols * rows
		if applyStartRandom and total > 0 then
			startFrame = math.random(0, total - 1)
			startFrameOffset = startFrame / total
		end
		local fw, fh = sheetSize.X / cols, sheetSize.Y / rows
		visual.ImageRectSize = Vector2.new(fw, fh)
		visual.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.new((startFrame % cols) * fw, math.floor(startFrame / cols) * fh)
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "ImageLabel",
		VisualPart = visual,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		LifeTime = safeLife,
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames or 100),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		BasePosition = data.ImgPosition or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		BaseSize = baseSize,
		DirX = dx, DirY = dy,
		EnvVelX = 0, EnvVelY = 0,
		PosX = 0,  PosY = 0,
		AccelX = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).X,
		AccelY = (data.ImgAcceleration or Vector2.new()).Y,
		Drag = data.ImgDrag or 0,

		InitialRotation = initialRot,
		RotMode = data.ImgRotMode or "OverLife",
		AccRot = 0,
		InvertMotion = data.ImgInvertMotion or false,

		Graphs = {
			ImageTransparency      = data.ImageTransparency,
			BackgroundTransparency = data.BackgroundTransparency,
			ImgSpeed               = data.ImgSpeed,
			ImgRotSpeed            = data.ImgRotSpeed,
			SizeScaleX             = data.SizeScaleX,
			SizeScaleY             = data.SizeScaleY,
			ImageColor3            = data.ImageColor3,
			BackgroundColor3       = data.BackgroundColor3,
			Timescale              = data.ImgTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.ImgTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLife),

		FlipbookSource   = data.ImgFlipbookSource or "Decals",
		FlipbookMode     = data.ImgFlipbookMode or Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop,
		FlipbookFramerate = framerate,
		FlipbookStartOffset = startFrameOffset,
		FlipbookReverse  = data.ImgFlipbookReverse or false,
		FlipbookDecals   = flipbookDecals,
		SheetSize = sheetSize,
		GridCols = data.ImgGridCols or 8,
		GridRows = data.ImgGridRows or 1,

		IsAnimate = isAnimate or nil,
		AnimateItem = isAnimate and item or nil,
	}

	-- InvertMotion: seed PosX/PosY + EnvVelX/Y to the forward trajectory's end-state
	-- and run elapsed counter from lifeTime back to 0 via per-frame _invertDtSign.
	-- EnvVel seed is required for accel-driven motion to reverse correctly  -  with
	-- EnvVel=0 the negative-dt integration accumulates accel in the wrong direction
	-- and doesn't retrace the forward path.
	if data.ImgInvertMotion then
		local endX, endY, endVelX, endVelY = _simulateForward2D(data, dx, dy, safeLife, seeds)
		pData.PosX, pData.PosY = endX, endY
		pData.EnvVelX, pData.EnvVelY = endVelX, endVelY
		pData._effectiveElapsed = safeLife
		pData._invertDtSign = -1
	end

	-- Static-graph short-circuit via shared StaticPass module. Constant-valued
	-- NumberSequence graphs nil out of pData.Graphs + stamp pData._static<Name>.
	-- Frame-0 setup already wrote the visual for ImageTransparency / BackgroundTransparency,
	-- so the nil'd-graph short-circuits the per-step write. Speed / RotSpeed / SizeScale
	-- store the constant on pData._static<Name>; UpdateImageLabel reads it instead of
	-- sampling. ColorSequence graphs not covered (ColorSequence has no IsStatic helper;
	-- color writes are already step-quantized).
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	-- SizeScale both-axes-static collapse: when X and Y both constant, nil their static
	-- fields too so the per-frame Size block short-circuits entirely (frame-0 captured
	-- the visual Size). Mixed (one static, one dynamic) keeps the static field so the
	-- block samples only the dynamic axis.
	if pData._staticSizeScaleX and pData._staticSizeScaleY then
		pData._staticSizeScaleX = nil
		pData._staticSizeScaleY = nil
	end

	return pData
end

function Particle:EmitImageLabel(item, link, emitCtx)
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- First-emit-per-RT preload yield; subsequent emits short-circuit on the memo.
	preloadAndWait(self, data.RenderTemplate, data, nil)

	-- Pool reuse: fresh clones strip ImageFlipbooks (textures come from pData.FlipbookDecals);
	-- pooled clones already have it stripped from prior acquire.
	local visual = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "ImageLabel", data.Pool)
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Visible = true
	local cloneFF = visual:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks")
	if cloneFF then cloneFF:Destroy() end

	local pData = buildImageLabelPData(data, visual, item, false)
	pData.Link = link
	pData._sourceItem = item
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	pData.Events = data.Events
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "ImageLabel" end
	preloadEmitAssets(data, pData.FlipbookDecals)
	visual.Parent = resolveImageParent(data, item, emitCtx)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Nested ImageLabels parent next to source via _PartIcleEmit ancestry; UDim2 Scale stays relative.
	for _, desc in visual:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") and desc:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			self:EnableEmit(desc, nil, emitCtx)
		end
	end
end

-- Singleton clone-animate; refuses duplicate emits while active.
function Particle:EmitImageLabelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- First-emit-per-RT preload yield (see EmitImageLabel).
	preloadAndWait(self, data.RenderTemplate, data, nil)

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate:Clone()
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Visible = true
	visual:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	local cloneFF = visual:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks"); if cloneFF then cloneFF:Destroy() end

	local pData = buildImageLabelPData(data, visual, item, true)
	pData.Link = link
	pData._sourceItem = item
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	pData.Events = data.Events
	preloadEmitAssets(data, pData.FlipbookDecals)
	visual.Parent = resolveImageParent(data, item, emitCtx)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	for _, desc in visual:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") and desc:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			self:EnableEmit(desc, nil, emitCtx)
		end
	end
end

-- Per-frame update; returns true when lifetime ends.
function Particle:UpdateImageLabel(pData, dt, currentTime)
	local visual = pData.VisualPart
	if not visual or not visual.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end

	-- Timescale v2 (signed reverse): see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	-- InvertMotion: flip dt sign so elapsed counter walks back from lifeTime → 0
	-- (seeded at lifeTime in buildImageLabelPData). PosX/PosY were seeded to the
	-- trajectory's END so the negative-dt integration retraces backward.
	if pData._invertDtSign then dt = dt * pData._invertDtSign end
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsed = newEff
	local i = elapsed / lifeTime
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	if i > 1 then i = 1 end
	if i < 0 then i = 0 end

	-- All motion + rotation + size + color/transparency writes gate on step advance
	-- (TotalKeyFrames quantization), matching Part / Beam / Highlight / etc. Sub-step
	-- frames accumulate dt into pData.AccumulatedDT; on step transition the accumulated
	-- delta drives one integration pass + one visual write batch. Flipbook stays per-frame
	-- because its cadence is FlipbookFramerate, independent of TKF.
	local graphs = pData.Graphs
	local seeds = pData.Seeds
	pData.AccumulatedDT = (pData.AccumulatedDT or 0) + dt

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local t = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames

		-- Speed sampled at step boundary. Drag decay still references continuous elapsed
		-- (math.exp closed form, identical to per-frame variant; not dt-dependent).
		local speed = 0
		if pData._staticImgSpeed then
			speed = pData._staticImgSpeed * 100
		elseif graphs.ImgSpeed then
			speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.ImgSpeed, seeds.ImgSpeed) * 100
		end
		if speed ~= 0 and pData.Drag > 0 then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsed) end

		-- EnvVel integrates Acceleration over the cross-frame batch (frameDT). Drag decay
		-- linear-approx — frameDT bounded by step-interval (1/(TKF/LifeTime)) so for typical
		-- TKF=100 still small.
		pData.EnvVelX += pData.AccelX * 100 * frameDT
		pData.EnvVelY += pData.AccelY * 100 * frameDT
		if pData.Drag > 0 then
			local decay = math.max(0, 1 - pData.Drag * frameDT)
			pData.EnvVelX *= decay; pData.EnvVelY *= decay
		end

		local vx = speed * pData.DirX + pData.EnvVelX
		local vy = speed * pData.DirY + pData.EnvVelY
		pData.PosX += vx * frameDT
		pData.PosY += vy * frameDT
		local bp = pData.BasePosition
		visual.Position = UDim2.new(bp.X.Scale, bp.X.Offset + pData.PosX, bp.Y.Scale, bp.Y.Offset + pData.PosY)

		-- Rotation. OverLife = absolute angle; Speed = deg/sec accumulator. Both add InitialRotation.
		local rs
		if pData._staticImgRotSpeed then
			rs = pData._staticImgRotSpeed
		elseif graphs.ImgRotSpeed then
			rs = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.ImgRotSpeed, seeds.ImgRotSpeed)
		end
		if rs then
			local newRot
			if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
				pData.AccRot += rs * frameDT
				newRot = pData.InitialRotation + pData.AccRot
			else
				newRot = pData.InitialRotation + rs
			end
			if newRot ~= pData._lastRotation then
				visual.Rotation = newRot
				pData._lastRotation = newRot
			end
		end

		-- Size scale.
		local hasSizeX = pData._staticSizeScaleX or graphs.SizeScaleX
		local hasSizeY = pData._staticSizeScaleY or graphs.SizeScaleY
		if (hasSizeX or hasSizeY) and not pData.SkipSize then
			local sx = pData._staticSizeScaleX
				or (graphs.SizeScaleX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.SizeScaleX, seeds.SizeScaleX))
				or 1
			local sy = pData._staticSizeScaleY
				or (graphs.SizeScaleY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.SizeScaleY, seeds.SizeScaleY))
				or 1
			if sx ~= pData._lastSizeX or sy ~= pData._lastSizeY then
				local bs = pData.BaseSize
				visual.Size = UDim2.new(bs.X.Scale * sx, bs.X.Offset * sx, bs.Y.Scale * sy, bs.Y.Offset * sy)
				pData._lastSizeX, pData._lastSizeY = sx, sy
			end
		end

		-- Color / transparency. Gate on SkipColor / SkipTransparency for runtime overrides
		-- via payload.SetSkipColor / SetSkipTransparency.
		if graphs.ImageTransparency and not pData.SkipTransparency then visual.ImageTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.ImageTransparency, seeds.ImageTransparency) end
		if graphs.BackgroundTransparency and not pData.SkipTransparency then visual.BackgroundTransparency = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BackgroundTransparency, seeds.BackgroundTransparency) end
		if graphs.ImageColor3 and not pData.SkipColor then visual.ImageColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.ImageColor3) end
		if graphs.BackgroundColor3 and not pData.SkipColor then visual.BackgroundColor3 = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.BackgroundColor3) end
	end

	-- Flipbook independent of TKF (uses FlipbookFramerate); runs per-frame with internal lastFrame dedup.
	applyFlipbookFrame(pData, elapsed)

	return isDying
end

-- AnimateLoop refresh: non-spatial fields only (spatial accumulators reset by replay).
function Particle:_refreshImageLabelAnimateNonSpatial(pData, freshData)
	if not freshData then return end
	local ea = freshData.ImgEmissionAngle or 90
	local sp = freshData.ImgSpreadAngle or 0
	local angle = ea + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * sp
	local rad = math.rad(angle)
	local dx, dy = math.cos(rad), -math.sin(rad)
	-- InvertMotion no longer flips dx/dy here. Engine's AnimateLoop branch handles
	-- inversion by seeding PosX/PosY to the trajectory's end + per-frame negative dt.
	pData.DirX = dx; pData.DirY = dy
	if freshData.ImgAcceleration then
		pData.AccelX = freshData.ImgAcceleration.X
		pData.AccelY = freshData.ImgAcceleration.Y
	end
	if freshData.ImgDrag ~= nil then pData.Drag = freshData.ImgDrag end
	if freshData.ImgPosition then pData.BasePosition = freshData.ImgPosition end
	if freshData.ImgSizeUDim then pData.BaseSize = freshData.ImgSizeUDim end
	if freshData.ImgRotMode then pData.RotMode = freshData.ImgRotMode end
	if freshData.ImgRotRange then pData.InitialRotation = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ImgRotRange) end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookSource then pData.FlipbookSource = freshData.ImgFlipbookSource end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookMode then pData.FlipbookMode = freshData.ImgFlipbookMode end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookFramerate then pData.FlipbookFramerate = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ImgFlipbookFramerate) end
	if freshData.ImgFlipbookReverse ~= nil then pData.FlipbookReverse = freshData.ImgFlipbookReverse end
	if freshData.ImgGridCols then pData.GridCols = freshData.ImgGridCols end
	if freshData.ImgGridRows then pData.GridRows = freshData.ImgGridRows end
	if freshData.SheetSize ~= nil then pData.SheetSize = freshData.SheetSize end
	if freshData.ImageFlipbooks then pData.FlipbookDecals = gatherFlipbookDecals(freshData.ImageFlipbooks) end
	if freshData.ImgTimescale and pData.Graphs then pData.Graphs.Timescale = freshData.ImgTimescale; pData.Seeds.Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(freshData.ImgTimescale) end
end

end

--[[
	Lifecycle Mixin  -  cancelAnimation, Particle:Disable, EmitAnimate, EnableEmit.
	`_emitGen` attribute: each EnableEmit bumps + captures locally; delayed closures
	bail when live attribute has moved on. Disable also bumps to cancel pending closures.
]]

local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local IS_STUDIO = RunService:IsStudio()
-- Probe Plugin capability via Selection:Get; gates IsEdit + Selection sites below.
local IS_PLUGIN = pcall(function() return Selection:Get() end)
-- loopBody emit yield: PreRender on client so the resumed emit lands after Roblox's
-- attachment-transform propagation completes for the frame; Trail's first sample then
-- reads the clean spawn pose. Server falls back to Heartbeat (PreRender client-only).
local LOOP_YIELD_EVENT = RunService:IsClient() and RunService.PreRender or RunService.Heartbeat
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local Events = require(script.Parent.Events)
local EvenCycle = require(script.Parent.EvenCycle)
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.MeshFrames)

return function(Particle)
	-- Cancel an in-flight Animate cycle: restore position, clean up, remove from ActiveEmits.
	-- Beam restores via snapshot + Enabled=false (no InitialAnchorCF on Beam pData).
	local function cancelAnimation(self, item)
		local existing = self.ActiveAnimates[item]
		if not existing then return end
		-- Snapshot-restore runs BEFORE the CFrame write below: with the inverse order,
		-- one Heartbeat frame could render the visual at initial-pose still carrying the
		-- final-cycle Width/Color/Transparency = visible 1-frame pop on cancel.
		if (existing.Type == "Beam" or existing.Type == "Highlight" or existing.Type == "TrailEmitter")
			and existing.VisualPart and existing.VisualPart.Parent then
			local snap = existing.BeamSnapshot or existing.HighlightSnapshot or existing.TrailEmitterSnapshot
			if snap then
				pcall(function()
					for name, value in pairs(snap) do existing.VisualPart[name] = value end
				end)
			end
			existing.VisualPart.Enabled = false
		end
		if existing.InitialAnchorCF and existing.VisualPart and existing.VisualPart.Parent then
			if existing.Type == "Model" then
				existing.VisualPart:PivotTo(existing.InitialAnchorCF)
				if existing.InitialScale then
					pcall(function() existing.VisualPart:ScaleTo(existing.InitialScale) end)
				end
			elseif existing.Type ~= "Beam" then
				existing.VisualPart.CFrame = existing.InitialAnchorCF
			end
		end
		-- Part/Attachment hide via Transparency=1 (mirrors finishAnimate in init.luau).
		if (existing.Type == "Part" or existing.Type == "Attachment") and existing.VisualPart and existing.VisualPart.Parent then
			DecalLayersMod.restore(existing)
			MeshFramesMod.restore(existing)
			pcall(function()
				existing.VisualPart.Transparency = 1
				if existing.HasDecal then
					local d = existing.VisualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("Decal")
					if d then d.Transparency = 1 end
				end
			end)
		end
		if (existing.Type == "Screen" or existing.Type == "ImageLabel" or existing.Type == "Lightning" or existing.Type == "Rocks" or existing.Type == "Rope") and existing.VisualPart then
			-- Lightning / Rocks / Rope are clone-animate: source RT never mutated, nothing to restore.
			pcall(function() existing.VisualPart:Destroy() end)
			if existing._impactDisk then pcall(function() existing._impactDisk:Destroy() end) end
		end
		-- Native PE/Trail children clean themselves up via gen-token; no manual disable here.
		self:_reclaimPData(existing)
		for idx = #self.ActiveEmits, 1, -1 do
			if self.ActiveEmits[idx] == existing then
				local n = #self.ActiveEmits
				if idx < n then self.ActiveEmits[idx] = self.ActiveEmits[n] end
				self.ActiveEmits[n] = nil
				break
			end
		end
		self.ActiveAnimates[item] = nil
	end

	-- Public wrapper for Particle:Deactivate.
	function Particle:_cancelAnimation(item)
		cancelAnimation(self, item)
	end

	-- Stop new emission on `item`. hard=true restores Animate sources now (cancelAnimation)
	-- and hard-cancels raw descendants; hard=false soft-stops them (Enabled=false) so live
	-- particles finish their Lifetime. Order matters: cancelAnimation before cfg.Enabled.
	local function haltEmission(self, item, hard)
		if Particle.ActiveLoops[item] then
			task.cancel(Particle.ActiveLoops[item])
			Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil
		end
		local chainBucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
		if chainBucket then
			for _, t in ipairs(chainBucket) do pcall(task.cancel, t) end
			Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = nil
		end
		EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", false)
		local gen = (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) + 1
		EngineAttr.write(item, "_emitGen", gen)
		if hard then cancelAnimation(self, item) end
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		if config then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", false) end
		EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", nil)
		-- Reset this emitter's rolling cycle so the next emission restarts at idx 1.
		-- Transformed descendants clear their own keys via the recursion below.
		EvenCycle.clear(self._evenCycleStore, item:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") or item)
		for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				if hard then self:Disable(desc) else self:SoftDisable(desc) end
			elseif TypeRegistry.isInsideRenderTemplate(desc, item) then
				-- RenderTemplate natives are template state copied verbatim into clones; Transform owns them.
			elseif desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") then
				if hard then ParticlesMod.CancelNative(desc) else pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end) end
			elseif desc:IsA("Beam") or desc:IsA("Highlight") then
				pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Hard stop: halt emission AND reclaim every live clone now (sweep ActiveEmits + finish
	-- linger). Waypoint pair (Studio edit only; standalone-runtime skips it) makes the whole
	-- disable one undo step.
	function Particle:Disable(item)
		if not item then return end
		-- Inside the Heartbeat loop (event Modules run there): queue so the ActiveEmits sweep cannot
		-- pull entries out from under the step. Engine drains _afterStep after the loop.
		if self._inStep then
			self._afterStep = self._afterStep or {}
			table.insert(self._afterStep, function() self:Disable(item) end)
			return
		end
		local CHS = IS_PLUGIN and game:GetService("RunService"):IsEdit() and game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService") or nil
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Disable") end
		haltEmission(self, item, true)
		-- Reclaim live one-shots (backward walk = swap-and-pop safe); _releaseOrDestroy pools
		-- eligible visuals instead of cold-destroying them.
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for idx = #active, 1, -1 do
			local pData = active[idx]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				if pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
					self:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, pData.VisualPart)
				end
				self:_reclaimPData(pData)
				-- _releaseOrDestroy may already have popped a live-RT Animate entry via cancelAnimation.
				if active[idx] == pData then
					local n = #active
					if idx < n then active[idx] = active[n] end
					active[n] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		-- Finish PartLife linger clones early; _lingerCounted guards a double-decrement.
		if self._lingerByItem and self._lingerByItem[item] then
			for _, visualPart in ipairs(self._lingerByItem[item]) do
				if visualPart then
					local counted = false
					pcall(function() counted = visualPart:GetAttribute("_lingerCounted") == true end)
					if counted then
						self._lingerVisualCount = math.max(0, (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) - 1)
						EngineAttr.write(visualPart, "_lingerCounted", nil)
					end
					if visualPart.Parent then
						pcall(function() visualPart:Destroy() end)
					end
				end
			end
			self._lingerByItem[item] = nil
		end
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Disable") end
	end

	-- Skip descendants under a nested Transformed item (recursion reaches them separately).
	local function _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, root)
		local p = desc.Parent
		while p and p ~= root do
			if p:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
			p = p.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Recursive enable. Walks `item` + descendants:
	--   - Transformed item → cfg.Enabled=true + :Enable(math.huge). Sets _PartIclePlaying
	--     first so the EnabledLoop listener bails (prevents double-Enable / 1-frame pop).
	--   - Raw PE / Trail / Beam → .Enabled=true.
	--   - Container → walks descendants once, recurses children with `_parentCovered` so raw
	--     descendants don't double-toggle.
	function Particle:AbsoluteEnable(item, _parentCovered)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			-- Set _PartIclePlaying BEFORE flipping cfg.Enabled so EnabledLoop.handleToggle
			-- bails on the attribute change (it gates on _PartIclePlaying). Otherwise the
			-- direct Enable below and the listener's handleToggle both spawn loopBody,
			-- causing a cancel+restart pop on every AbsoluteEnable call (visible 1-frame
			-- artifact on Animate mode, off-by-one emit shift on Emit mode). Particle:Disable
			-- clears the attribute on the matching AbsoluteDisable.
			EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", true)
			local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
			if config then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", true) end
			-- Direct Enable call covers standalone-runtime (no listener to react to attribute).
			self:Enable(item, nil, math.huge)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam") then
			if _parentCovered then return end
			pcall(function() item.Enabled = true end)
			return
		end
		local shouldCover = (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not _parentCovered
		if shouldCover then
			for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
				if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam"))
					and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
					and not _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, item) then
					pcall(function() desc.Enabled = true end)
				end
			end
		end
		local covered = shouldCover or _parentCovered
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteEnable(child, covered)
		end
	end

	-- Soft stop: halt new emission but leave live clones for the Heartbeat to age out (no
	-- ActiveEmits sweep, no linger destroy, no cancelAnimation) so on-screen clones finish
	-- their Lifetime instead of vanishing this frame.
	function Particle:SoftDisable(item)
		if not item then return end
		local CHS = IS_PLUGIN and game:GetService("RunService"):IsEdit() and game:GetService("ChangeHistoryService") or nil
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Soft Disable") end
		haltEmission(self, item, false)
		if CHS then CHS:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Soft Disable") end
	end

	-- Recursive disable. Walks `item` + descendants, soft-stopping each:
	--   - Transformed item → :SoftDisable (stop new emission, live particles finish Lifetime).
	--   - Raw PE / Trail / Beam → .Enabled=false (native soft stop).
	--   - Container → walks descendants once, recurses children with `_parentCovered` flag.
	-- For an instant scene-clear that reclaims live clones, call :Disable per item instead.
	function Particle:AbsoluteDisable(item, _parentCovered)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:SoftDisable(item)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or item:IsA("Trail") or item:IsA("Beam") then
			if _parentCovered then return end
			pcall(function() item.Enabled = false end)
			return
		end
		local shouldCover = (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not _parentCovered
		if shouldCover then
			for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
				if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam"))
					and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
					and not _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, item) then
					pcall(function() desc.Enabled = false end)
				end
			end
		end
		local covered = shouldCover or _parentCovered
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteDisable(child, covered)
		end
	end

	-- Start one Animate cycle. 3D = animate source in-place; Screen/ImageLabel = singleton clone.
	function Particle:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("EmitAnimate")
		local isCloneAnimate = item:IsA("BlurEffect")
			or item:IsA("BloomEffect")
			or item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			or item:IsA("Atmosphere")
			or item:IsA("ImageLabel")
			or Particle._isLightning(item)
			or Particle._isCameraShake(item)
			or Particle._isRocks(item)
			or Particle._isRope(item)
			or Particle._isDistortion(item)
		if isCloneAnimate and self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
		cancelAnimation(self, item)
		-- Cap check here, not in _registerEmit: Animate paths mutate the live RT before registering,
		-- so a reject there could not restore it.
		local cap = self.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000
		if #self.ActiveEmits + (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= cap then
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - (self._capWarnLastAt or 0) >= 1 then
				self._capWarnLastAt = now
				Log.warn(("[Part-Icles] active particle cap (%d) reached  -  new emits skipped (user Module code still runs)."):format(cap))
			end
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("Beam") then self:EmitBeamAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Trail") and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") then self:EmitTrailAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Highlight") then self:EmitHighlightAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then self:EmitAttachmentAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then self:EmitModelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BlurEffect") then self:EmitBlurAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BloomEffect") then self:EmitBloomAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then self:EmitColorCorrectionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("Atmosphere") then self:EmitAtmosphereAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") then self:EmitImageLabelAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isLightning(item) then self:EmitLightningAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isCameraShake(item) then self:EmitCameraShakeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isRocks(item) then self:EmitRocksAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isRope(item) then self:EmitRopeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif Particle._isDistortion(item) then self:EmitDistortionAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
		elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then self:EmitPartAnimate(item, link, emitCtx) end
	end

	-- Emit honoring EmitCount + EmitDelay + EmitDuration. Animate mode: EmitDuration bounds AnimateLoop.
	function Particle:EnableEmit(item, link, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("EnableEmit")
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute('EmissionMode') or "Emit"
		-- Zero-as-zero: missing EmitCount → default 1; explicit 0 → no emission.
		local rawEmitCount = item:GetAttribute('EmitCount')
		local emitCount = rawEmitCount == nil and 1 or rawEmitCount
		-- An event firing its EmitTarget is an explicit demand: a target left at 0 still
		-- emits one burst. Authored counts >= 1 win unchanged.
		if emitCount <= 0 and emitCtx and emitCtx.EventDriven then emitCount = 1 end
		local emitDelay = item:GetAttribute('EmitDelay') or 0
		-- EmitDuration: number or "min,max" range string.
		local emitDuration = ParticlesMod.parseDuration(item:GetAttribute('EmitDuration')) or 0
		-- Per-play overrides (EmitAt options Count / Delay / Duration) replace the authored
		-- attributes for this call only; nothing is written to the source.
		local overrides = emitCtx and emitCtx.Overrides
		if overrides then
			if overrides.Count ~= nil then emitCount = overrides.Count end
			if overrides.Delay ~= nil then emitDelay = overrides.Delay end
			if overrides.Duration ~= nil then emitDuration = ParticlesMod.parseDuration(overrides.Duration) or 0 end
		end
		-- Animate items with default 0/0 still reach EmitAnimate (AnimateLoop drives them).
		if emissionMode ~= "Animate" and emitCount <= 0 and emitDuration <= 0 then return end

		-- Skip _emitGen serialization for: chain-driven (N parallel chains), nested-driven
		-- (one chain per parent particle  -  multiple parents must coexist), and instant
		-- bursts. Nested-driven detected via emitCtx._parentAlive set by NestedEmit.walk.
		local isChainDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx ~= nil
		local isNestedDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil
		-- Play-driven (EmitAt) Emit plays coexist on one source, each stopped by its own token.
		-- Animate keeps one cycle per source, so it stays serialized.
		local isPlayDriven = emitCtx ~= nil and emitCtx._playToken ~= nil and emissionMode ~= "Animate"
		local skipGenSerialization = isChainDriven or isNestedDriven or isPlayDriven or emitDuration <= 0
		-- Top-level emit: backfill _EvenCycleId on this authored emitter + its nested
		-- emitters so clones inherit a shared rolling-cycle key (no-op once stamped).
		if not (isChainDriven or isNestedDriven) then EvenCycle.ensureIds(item) end
		local startGen
		if not skipGenSerialization then
			startGen = (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) + 1
			EngineAttr.write(item, "_emitGen", startGen)
		end
		-- Engine-session gen invalidates closures past Activate/Deactivate.
		local engineGen = self._engineGen or 0
		local function genStillCurrent()
			if self.Connection == nil then return false end
			if (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGen then return false end
			if not item.Parent then return false end
			if not skipGenSerialization and (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) ~= startGen then
				return false
			end
			-- Nested-emit cancellation: parent's Engine cleanup flips _parentAlive[1].
			if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then return false end
			-- Play-driven: PlayHandle:Disable flips token.Alive.
			if emitCtx and emitCtx._playToken and emitCtx._playToken.Alive == false then return false end
			return true
		end

		if emissionMode == "Animate" then
			local function doAnimate()
				if not genStillCurrent() then return end
				if emitDuration > 0 then
					EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", true)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						-- Own guard: the window must close even after a nested parent died (genStillCurrent
						-- would bail and leave AnimateLoop=true persisted on the source).
						if self.Connection == nil or (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGen or not item.Parent then return end
						if not skipGenSerialization and (item:GetAttribute("_emitGen") or 0) ~= startGen then return end
						if item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") then EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", false) end
					end)
				end
				self:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
			end
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doAnimate) else doAnimate() end
			return
		end

		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)

		local function doEmit()
			if not genStillCurrent() then return end
			-- Advance the rolling cycle ONCE per emission (this whole burst), then offset
			-- every particle's even spread by it. Keyed by _EvenCycleId so the next burst
			-- and nested re-emits keep rolling the same shared counter.
			local hasPosEven, hasRotEven = EvenCycle.evenFlags(config)
			local cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = 1, 0, 1, 0
			if hasPosEven or hasRotEven then
				local cycleKey = item:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") or item
				local currentRate = (config and config:GetAttribute("Rate")) or 10
				cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = EvenCycle.advance(self._evenCycleStore, cycleKey, config, currentRate, hasPosEven, hasRotEven)
			end
			for i = 1, emitCount do
				self:Emit(item, link, Events.withEvenOffset(emitCtx, i, emitCount, cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN))
			end
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				if isChainDriven or isNestedDriven or isPlayDriven then
					-- Chain-, nested- or play-driven: independent parallel loop. Don't flip
					-- cfg.Enabled  -  nested-driven must not touch the user's standalone
					-- Enabled state on the nested item, since each parent particle has its
					-- own _parentAlive lifetime; cfg.Enabled is reserved for user intent.
					self:Enable(item, link, emitDuration, emitCtx)
				else
					-- User-driven duration emit: flip cfg.Enabled so the engine listener
					-- treats this as the canonical Enable cycle, schedule shared cleanup.
					-- Claim the item so a separate Part module instance skips its auto-Enable.
					EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", true)
					if config then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", true) end
					self:Enable(item, link, emitDuration, emitCtx)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if not genStillCurrent() then return end
						if config and config.Parent then EngineAttr.write(config, "Enabled", false) end
						EngineAttr.write(item, "_PartIclePlaying", nil)
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
	end

	-- Continuous emit loop until duration / cfg.Enabled / parent / engine-gen drift.
	-- Animate mode short-circuits to AnimateLoop=true + EmitAnimate.
	function Particle:Enable(item, link, duration, emitCtx)
		self:_warnIfNotActivated("Enable")
		local data = self:GetData(item)
		if not data then return end
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute('EmissionMode') or "Emit"
		if emissionMode == "Animate" then
			EngineAttr.write(item, "AnimateLoop", true)
			self:EmitAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
			return
		end
		local loopDuration = duration or math.huge
		local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
		-- Chain-driven AND nested-driven loops run parallel (own bucket); user-driven
		-- cancel-and-replace. Nested-driven means each parent particle gets its OWN
		-- independent task whose lifetime tracks _parentAlive[1].
		local isChainDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx ~= nil
		local isNestedDriven = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil
		-- Play-driven: an AbsoluteEmitAt ghost play. Runs parallel (own bucket) so concurrent
		-- plays on ONE shared source coexist instead of cancel-and-replacing via ActiveLoops.
		-- The PlayHandle stops it by flipping token.Alive and cancels its task via token.Loops.
		local playToken = emitCtx and emitCtx._playToken
		local isPlayDriven = playToken ~= nil
		local isParallel = isChainDriven or isNestedDriven or isPlayDriven
		local engineGenAtStart = self._engineGen or 0
		local function loopBody()
			local startTime = os.clock()
			local emitAccum = 0 -- sub-frame Rate carry
			-- Persistent rolling cycle, keyed by _EvenCycleId so this loop, discrete bursts,
			-- and nested re-emits share + advance one counter (resets on Disable, not on a
			-- bare cfg.Enabled re-toggle). Direction follows sign of N (+ forward, - reverse).
			local cycleKey = item:GetAttribute("_EvenCycleId") or item
			while true do
				if isParallel and (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGenAtStart then break end
				-- Nested-driven: bail when this parent particle dies. Sibling parents'
				-- loops are independent (different _parentAlive table per parent emit).
				if isNestedDriven and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then break end
				-- Play-driven: bail when the PlayHandle disables this play (token.Alive flipped).
				if isPlayDriven and not playToken.Alive then break end
				if not item or not item.Parent then
					if not isParallel then Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil end; break
				end
				if os.clock() - startTime >= loopDuration then
					if not isParallel then Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil end; break
				end
				if not isParallel and not data.CheckEnabled() then
					Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = nil; break
				end
				local dt = LOOP_YIELD_EVENT:Wait()
				-- Re-check after the yield: the parent particle or engine may have died during the frame.
				if isParallel and (self._engineGen or 0) ~= engineGenAtStart then break end
				if isNestedDriven and emitCtx._parentAlive and not emitCtx._parentAlive[1] then break end
				if isPlayDriven and not playToken.Alive then break end
				-- Studio-unfocused pause; runtime always passes (Selection:Get is editor-only).
				if IS_STUDIO and IS_PLUGIN and not Particle._focused then
					local sel = Selection:Get()
					if #sel == 0 or (Particle._unfocusedAt > 0 and os.clock() - Particle._unfocusedAt > 600) then emitAccum = 0; continue end
				end
				local currentRate = config and config:GetAttribute("Rate") or 10
				if currentRate <= 0 then emitAccum = 0; continue end
				local interval = 1 / currentRate
				emitAccum = emitAccum + dt
				local hasPosEven = (data.PosXEven or data.PosYEven or data.PosZEven) == true
				local hasRotEven = (data.RotXEven or data.RotYEven or data.RotZEven) == true
				while emitAccum >= interval do
					emitAccum = emitAccum - interval
					if hasPosEven or hasRotEven then
						-- One particle per emission: i=1,count=1; the cycle is pure offset.
						local cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN = EvenCycle.advance(self._evenCycleStore, cycleKey, config, currentRate, hasPosEven, hasRotEven)
						self:Emit(item, link, Events.withEvenOffset(emitCtx, 1, 1, cyPI, cyPN, cyRI, cyRN))
					else
						self:Emit(item, link, emitCtx)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if isParallel then
			-- Bucket per-item so Disable can cancel; task self-removes its entry on
			-- completion. Nested-driven and chain-driven share this bucket: both are
			-- independent parallel tasks that must coexist (one per parent particle
			-- for nested-driven; one per chain stagger for chain-driven).
			local chainTask = task.spawn(function()
				loopBody()
				local selfThread = coroutine.running()
				local bucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
				if not bucket then return end
				for i = #bucket, 1, -1 do
					if bucket[i] == selfThread then table.remove(bucket, i); break end
				end
				if #bucket == 0 then Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = nil end
			end)
			local bucket = Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item]
			if not bucket then bucket = {}; Particle.ActiveChainLoops[item] = bucket end
			table.insert(bucket, chainTask)
			-- Register with the play so PlayHandle:Disable/SoftDisable cancels exactly this task.
			if isPlayDriven then table.insert(playToken.Loops, chainTask) end
		else
			if Particle.ActiveLoops[item] then task.cancel(Particle.ActiveLoops[item]) end
			Particle.ActiveLoops[item] = task.spawn(loopBody)
		end
	end

	-- Particle:EnableEmitAt / AbsoluteEmitAt live in EmitAt.luau (mixin): origin-override emits with a PlayHandle.

	-- Particle:_registerEmit lives in RegisterEmit.luau (mixin) — split out to keep this file
	-- under the 500-line cap. It is the universal pData insertion chokepoint + play-token stamp.

	-- _fireOnDeath / _fireOnDestruction / _releaseOrDestroy live in LifecycleRelease.luau (mixin).

	-- Engine-session predicate; ParticlesMod delayed closures bail on _engineGen drift.
	function Particle:_makeAliveCheck()
		local engineGen = self._engineGen or 0
		return function()
			return self.Connection ~= nil and (self._engineGen or 0) == engineGen
		end
	end

	-- AnimateLoop cycle restart: re-seed OnHit + fire OnEmit. EmitIndex nil for re-fires.
	function Particle:_fireAnimateCycleRestartEvents(pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit then
			pData.LastHitCheckPos = Events.getWorldPosition(pData)
			pData.LastHitCheckTime = nil
		end
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnEmit then
			local payload = Events.makePayload(self, pData, "OnEmit", { ChainCtx = pData.EventChainCtx, EmitIndex = nil })
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnEmit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
		end
	end

	-- payload.Kill flags-only; Heartbeat death branch destroys + restores. PartLife=0 forces immediate.
	-- Animate also flips AnimateLoop=false + cfg.Enabled=false so death branch goes to animate-finish.
	function Particle:_killParticle(pData, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		pData._killedManually = true
		pData._fireOnDeathOverride = opts.fireOnDeath == true
		pData._forceDead = true
		pData.PartLife = 0
		if pData.IsAnimate then
			local source = pData._sourceItem
			if source then
				pcall(function()
					EngineAttr.write(source, "AnimateLoop", false)
					-- Enabled is on Configuration, not item; route through config.
					local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(source)
					if cfg then EngineAttr.write(cfg, "Enabled", false) end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end

--[[
	LifecycleRelease Mixin  -  end-of-life helpers shared by Engine reclaim paths and finishAnimate:
	_fireOnDeath / _fireOnDestruction (event dispatch) and _releaseOrDestroy (pool release vs Destroy).
	Split from Lifecycle.luau for the 500-line cap.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local Events = require(script.Parent.Events)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)

return function(Particle)

	-- Bookkeeping every ActiveEmits removal route runs (Engine death / one-shot finish /
	-- Deactivate, Disable sweep, PlayHandle:Disable, cancelAnimation, cap-reject): flips the
	-- nested-alive flag so pending nested closures and duration loops stop. Callers still pop the entry from ActiveEmits themselves.
	-- Animate pData whose VisualPart IS the source's live RenderTemplate. Every destroy path
	-- (Deactivate, cap-reject, PlayHandle / Disable sweeps) must restore it, never Destroy it.
	function Particle:_isLiveRTAnimate(pData)
		if not pData.IsAnimate then return false end
		local t = pData.Type
		return t == "Part" or t == "Attachment" or t == "Beam" or t == "Model" or t == "Highlight" or t == "TrailEmitter"
	end

	function Particle:_reclaimPData(pData)
		if pData._nestedAlive then pData._nestedAlive[1] = false end
	end

	-- OnDeath fire helper; manual Kill suppresses unless fireOnDeath=true.
	function Particle:_fireOnDeath(pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnDeath
			and (not pData._killedManually or pData._fireOnDeathOverride) then
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnDeath", pData.EventChainCtx, nil)
		end
	end

	-- OnDestruction fire helper for Heartbeat destroy paths + finishAnimate.
	function Particle:_fireOnDestruction(pData, visualPart)
		if not (pData.Events and pData.Events.OnDestruction) then return end
		-- Clone-backed types need the visual still parented; VisualPart-less types (CameraShake,
		-- Distortion) resolve their origin through Events.getWorldCF instead.
		local hasOrigin = (visualPart and visualPart.Parent) or (not visualPart and Events.getWorldCF(pData) ~= nil)
		if hasOrigin then
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnDestruction", pData.EventChainCtx, nil)
		end
	end

	-- Release visual to pool when eligible, else Destroy. Animate visuals never pool.
	-- The carrier (if any) is released only after the visual has been destroyed or re-parented
	-- into the pool: destroying the carrier first would take a pooled child with it.
	function Particle:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, visualPart)
		self:_releaseVisual(pData, visualPart)
		if pData._carrier then
			VisualHost.releaseCarrier(pData._carrier)
			pData._carrier = nil
		end
	end

	function Particle:_releaseVisual(pData, visualPart)
		-- Fan-out clones (Lightning per-segment lights) always destroy — never pool.
		-- Runs before the early returns so a dead visualPart still sweeps its extras.
		if pData._extraLights then
			for _, extraLight in ipairs(pData._extraLights) do
				pcall(function() extraLight:Destroy() end)
			end
			pData._extraLights = nil
		end
		if pData._impactDisk then
			pcall(function() pData._impactDisk:Destroy() end)
			pData._impactDisk = nil
		end
		if self:_isLiveRTAnimate(pData) then
			if pData.AnimateItem then self:_cancelAnimation(pData.AnimateItem) end
			return
		end
		if not visualPart then return end
		if not visualPart.Parent then return end
		if pData.IsAnimate or not pData._sourceRT or not pData._poolKind then
			Pool.dropCloneMap(visualPart)
			pcall(function() visualPart:Destroy() end)
			return
		end
		-- Live Rate read so pool cap tracks emitter rate.
		local rate
		local source = pData._sourceItem
		if source and source.Parent then
			local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(source)
			if cfg then rate = cfg:GetAttribute("Rate") end
		end
		Pool.release(visualPart, pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind, rate)
	end

end

--[[
	Lightning Mixin  -  Emit + Animate + Update for procedural part-based lightning bolts.

	Visual = Model of up to MAX_BOLT_PARTS segment parts cloned from the RenderTemplate
	(the user's styled template part). Geometry rolls via BoltGen midpoint displacement
	at JitterRate Hz; per-frame work is transparency/color stepping + tip-extension
	reveal only. All roll buffers live on a per-model "rig" (weak-keyed) so pooled
	reuse allocates nothing.

	Endpoint modes: "Point" (bolt arcs from source to the Target ObjectValue instance,
	re-resolved live every roll) and "Directional" (EmissionDirection ± SpreadAngle for
	Length studs, rolled per emit). GrowthSpeed > 0 reveals segments in arc order.

	Animate mode is clone-animate (like Screen types): a singleton persistent bolt per
	source; the source RT is never mutated, so cancel just destroys the clone.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local TurbulenceMod = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Events)
local BoltGen = require(script.BoltGen)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- Rig construction + pool acquire live in Lightning/Rig (500-line cap split);
-- it owns the weak-keyed Rigs map.
local RigMod = require(script.Rig)
local buildRig = RigMod.buildRig
local acquireBolt = RigMod.acquireBolt
local layoutFor = RigMod.layoutFor
local flushCFrames = RigMod.flushCFrames
local FAR_CFRAME = RigMod.FAR_CFRAME

-- Per-frame roll budget (Heartbeat-scoped module state). Engages only under
-- frame pressure so steady scenes stay bit-identical; during a hitch it caps
-- FRESH geometry rolls per frame, deferring the rest one frame via
-- pData._rollPending (bypasses the cap on landing — no starvation).
local ROLL_BUDGET = 8
local PRESSURE_ON = 1 / 40
local PRESSURE_OFF = 1 / 55
local _frameStamp = -1
local _rollsUsed = 0
local _budgetActive = false
local _calmFrames = 0

return function(Particle)

-- Lightning discriminator; shared by init.luau Emit dispatch + Lifecycle EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isLightning(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsLightning") == true
end

-- Spawn-shape sampling + live endpoint resolution live in Lightning/Endpoints
-- (500-line cap split).
local EndpointsMod = require(script.Endpoints)
local ImpactDisk = require(script.ImpactDisk)
local sampleShape = EndpointsMod.sampleShape
local resolveEndpoints = EndpointsMod.resolveEndpoints

-- Flush planned Size writes. BoltGen.planSizes decides which LIVE parts actually
-- changed (exact compares; parked slots skip). Every Size write path must route
-- through here or the plan caches lie.
local function writeSizes(rig, thick, force)
	local writes = BoltGen.planSizes(rig, thick, force)
	for k = 1, writes do
		local i = rig.sizeWriteIdx[k]
		local w = math.max(0.05, thick * rig.widthScale[i] * rig.taper[i])
		rig.parts[i].Size = Vector3.new(w, w, rig.segLen[i])
	end
end

-- One geometry roll: endpoints → BoltGen → scroll overlay → Size writes → flush.
local function applyRoll(pData, atEmit)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local startCF, startPos, endPos = resolveEndpoints(pData)
	pData._totalLen = BoltGen.roll(rig, pData, startPos, endPos, FAR_CFRAME)
	if pData._shapeMode ~= "Jitter" then
		BoltGen.applyScroll(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase or 0)
		BoltGen.applyScrollForks(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase or 0)
	end
	RigMod.applyTaper(rig, pData.Graphs.ThicknessProfile, pData.Seeds.ThicknessProfile, pData._totalLen)
	-- Parked→live transitions re-apply cached visuals (stale from before the slot
	-- parked). Skipped at emit: writeVisuals(0) follows and covers every live part.
	-- Gradient colors are handled by the roll-time gradient loop below.
	local newlyLive = BoltGen.diffLive(rig)
	local gradient = pData.Graphs.Gradient
	if not atEmit and newlyLive > 0 then
		local trans = pData._curTrans
		local color = not gradient and pData._curColor or nil
		for k = 1, newlyLive do
			local idx = rig.newlyLiveIdx[k]
			local seg = rig.parts[idx]
			if trans then seg.Transparency = trans end
			if color then seg.Color = color end
			local decal = rig.decals[idx]
			if decal then
				if trans then decal.Transparency = trans end
				if color then decal.Color3 = color end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Spatial Gradient: sample per live part at its arc position and apply the
	-- composed color NOW. Roll-time application is required — with a static
	-- temporal Color, writeVisuals runs once at step 0, so re-rolled arcs and
	-- revived fork slots would otherwise keep stale colors forever.
	if gradient and not pData.SkipColor then
		local invReveal = 1 / math.max(rig.maxReveal or 0, 1e-4)
		local tint = pData._curTint
		for i = 1, rig.partCount do
			if rig.prevLive[i] then
				local arcFrac = math.clamp((rig.revealDist[i] + rig.segLen[i] * 0.5) * invReveal, 0, 1)
				local g = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(arcFrac, gradient)
				rig.gradColor[i] = g
				if not atEmit then
					local c = tint
						and Color3.new(math.min(g.R * tint.R, 1), math.min(g.G * tint.G, 1), math.min(g.B * tint.B, 1))
						or g
					rig.parts[i].Color = c
					local decal = rig.decals[i]
					if decal then decal.Color3 = c end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	writeSizes(rig, pData._curThick or 0.15, atEmit)
	pcall(function() pData.VisualPart.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(startPos) * startCF.Rotation end)
	flushCFrames(pData, atEmit)
	if pData._impactDisk then ImpactDisk.place(pData, startPos, endPos) end
end

-- Step-gated visual write: sample graphs at stepped t, cache scalars, batch-apply.
-- Parked slots (prevLive false) skip: they sit at FAR_CFRAME and applyRoll
-- re-applies the caches when a slot revives.
local function writeVisuals(pData, t)
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local trans = graphs.Transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Transparency, seeds.Transparency) or 0
	if pData.SkipTransparency then trans = pData._curTrans or trans end
	local bright = graphs.Brightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Brightness, seeds.Brightness) or 1
	local color
	if graphs.Color and not pData.SkipColor then
		local c = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.Color)
		color = Color3.new(math.min(c.R * bright, 1), math.min(c.G * bright, 1), math.min(c.B * bright, 1))
	end
	local thick = graphs.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Thickness, seeds.Thickness)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local thickChanged = thick and thick ~= pData._curThick
	if thick then pData._curThick = thick end
	pData._curTrans = trans
	pData._curBright = bright
	if color then
		pData._curColor = color
		-- Tint cache for the roll-time Gradient compose (applyRoll).
		pData._curTint = color
	end
	local gradient = graphs.Gradient
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		if rig.prevLive[i] then
			local seg = rig.parts[i]
			seg.Transparency = trans
			local decal = rig.decals[i]
			if decal then decal.Transparency = trans end
			if color then
				local c = color
				if gradient then
					local g = rig.gradColor[i]
					if g then
						c = Color3.new(math.min(g.R * color.R, 1), math.min(g.G * color.G, 1), math.min(g.B * color.B, 1))
					end
				end
				seg.Color = c
				if decal then decal.Color3 = c end
			end
		end
	end
	if thickChanged then
		writeSizes(rig, thick, false)
	end
	if pData._impactDisk then ImpactDisk.write(pData, t) end
end

-- Per-bolt pData construction lives in Lightning/PDataBuilder (500-line cap split).
local PDataBuilder = require(script.PDataBuilder)
local buildPData = PDataBuilder.build

-- Seek-mode raycast params: OnHit cfg filters + both engine folders excluded by
-- ancestry + RespectCanCollide (Rocks buildRockParams pattern).
local function buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	if pData._endpointMode ~= "Seek" then return end
	local p = EventsMod.makeHitParams(pData)
	p.RespectCanCollide = true
	pcall(function()
		p:AddToFilter(self:GetFolder())
		p:AddToFilter(self:GetPoolFolder())
	end)
	pData._seekRayFn = function(origin, disp)
		return workspace:Raycast(origin, disp, p)
	end
end

-- OnHit per strike-point acquisition (emit + each retarget), Seek mode only.
-- Payload carries the seek raycast's real hit; the global per-frame event
-- budget (Events.reserveFrameFire) guards retarget spam.
local function fireSeekHit(self, pData)
	if not pData._seekNewHit then return end
	-- Glide (RetargetSpeed > 0) holds the fire until the strike point arrives.
	if not EndpointsMod.glideArrived(pData) then return end
	pData._seekNewHit = nil
	if not (pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit and pData._seekHit) then return end
	local hit = pData._seekHit
	local payload = EventsMod.makePayload(self, pData, "OnHit", nil)
	payload.HitInstance = hit.Instance
	payload.Other = hit.Instance
	payload.HitPosition = hit.Position
	payload.HitNormal = hit.Normal
	EventsMod.fire(self, pData, "OnHit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
end

-- Spawn one bolt clone.
function Particle:EmitLightning(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = acquireBolt(data)
	local pData = buildPData(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Nested emit: link = the emitted parent clone; resolveEndpoints prefers its
	-- LIVE CFrame so the bolt origin rides the moving particle. nil for top-level.
	pData._parentLink = link

	-- Event origin override (EnableEmitAt / Events AtPosition chains): freeze the
	-- resolved origin as the bolt start for its whole life.
	if emitCtx then
		local originCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		originCF = originCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if originCF then
			pData._startCFOverride = (emitCtx.UseFullOrigin and originCF)
				or CFrame.new(originCF.Position) * item.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	end

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	if data.Pool ~= false then
		pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Lightning"
	end

	-- Frame-0: thickness seed, geometry roll (pre-parent → direct CFrame writes), visuals.
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	-- Emit rolls never defer (the bolt must appear this frame) but count
	-- against the frame budget.
	_rollsUsed += 1
	applyRoll(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)

	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	ImpactDisk.attach(self, pData, data)
	Pool.restoreTrails(model, "Lightning")
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
	fireSeekHit(self, pData)
end

-- Animate mode: singleton persistent bolt per source (clone-animate; source RT untouched).
function Particle:EmitLightningAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	local pData = buildPData(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	pData._parentLink = link
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	-- Emit rolls never defer (the bolt must appear this frame) but count
	-- against the frame budget.
	_rollsUsed += 1
	applyRoll(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)

	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	ImpactDisk.attach(self, pData, data)
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
	fireSeekHit(self, pData)
end

-- Per-frame Heartbeat update. Idle frame cost = time header + three comparisons;
-- zero allocation (roll-time writes go into pre-sized rig buffers).
function Particle:UpdateLightning(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Highlight.luau UpdateHighlight.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local prevEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = prevEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	local model = pData.VisualPart
	if not model or not model.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)

	local rig = pData._rig

	-- Roll-budget frame bookkeeping: currentTime is shared by every particle in
	-- one Heartbeat step, so the first Lightning update of the frame resets the
	-- counter and re-evaluates the pressure gate (2-calm-frame hysteresis).
	if currentTime ~= _frameStamp then
		_frameStamp = currentTime
		_rollsUsed = 0
		if dt > PRESSURE_ON then
			_budgetActive = true
			_calmFrames = 0
		elseif _budgetActive then
			if dt < PRESSURE_OFF then
				_calmFrames += 1
				if _calmFrames >= 2 then
					_budgetActive = false
				end
			else
				_calmFrames = 0
			end
		end
	end

	-- Geometry work skipped on the death frame; the final keyframe write below still
	-- runs so a lingering bolt (PartLife) holds the end-of-graph look.
	if not isDying then
		-- Origin motion: Speed along the launch direction (drag-damped) + Acceleration
		-- drift, plus PosOffset displacement graphs. resolveEndpoints applies both at
		-- the next roll (JitterRate sets motion smoothness). Clamped effective-time
		-- delta, NOT raw dtTs: once the clock pins at 0 / LifeTime the signed drift
		-- stops instead of over-running (reverse Timescale past the start).
		local mdt = newEff - prevEff
		if pData._hasMotion and mdt ~= 0 then
			local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
			local sp = pData.Graphs.Speed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) or 0
			if pData._drag ~= 0 then sp = sp * math.exp(-pData._drag * newEff) end
			pData._motionAccelVel = pData._motionAccelVel + pData._accel * mdt
			pData._motionOffset = pData._motionOffset
				+ (pData._lastDirWorld or Vector3.zero) * (sp * mdt)
				+ pData._motionAccelVel * mdt
		end
		if pData._hasDisp then
			local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
			local ox = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
			local oy = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
			local oz = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
			pData._dispRaw = Vector3.new(ox, oy, oz)
		end
		if pData._hasTurb then
			local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
			pData._turbRaw = TurbulenceMod.sampleRaw(pData.Graphs.Turbulence, pData.Seeds.Turbulence,
				pData._turbSeed, pData._turbFreq, lifeTime, li)
		end
		-- Pending roll deferred by the budget last frame: bypasses the cap (still
		-- counts) so worst case is one frame late — no starvation. A pending roll
		-- landing on a death frame is dropped silently (isDying skips geometry).
		if pData._rollPending and pData._rollPendingStamp ~= currentTime then
			pData._rollPending = nil
			pData._rollPendingStamp = nil
			pData._jitterAccum = 0
			_rollsUsed += 1
			applyRoll(pData, false)
			fireSeekHit(self, pData)
		end

		-- Seek glide: strike point advances toward the goal at RetargetSpeed studs/s.
		-- Jitter rolls pick the moved point up at JitterRate; a frozen-jitter bolt
		-- (rate 0) re-rolls itself here so the drag stays visible.
		if EndpointsMod.glideStep(pData, math.abs(mdt)) and pData._jitterInterval == math.huge then
			if _budgetActive and _rollsUsed >= ROLL_BUDGET then
				pData._rollPending = true
				pData._rollPendingStamp = currentTime
			else
				_rollsUsed += 1
				applyRoll(pData, false)
				fireSeekHit(self, pData)
			end
		end

		-- Jitter re-roll at JitterRate Hz. abs() so reversed time still flickers; a hitch
		-- rolls once, never queues a burst. Budget-deferred rolls keep the accumulator;
		-- the pending landing zeroes it.
		pData._jitterAccum += math.abs(dtTs)
		if pData._jitterAccum >= pData._jitterInterval and not pData._rollPending then
			if _budgetActive and _rollsUsed >= ROLL_BUDGET then
				pData._rollPending = true
				pData._rollPendingStamp = currentTime
			else
				pData._jitterAccum = 0
				_rollsUsed += 1
				applyRoll(pData, false)
				fireSeekHit(self, pData)
			end
		end

		-- Tip-extension reveal (GrowthSpeed). Effective-time-based → reversible.
		-- Scroll modes only advance _tipDist here (flushCFrames rebuilds the full
		-- mask every frame); reversed growth always full-rebuilds (<=64 comparisons).
		if pData._lSpeed ~= 0 then
			local tip = math.abs(pData._lSpeed) * newEff
			if tip ~= pData._tipDist then
				pData._tipDist = tip
				if pData._growReversed then
					if pData._shapeMode == "Jitter" then
						flushCFrames(pData, false)
					end
				elseif pData._shapeMode == "Jitter" then
					local order, rd, wcf, rcf = rig.revealOrder, rig.revealDist, rig.writeCFs, rig.rollCFs
					local ptr = pData._revealPtr
					local dirty = false
					while ptr < rig.partCount and rd[order[ptr + 1]] <= tip do
						ptr += 1
						local idx = order[ptr]
						wcf[idx] = rcf[idx]
						dirty = true
					end
					while ptr > 0 and rd[order[ptr]] > tip do
						local idx = order[ptr]
						wcf[idx] = FAR_CFRAME
						dirty = true
						ptr -= 1
					end
					pData._revealPtr = ptr
					if dirty then
						workspace:BulkMoveTo(rig.parts, rig.writeCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- Traveling Perlin wave (Scroll / JitterScroll): advance phase, recompute main
		-- segments, batch-flush. Signed + freeze-aware like the effective-time clock.
		if pData._shapeMode ~= "Jitter" then
			pData._scrollPhase += pData._scrollSpeed * (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
			BoltGen.applyScroll(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase)
			BoltGen.applyScrollForks(rig, pData, pData._scrollPhase)
			-- Scroll never changes slot liveness (fork firing is roll-only), so no
			-- diffLive here; planSizes drops the writes for parked slots.
			writeSizes(rig, pData._curThick or 0.15, false)
			flushCFrames(pData, false)
		end
	end

	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		writeVisuals(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	end

	return isDying
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (Engine replay branch dispatch). Re-reads procedural
-- props, rerolls spread/length, resets growth + jitter; rebuilds the rig when a
-- SegmentCount / fork edit changed the part count.
function Particle:_refreshLightningAnimate(pData, freshData)
	-- Engine's generic replay assigns pData.Link from freshData. A bolt is never moved by
	-- LinkTrack: its origin rides _userLink through Endpoints, re-read here for the new cycle.
	pData.Link = nil
	pData._userLink = freshData.Link
	pData._originPivotRot = nil
	pData._originLinkCF = nil
	pData._endpointMode = freshData.TargetMode == "Seek" and "Seek"
		or ((freshData.TargetMode == "Point" and freshData.Target and freshData.Target.Parent) and "Point" or "Directional")
	pData._target = freshData.Target
	-- Seek: re-roll radius + drop the cached strike so each cycle re-acquires.
	pData._seekRadius = math.max(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.SeekRadius), 1)
	pData._seekRetarget = freshData.SeekRetarget == true
	pData._seekBias = math.clamp(freshData.SeekBias or 0, 0, 1)
	pData._retargetSpeed = math.max(freshData.RetargetSpeed or 0, 0)
	pData._seekHit = nil
