	pData._seekFallbackDir = nil
	pData._seekNewHit = nil
	pData._seekCurrentPos = nil
	pData._seekGoalPos = nil
	buildSeekParams(self, pData)
	pData._length = math.max(0.1, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Length))
	pData._amplitude = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Amplitude)
	pData._decay = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.AmplitudeDecay)
	pData._forkChance = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ForkChance)
	pData._forkDepth = math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ForkDepth) + 0.5)
	pData._forkLenScale = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ForkLengthScale)
	pData._sag = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Sag)
	pData._sagShape = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.SagShape)
	pData._shapeMode = freshData.ShapeMode or "Jitter"
	pData._scrollSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.ScrollSpeed)
	pData._waves = math.max(0.25, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.Waves))
	pData._scrollPhase = 0
	pData._noiseSeedA = math.random() * 1000
	pData._noiseSeedB = 500 + math.random() * 1000
	local jitterHz = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.JitterRate)
	pData._jitterInterval = jitterHz > 0 and 1 / jitterHz or math.huge
	pData._jitterAccum = 0
	local growthSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.GrowthSpeed)
	pData._lSpeed = growthSpeed
	pData._growReversed = growthSpeed < 0
	pData._tipDist = 0
	pData._revealPtr = 0
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[freshData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local localAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	local spread = freshData.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(freshData, freshData.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, nil)
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(freshData.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX or 0, rotS.RotY or 0, rotS.RotZ or 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, localAxis)
	if freshData.DirMode == "Local" then cf = cf * rotXYZ end
	if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
		cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
	end
	pData._dirLocalVec = cf.LookVector
	pData._dirGlobal = freshData.DirMode == "Global"
	pData._originRot = rotXYZ
	local posS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(freshData, freshData.AxisLinks, {"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, RangeMod, nil)
	local px, py, pz = posS.PosX or 0, posS.PosY or 0, posS.PosZ or 0
	if px ~= 0 or py ~= 0 or pz ~= 0 then
		pData._originOffset = Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
		pData._originOffsetGlobal = freshData.PosMode == "Global"
	else
		pData._originOffset = nil
	end
	-- Origin motion resets per cycle (accumulators restart from the source pose).
	pData._accel = freshData.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
	pData._drag = freshData.Drag or 0
	pData._dispMode = freshData.DisplacementMode or "Global"
	pData._motionOffset = Vector3.zero
	pData._motionAccelVel = Vector3.zero
	pData._dispRaw = nil
	pData._hasMotion = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.Speed) ~= nil or pData._accel.Magnitude > 0
	pData._hasDisp = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.PosOffsetX) ~= nil
		or PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.PosOffsetY) ~= nil
		or PDataBuilder.liveGraph(freshData.PosOffsetZ) ~= nil
	-- Gradient + Taper + Turbulence re-read per cycle; fresh noise seed varies the wander per loop.
	pData.Graphs.Gradient = PDataBuilder.liveColor(freshData.Gradient)
	pData.Graphs.ThicknessProfile = PDataBuilder.liveProfile(freshData.ThicknessProfile)
	pData.Seeds.ThicknessProfile = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(pData.Graphs.ThicknessProfile)
	pData.Graphs.Turbulence = TurbulenceMod.isLive(freshData.Turbulence)
	pData._hasTurb = pData.Graphs.Turbulence ~= nil
	pData._turbFreq = freshData.TurbulenceFrequency or 1
	pData._turbSeed = math.random() * 997 + 0.5
	pData._turbRaw = nil
	sampleShape(pData, freshData, pData.AnimateItem)

	local expected = layoutFor(freshData)
	if expected ~= pData._rig.partCount and freshData.RenderTemplate then
		local oldModel = pData.VisualPart
		local parent = oldModel and oldModel.Parent
		local model, rig = buildRig(freshData)
		model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
		pData.VisualPart = model
		pData._rig = rig
		model.Parent = parent or self:GetFolder()
		if oldModel then pcall(function() oldModel:Destroy() end) end
	end
	-- Reroll after any rig rebuild so the clamp sees the current mainSegs.
	pData._segCount = math.clamp(math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(freshData.SegmentCount) + 0.5), 2, pData._rig.mainSegs)

	pData._curThick = freshData.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, freshData.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or pData._curThick
	ImpactDisk.refresh(self, pData, freshData)
	-- Cycle-refresh rolls now; drop any budget-deferred roll from the old cycle.
	pData._rollPending = nil
	pData._rollPendingStamp = nil
	_rollsUsed += 1
	applyRoll(pData, false)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	fireSeekHit(self, pData)
end

end

--[[
	BoltGen  -  pure lightning-bolt geometry. No engine/pool knowledge.
	Midpoint displacement over caller-owned buffers: every roll overwrites slots in
	the rig arrays allocated once by Lightning/init.buildRig  -  zero table creation
	per roll. Fork slots have build-time-fixed depth; unused slots park at farCF with
	revealDist = math.huge so the growth reveal never shows them.
]]

local BoltGen = {}

local FORK_MIN_ANGLE = math.rad(15)
local FORK_MAX_ANGLE = math.rad(45)
local MIN_SEG_LEN = 0.05

-- Part-count layout for a config. mainSegs = clamped SegmentCount; forks are
-- polylines of half resolution. Clamps forkSlots so the total stays <= maxParts.
-- Slot depths are fixed by position: first half depth 1, remainder depth 2.
function BoltGen.layout(segmentCount, forkDepth, forkChance, maxParts)
	local mainSegs = math.clamp(math.floor(segmentCount or 12), 2, maxParts)
	local forkSlots = 0
	local forkSegs = math.max(2, math.floor(mainSegs / 2))
	-- >= 0.5 matches PDataBuilder's round-to-nearest on the per-bolt roll, so a
	-- ForkDepth that rounds to 1 also gets slots allocated.
	if (forkDepth or 0) >= 0.5 and (forkChance or 0) > 0 then
		local remaining = maxParts - mainSegs
		-- High Segments can leave less part budget than one half-resolution fork;
		-- shrink the per-fork resolution before surrendering slots (a 4-segment
		-- fork beats zero forks).
		if remaining >= 4 and math.floor(remaining / forkSegs) < 2 then
			forkSegs = math.max(4, math.min(forkSegs, math.floor(remaining / 2)))
		end
		forkSlots = math.min(6, math.floor(remaining / forkSegs))
		if forkSlots < 0 then forkSlots = 0 end
	end
	return mainSegs + forkSlots * forkSegs, mainSegs, forkSegs, forkSlots
end

-- Orthonormal basis perpendicular to dir; degenerate dir falls back to world axes.
function BoltGen.basis(dir)
	if dir.Magnitude < 1e-4 then return Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis end
	local unit = dir.Unit
	local ref = math.abs(unit.Y) < 0.99 and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis
	local u = unit:Cross(ref).Unit
	local v = unit:Cross(u)
	return u, v
end

-- Recursive midpoint displacement over pts[lo..hi] (endpoints already set).
-- Offsets in the u/v plane; amplitude decays per level.
local function displace(pts, lo, hi, amp, decay, u, v)
	if hi - lo <= 1 then return end
	local mid = math.floor((lo + hi) / 2)
	local t = (mid - lo) / (hi - lo)
	pts[mid] = pts[lo]:Lerp(pts[hi], t)
		+ u * ((math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp)
		+ v * ((math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp)
	local nextAmp = amp * decay
	displace(pts, lo, mid, nextAmp, decay, u, v)
	displace(pts, mid, hi, nextAmp, decay, u, v)
end

-- Fill pts[1..segs+1] with a polyline from startPos toward endPos. jitter=false
-- skips midpoint displacement (Scroll mode base). Sag applies AFTER displacement:
-- the midpoint recursion lerps between endpoints, so a pre-applied droop would be
-- overwritten.
local function buildPolyline(pts, segs, startPos, endPos, amp, decay, sag, jitter, sagDir, sagShape)
	local delta = endPos - startPos
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	for i = 1, segs + 1 do
		pts[i] = startPos + delta * ((i - 1) / segs)
	end
	if jitter and amp ~= 0 then
		local u, v = BoltGen.basis(delta)
		displace(pts, 1, segs + 1, amp, decay, u, v)
	end
	-- Signed: negative sag arches upward, along frame down (sagDir, DisplacementMode).
	-- sagShape >= 1: exponent profile (1 = parabola, higher = pointier). Below 1 the
	-- path morphs through EXACT circular-arc geometry: 0.5 = the circle whose sagitta
	-- is the sag depth (past a semicircle it wraps outward as a horseshoe), 0 = square
	-- trough, in-between = point-wise blend. The blend zone bulges along the chord-
	-- perpendicular component of sagDir (arc geometry needs a perpendicular axis).
	if sag ~= 0 and dist > 1e-4 then
		local droop = (sagDir or Vector3.yAxis) * (sag >= 0 and -1 or 1)
		local shape = math.max(sagShape or 1, 0)
		local h = math.abs(sag) * dist
		if shape >= 1 then
			for i = 2, segs do
				local t = (i - 1) / segs
				local profile = 4 * t * (1 - t)
				if shape ~= 1 then profile = profile ^ shape end
				pts[i] = pts[i] + droop * (h * profile)
			end
		else
			local u = delta * (1 / dist)
			local bulge = droop - u * droop:Dot(u)
			if bulge.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
				bulge = bulge.Unit
				-- Sagitta circle through both endpoints: r from chord + depth.
				-- acos, not two-arg atan: Luau's math.atan is single-argument (it
				-- silently ignores a second argument, unlike Lua 5.3).
				local r = (dist * dist * 0.25 + h * h) / (2 * h)
				local halfSweep = math.acos(math.clamp((r - h) / r, -1, 1))
				local center = startPos + delta * 0.5 + bulge * (h - r)
				for i = 2, segs do
					local t = (i - 1) / segs
					local base = startPos + delta * t
					local phi = (2 * t - 1) * halfSweep
					local arcPt = center + (u * math.sin(phi) + bulge * math.cos(phi)) * r
					local target
					if shape >= 0.5 then
						local parabolaPt = base + bulge * (h * 4 * t * (1 - t))
						target = arcPt:Lerp(parabolaPt, (shape - 0.5) * 2)
					else
						local troughPt = base + bulge * h
						target = troughPt:Lerp(arcPt, shape * 2)
					end
					pts[i] = pts[i] + (target - base)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Write segment CFrames/lengths/reveal distances for pts[1..segs+1] into rig slots
-- starting at slotBase+1. revealBase = arc distance already travelled before this
-- polyline begins (0 for the main bolt, branch-point distance for forks).
local function writeSegments(rig, pts, segs, slotBase, revealBase)
	local arc = revealBase
	for i = 1, segs do
		local p0, p1 = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
		local seg = p1 - p0
		local len = seg.Magnitude
		local slot = slotBase + i
		rig.revealDist[slot] = arc
		if len > 1e-4 then
			rig.rollCFs[slot] = CFrame.lookAt((p0 + p1) * 0.5, p1)
		else
			rig.rollCFs[slot] = CFrame.new((p0 + p1) * 0.5)
		end
		rig.segLen[slot] = math.max(len, MIN_SEG_LEN)
		arc += len
	end
	return arc - revealBase
end

-- One full geometry roll. Overwrites rig buffers only. params reads: _amplitude
-- (fraction of bolt length), _decay, _forkChance, _forkDepth, _forkLenScale, _sag.
-- Returns the main polyline's arc length.
function BoltGen.roll(rig, params, startPos, endPos, farCF)
	-- Per-bolt segment count within the max-sized rig; leftover main slots park far.
	local mainSegs = math.clamp(params._segCount or rig.mainSegs, 2, rig.mainSegs)
	local dist = (endPos - startPos).Magnitude
	local amp = (params._amplitude or 0) * dist
	local mode = params._shapeMode or "Jitter"

	-- Scroll = straight+sag base (traveling wave applied per frame by applyScroll);
	-- Jitter/JitterScroll = midpoint-displaced base re-rolled here at JitterRate.
	buildPolyline(rig.ptBuf, mainSegs, startPos, endPos, amp, params._decay or 0.5, params._sag or 0, mode ~= "Scroll",
		params._sagDirWorld, params._sagShape)
	if mode ~= "Jitter" then
		for i = 1, mainSegs + 1 do rig.basePtBuf[i] = rig.ptBuf[i] end
		rig.scrollU, rig.scrollV = BoltGen.basis(endPos - startPos)
		rig.scrollDist = dist
	end
	rig.curSegs = mainSegs
	local totalLen = writeSegments(rig, rig.ptBuf, mainSegs, 0, 0)
	for i = mainSegs + 1, rig.mainSegs do
		rig.rollCFs[i] = farCF
		rig.segLen[i] = MIN_SEG_LEN
		rig.revealDist[i] = math.huge
	end

	-- Forks. Depth-1 slots branch off the main polyline; depth-2 slots branch off a
	-- depth-1 fork that fired THIS roll (anchor cached per slot). Chance-gated per roll.
	local forkSlots = rig.forkSlots
	local depth1Fired = 0
	for slot = 1, forkSlots do
		-- Slot layout is FIXED at rig.mainSegs (range Max); only the polyline uses the
		-- per-bolt rolled count.
		local slotBase = rig.mainSegs + (slot - 1) * rig.forkSegs
		local depth = rig.slotDepth[slot]
		local fired = false
		if (params._forkChance or 0) > math.random() and (params._forkDepth or 0) >= depth then
			local originPos, originDir, originReveal
			local originIdx, parentSlot, parentPtIdx = 0, 0, 0
			if depth == 1 then
				local idx = math.random(2, mainSegs)
				originPos = rig.ptBuf[idx]
				originDir = (rig.ptBuf[idx + 1] or endPos) - originPos
				-- Point idx is the START of segment idx; revealDist[idx] is the arc there.
				originReveal = rig.revealDist[idx] or 0
				originIdx = idx
			elseif depth1Fired > 0 then
				local src = math.random(1, depth1Fired)
				originPos = rig.forkAnchorPos[src]
				originDir = rig.forkAnchorDir[src]
				originReveal = rig.forkAnchorReveal[src]
				parentSlot = rig.forkAnchorSlot[src]
				parentPtIdx = rig.forkAnchorPtIdx[src]
			end
			if originPos and originDir and originDir.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
				local scale = (params._forkLenScale or 0.4) ^ depth
				local forkLen = math.max(1, dist * scale)
				local u, v = BoltGen.basis(originDir)
				local phi = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				local axis = u * math.cos(phi) + v * math.sin(phi)
				local ang = FORK_MIN_ANGLE + math.random() * (FORK_MAX_ANGLE - FORK_MIN_ANGLE)
				local forkDir = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(axis, ang):VectorToWorldSpace(originDir.Unit)
				local forkEnd = originPos + forkDir * forkLen
				buildPolyline(rig.forkPtBuf, rig.forkSegs, originPos, forkEnd, amp * scale, params._decay or 0.5, 0, true)
				writeSegments(rig, rig.forkPtBuf, rig.forkSegs, slotBase, originReveal)
				-- Retain fork geometry LOCAL to its root + the anchor identity so scroll
				-- modes can re-anchor to the moving main polyline per frame.
				local lp = rig.forkLocalPts[slot]
				for i = 1, rig.forkSegs + 1 do lp[i] = rig.forkPtBuf[i] - originPos end
				rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] = originIdx or 0
				rig.forkParentSlot[slot] = parentSlot or 0
				rig.forkParentPtIdx[slot] = parentPtIdx or 0
				rig.forkLen[slot] = forkLen
				-- Taper continuation: the parent's arc fraction at the branch point (Rig.applyTaper).
				rig.forkStartReveal[slot] = originReveal
				if depth == 1 then
					rig.forkStartFrac[slot] = originReveal / math.max(totalLen, 1e-4)
				else
					local parentStart = rig.forkStartFrac[parentSlot] or 0
					local parentLocal = (originReveal - (rig.forkStartReveal[parentSlot] or 0)) / math.max(rig.forkLen[parentSlot] or 1, 1e-4)
					rig.forkStartFrac[slot] = parentStart + math.clamp(parentLocal, 0, 1) * (1 - parentStart)
				end
				local fu, fv = BoltGen.basis(forkDir)
				rig.forkU[slot], rig.forkV[slot] = fu, fv
				rig.forkSeedU[slot] = math.random() * 100
				rig.forkSeedV[slot] = 100 + math.random() * 100
				if depth == 1 then
					depth1Fired += 1
					local midIdx = math.max(2, math.floor(rig.forkSegs / 2) + 1)
					rig.forkAnchorPos[depth1Fired] = rig.forkPtBuf[midIdx]
					rig.forkAnchorDir[depth1Fired] = forkDir
					rig.forkAnchorReveal[depth1Fired] = originReveal
					rig.forkAnchorSlot[depth1Fired] = slot
					rig.forkAnchorPtIdx[depth1Fired] = midIdx
				end
				fired = true
			end
		end
		if not fired then
			rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] = 0
			rig.forkParentSlot[slot] = 0
			for i = 1, rig.forkSegs do
				local slotIdx = slotBase + i
				rig.rollCFs[slotIdx] = farCF
				rig.segLen[slotIdx] = MIN_SEG_LEN
				rig.revealDist[slotIdx] = math.huge
			end
		end
	end

	-- Max reveal distance (arc at the farthest segment END, forks included)  -
	-- reverse GrowthSpeed measures from here back toward the source.
	local maxReveal = 0
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		local rd = rig.revealDist[i]
		if rd ~= math.huge and rd + rig.segLen[i] > maxReveal then
			maxReveal = rd + rig.segLen[i]
		end
	end
	rig.maxReveal = maxReveal

	-- Reveal order: indices ascending by revealDist. In-place insertion sort  -
	-- <= 64 ints, mostly-sorted between rolls.
	BoltGen.sortReveal(rig)

	return totalLen
end

-- Diff live-vs-parked after a roll. Fills rig.newlyLiveIdx[1..m], updates
-- rig.prevLive, and stamps a lastWrittenLen sentinel on newly-live slots so
-- planSizes force-writes their Size (width can drift while a slot is parked).
-- Liveness = revealDist ~= huge; only BoltGen.roll changes it, so callers run
-- this once per roll (never per scroll frame).
function BoltGen.diffLive(rig)
	local m = 0
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		local live = rig.revealDist[i] ~= math.huge
		if live and not rig.prevLive[i] then
			m += 1
			rig.newlyLiveIdx[m] = i
			rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = -1
		end
		rig.prevLive[i] = live
	end
	return m
end

-- Plan which parts need a Size write this flush: fills rig.sizeWriteIdx[1..n]
-- and maintains the rig.lastWrittenLen / rig.lastThick caches. EXACT compares
-- only  -  rendered geometry must stay bit-identical to unconditional writes.
-- Parked slots are skipped entirely (their Size is invisible at farCF; the
-- diffLive sentinel forces a write when they revive). Every Size write path in
-- Lightning/init.luau MUST go through this plan or the caches lie.
function BoltGen.planSizes(rig, thick, force)
	local thickChanged = force or thick ~= rig.lastThick
	local n = 0
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		if rig.revealDist[i] ~= math.huge then
			local len = rig.segLen[i]
			if thickChanged or len ~= rig.lastWrittenLen[i] then
				n += 1
				rig.sizeWriteIdx[n] = i
				rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = len
			end
		end
	end
	rig.lastThick = thick
	return n
end

-- Per-frame traveling wave (Scroll / JitterScroll). Adds 2-octave Perlin offsets in
-- the roll-time u/v basis to the cached base polyline, endpoint-pinned by 4s(1-s),
-- then rewrites MAIN segment CFrames/lengths in place. Fork slots + revealDist stay
-- from the last full roll. Buffer slot writes only  -  no table allocation.
function BoltGen.applyScroll(rig, params, phase)
	local segs = rig.curSegs
	local u, v = rig.scrollU, rig.scrollV
	if not segs or segs < 2 or not u then return end
	local amp = (params._amplitude or 0) * (rig.scrollDist or 0)
	local waves = params._waves or 3
	local decay = params._decay or 0.5
	local seedA = params._noiseSeedA or 0
	local seedB = params._noiseSeedB or 500
	local pts, base = rig.ptBuf, rig.basePtBuf
	for i = 1, segs + 1 do
		local s = (i - 1) / segs
		-- Squared taper: zero slope at the pinned endpoints so the wave fades in
		-- instead of kinking the exit direction (plain 4s(1-s) has max slope there).
		local env = 4 * s * (1 - s)
		env = env * env
		local x1 = s * waves - phase
		local x2 = s * waves * 2.7 - phase * 1.6
		local offU = (math.noise(x1, seedA) + math.noise(x2, seedA + 37.1) * decay) * amp * env
		local offV = (math.noise(x1, seedB) + math.noise(x2, seedB + 37.1) * decay) * amp * env
		pts[i] = base[i] + u * offU + v * offV
	end
	for i = 1, segs do
		local p0, p1 = pts[i], pts[i + 1]
		local seg = p1 - p0
		local len = seg.Magnitude
		if len > 1e-4 then
			rig.rollCFs[i] = CFrame.lookAt((p0 + p1) * 0.5, p1)
		else
			rig.rollCFs[i] = CFrame.new((p0 + p1) * 0.5)
		end
		rig.segLen[i] = math.max(len, MIN_SEG_LEN)
	end
end

-- Per-frame fork re-anchor + scroll (Scroll / JitterScroll). Each fired fork's root
-- follows the CURRENT (scrolled) main polyline point (depth-2 forks follow their
-- parent fork's current midpoint  -  depth-1 slots come first in slot order, so
-- parents are always up to date); the fork body adds its own root-pinned Perlin
-- wave with a per-slot seed and slightly offset phase so branches move
-- independently of the trunk. Buffer slot writes only.
function BoltGen.applyScrollForks(rig, params, phase)
	local segs = rig.forkSegs
	local waves = params._waves or 3
	for slot = 1, rig.forkSlots do
		local originIdx = rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] or 0
		local parentSlot = rig.forkParentSlot[slot] or 0
		if originIdx ~= 0 or parentSlot ~= 0 then
			local root
			if parentSlot ~= 0 then
				local pw = rig.forkWorldPts[parentSlot]
				root = pw and pw[rig.forkParentPtIdx[slot]]
			else
				root = rig.ptBuf[originIdx]
			end
			if root then
				local lp = rig.forkLocalPts[slot]
				local wp = rig.forkWorldPts[slot]
				local u, v = rig.forkU[slot], rig.forkV[slot]
				local amp = (params._amplitude or 0) * (rig.forkLen[slot] or 1)
				local su = rig.forkSeedU[slot] or 0
				local sv = rig.forkSeedV[slot] or 50
				for i = 1, segs + 1 do
					local s = (i - 1) / segs
					local x1 = s * waves - phase * 1.35
					wp[i] = root + lp[i]
						+ u * (math.noise(x1, su) * amp * s)
						+ v * (math.noise(x1, sv) * amp * s)
				end
				local slotBase = rig.mainSegs + (slot - 1) * segs
				for i = 1, segs do
					local p0, p1 = wp[i], wp[i + 1]
					local d = p1 - p0
					local len = d.Magnitude
					local idx = slotBase + i
					if len > 1e-4 then
						rig.rollCFs[idx] = CFrame.lookAt((p0 + p1) * 0.5, p1)
					else
						rig.rollCFs[idx] = CFrame.new((p0 + p1) * 0.5)
					end
					rig.segLen[idx] = math.max(len, MIN_SEG_LEN)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- In-place insertion sort of revealOrder by revealDist.
function BoltGen.sortReveal(rig)
	local order, rd = rig.revealOrder, rig.revealDist
	for i = 2, rig.partCount do
		local key = order[i]
		local keyDist = rd[key]
		local j = i - 1
		while j >= 1 and rd[order[j]] > keyDist do
			order[j + 1] = order[j]
			j -= 1
		end
		order[j + 1] = key
	end
end

return BoltGen

--[[
	Lightning/Endpoints  -  spawn-shape sampling + live endpoint resolution.
	Split from Lightning/init (500-line cap). Pure pData readers/writers; no
	engine or pool knowledge.
	Origin, in order: an event's origin override, the emitted parent clone of a nested bolt
	(_parentLink), the authored Link by LinkMode (_userLink, through LinkCF.originFrame), the
	source part itself.
]]

local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.Parent.LinkCF)

local Endpoints = {}

-- Resolve a DisplacementMode-framed vector into world space at the current origin.
-- Local = per-bolt rotated frame (origin × RotXYZ); RigidLocal = origin frame only.
local function resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, vec)
	local mode = pData._dispMode
	if mode == "Local" then
		local frame = pData._originRot and (startCF.Rotation * pData._originRot) or startCF
		return frame:VectorToWorldSpace(vec)
	elseif mode == "RigidLocal" then
		return startCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(vec)
	end
	return vec
end

-- Sample the spawn Shape once per bolt: local-frame offset (start scatter) and, in
-- Directional mode, the outward normal as the bolt direction (ShapeInOut applied).
-- Stored shape-local; resolveEndpoints re-applies against the LIVE frame each roll.
function Endpoints.sampleShape(pData, data, item)
	pData._shapeLocalOffset = nil
	pData._shapeDirLocal = nil
	pData._shapeUsesPart = nil
	if not data.UseShape then return end
	local shapeFunc = Constants.shapeFunctions[data.Shape]
	local shapePart = data.ShapePart
	local shapeSrc = (shapePart and shapePart:IsA("BasePart")) and shapePart
		or (item and item:IsA("BasePart") and item or nil)
	if not shapeFunc or not shapeSrc then return end
	local offset, _, outwardDir = shapeFunc(shapeSrc, { ShapePartial = data.ShapePartial or 0 })
	pData._shapeLocalOffset = offset
	pData._shapeUsesPart = shapeSrc ~= item and shapeSrc or nil
	-- Radial only when explicitly chosen; Emitter mode keeps the authored
	-- Direction ± Spread (shape scatters starts only).
	if data.ShapeDirection == "Radial" and pData._endpointMode == "Directional" and outwardDir then
		local sio = data.ShapeInOut
		if sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward then
			outwardDir = -outwardDir
		elseif sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut and math.random() < 0.5 then
			outwardDir = -outwardDir
		end
		pData._shapeDirLocal = outwardDir
	end
end

-- Seek (Kutsuna arc-grounding): cast SEEK_RAYS random directions from the
-- current origin, collect surface hits within _seekRadius, keep one at RANDOM
-- (nearest would collapse every bolt onto the same object). SeekBias skews the
-- pick toward closer hits: 0 = uniform, 1 = near-always the nearest. No hit →
-- cache a fallback direction so the bolt arcs into open air at half radius.
-- _seekNewHit flags a fresh acquisition; Lightning/init fires OnHit from it.
local SEEK_RAYS = 8
local function seekScan(pData, startPos)
	local rayFn = pData._seekRayFn
	if not rayFn then return end
	local radius = pData._seekRadius or 30
	local hits = {}
	for _ = 1, SEEK_RAYS do
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
		if dir.Magnitude > 1e-3 then
			local hit = rayFn(startPos, dir.Unit * radius)
			if hit then
				hits[#hits + 1] = { hit = hit, dist = (hit.Position - startPos).Magnitude }
			end
		end
	end
	if #hits > 0 then
		table.sort(hits, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
		-- Skewed index: random^(1+bias*8) compresses toward 0 as bias rises,
		-- so the sorted-nearest hits win more often without ever excluding the far ones.
		local bias = pData._seekBias or 0
		local skew = math.random() ^ (1 + bias * 8)
		local hit = hits[math.clamp(math.floor(skew * #hits) + 1, 1, #hits)].hit
		pData._seekHit = { Position = hit.Position, Normal = hit.Normal, Instance = hit.Instance }
		pData._seekNewHit = true
	else
		pData._seekHit = nil
		local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
		pData._seekFallbackDir = dir.Magnitude > 1e-3 and dir.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
	end
end

-- Advance the glide strike point toward the goal by RetargetSpeed * dt.
-- Returns true when it moved (UpdateLightning re-rolls a frozen-jitter bolt on it).
function Endpoints.glideStep(pData, dt)
	local cur, goal = pData._seekCurrentPos, pData._seekGoalPos
	if (pData._retargetSpeed or 0) <= 0 or not cur or not goal then return false end
	local delta = goal - cur
	local dist = delta.Magnitude
	if dist <= 1e-3 then return false end
	local step = pData._retargetSpeed * dt
	pData._seekCurrentPos = step >= dist and goal or cur + delta * (step / dist)
	return true
end

-- Glide arrival check: OnHit holds until the strike point reaches the goal
-- (the impact lands where the zap lands). Instant mode always counts as arrived.
function Endpoints.glideArrived(pData)
	if (pData._retargetSpeed or 0) <= 0 then return true end
	local cur, goal = pData._seekCurrentPos, pData._seekGoalPos
	if not cur or not goal then return true end
	return (cur - goal).Magnitude <= 1e-2
end

-- Live endpoint resolution, used at emit AND every jitter roll so moving sources /
-- targets / ShapeParts track. Destroyed instances freeze at their last known pose.
-- Returns (startCF for pivot rotation, startPos, endPos).
function Endpoints.resolveEndpoints(pData)
	local startCF
	local link = pData._parentLink
	if pData._startCFOverride then
		startCF = pData._startCFOverride
	elseif link and link.Parent then
		-- Nested emit: origin rides the emitted parent clone (re-resolved every
		-- roll, so a moving parent carries its bolts). resolveLinkCFrame handles
		-- Model/Attachment/Bone clone roots.
		startCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	else
		local src = pData._sourceItem
		local sourceCF = (src and src.Parent) and src.CFrame or pData._lastStartCF or CFrame.new()
		if pData._userLink then
			startCF = LinkCF.originFrame(pData, pData._userLink, src, sourceCF)
		end
		startCF = startCF or sourceCF
	end
	pData._lastStartCF = startCF

	-- Spawn Shape: apply the per-bolt local offset in the live shape frame.
	local startPos = startCF.Position
	local dirFrame = startCF
	if pData._shapeLocalOffset then
		local sp = pData._shapeUsesPart
		local frame = (sp and sp.Parent and sp.CFrame) or startCF
		startPos = (frame * CFrame.new(pData._shapeLocalOffset)).Position
		dirFrame = frame
	end

	-- Spawn Pos offset (even-distribution aware, rolled per bolt). Rotation applies
	-- FIRST: Local offsets live in the per-bolt rotated frame (origin frame × RotXYZ)
	-- so Rot-even sweeps + Pos offsets compose into rings/spirals, and the whole
	-- pattern rides moving sources/links. PosMode Global = raw world axes.
	local off = pData._originOffset
	if off then
		if pData._originOffsetGlobal then
			startPos = startPos + off
		else
			local frame = pData._originRot and (startCF.Rotation * pData._originRot) or startCF
			startPos = startPos + frame:VectorToWorldSpace(off)
		end
	end

	-- Origin motion: accumulated Speed/Accel drift (world) + PosOffset displacement
	-- graphs + Turbulence wander, the latter two in the DisplacementMode frame.
	-- All maintained by UpdateLightning.
	local motion = pData._motionOffset
	if motion and motion ~= Vector3.zero then
		startPos = startPos + motion
	end
	local disp = pData._dispRaw
	if disp then
		startPos = startPos + resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, disp)
	end
	local turb = pData._turbRaw
	if turb then
		startPos = startPos + resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, turb)
	end

	-- Sag droop axis: frame down in the DisplacementMode frame (world down when
	-- Global). Re-resolved every roll so rotating sources carry their arch.
	pData._sagDirWorld = resolveDispFrame(pData, startCF, Vector3.yAxis)

	local endPos
	if pData._endpointMode == "Point" then
		local target = pData._target
		if target and target.Parent then
			endPos = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target).Position
		else
			endPos = pData._lastEndPos or startPos
		end
		local dvec = endPos - startPos
		if dvec.Magnitude > 1e-4 then pData._lastDirWorld = dvec.Unit end
	elseif pData._endpointMode == "Seek" then
		-- Scan on first resolve; re-scan every roll when Retarget (the flicker).
		-- An in-flight glide finishes before the next re-scan, so the zap drags
		-- A → B → C instead of wandering between switching goals.
		local glideBusy = not Endpoints.glideArrived(pData)
		if (pData._seekRetarget and not glideBusy) or (not pData._seekHit and not pData._seekFallbackDir) then
			seekScan(pData, startPos)
		end
		local goal
		if pData._seekHit then
			goal = pData._seekHit.Position
		else
			goal = startPos + pData._seekFallbackDir * ((pData._seekRadius or 30) * 0.5)
		end
		-- RetargetSpeed > 0: the strike point GLIDES toward the goal (advanced per
		-- frame by UpdateLightning's glide block — the continuous destructive zap);
		-- 0 = instant snap. First acquisition always snaps so a newborn bolt
		-- appears already struck.
		pData._seekGoalPos = goal
		if (pData._retargetSpeed or 0) <= 0 or not pData._seekCurrentPos then
			pData._seekCurrentPos = goal
		end
		endPos = pData._seekCurrentPos
		local dvec = endPos - startPos
		if dvec.Magnitude > 1e-4 then pData._lastDirWorld = dvec.Unit end
	else
		local dirVec
		if pData._shapeDirLocal then
			dirVec = dirFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(pData._shapeDirLocal)
		elseif pData._dirGlobal then
			dirVec = pData._dirLocalVec
		else
			dirVec = startCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(pData._dirLocalVec)
		end
		-- Cached for UpdateLightning's Speed-along-direction origin motion.
		pData._lastDirWorld = dirVec
		endPos = startPos + dirVec * pData._length
	end
	pData._lastStartPos = startPos
	pData._lastEndPos = endPos
	return startCF, startPos, endPos
end

return Endpoints

--[[
	Lightning/ImpactDisk  -  the flat disk at a bolt's strike point: a thin cylinder whose axis
	follows the surface normal, optionally textured (Decal on the outward face). It exists only
	while the strike ray hits a surface; a bolt that ends in the air shows no disk.

	Colour always follows the bolt tip: Color graph x Gradient at the far end of the arc.
	DiskMode "Follow": size = DiskSize x thickness ratio x (1 - bolt transparency); transparency
	and brightness come from the bolt graphs. "Manual": DiskSize / DiskTransparency /
	DiskBrightness graphs drive the disk directly.
	Reads pData._curThick / _curTrans / _curBright written by Lightning/init.luau writeVisuals.

	Normal: Seek bolts use the scan hit; Point / Directional cast one ray along the bolt from
	its origin and re-cast only after the strike point moved RAY_REFRESH_DIST (never per frame).
	Lifetime: pData._impactDisk is destroyed by LifecycleRelease._releaseVisual and by
	cancelAnimation; it lives beside the bolt Model (never inside a pooled Model).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Events)

local ImpactDisk = {}

local DISK_THICKNESS = 0.05
local RAY_REFRESH_DIST = 0.5
local RAY_OVERSHOOT = 1.05
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

-- Raycast params for the strike ray (Seek bolts reuse their own seek params).
local function buildRayFn(particle, pData)
	local params = EventsMod.makeHitParams(pData)
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	pcall(function()
		params:AddToFilter(particle:GetFolder())
		params:AddToFilter(particle:GetPoolFolder())
	end)
	pData._diskRayFn = function(origin, disp)
		return workspace:Raycast(origin, disp, params)
	end
end

-- Surface normal + disk position for the current endpoints; nil when the bolt hits nothing.
local function resolveSurface(pData, startPos, endPos)
	if pData._endpointMode == "Seek" then
		local hit = pData._seekHit
		if hit then return hit.Normal, endPos end
		return nil
	end
	local last = pData._diskRayPos
	if last and (endPos - last).Magnitude < RAY_REFRESH_DIST then
		return pData._diskNormal, pData._diskHitPos
	end
	pData._diskRayPos = endPos
	local span = endPos - startPos
	local rayFn = pData._seekRayFn or pData._diskRayFn
	local hit = rayFn and span.Magnitude > 1e-4 and rayFn(startPos, span * RAY_OVERSHOOT) or nil
	pData._diskNormal = hit and hit.Normal or nil
	pData._diskHitPos = hit and hit.Position or nil
	return pData._diskNormal, pData._diskHitPos
end

-- The visible surface: the decal on textured disks, the cylinder otherwise.
local function surfaceOf(pData)
	return pData._impactDecal or pData._impactDisk
end

-- Cylinder axis is +X: yaw lookAt's -Z onto the normal so the caps face along it.
function ImpactDisk.place(pData, startPos, endPos)
	local disk = pData._impactDisk
	if not disk or not startPos or not endPos then return end
	local normal, position = resolveSurface(pData, startPos, endPos)
	if not normal then
		if not pData._diskHidden then
			pData._diskHidden = true
			surfaceOf(pData).Transparency = 1
		end
		return
	end
	local lifted = position + normal * (pData._diskOffset or DISK_THICKNESS)
	disk.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(lifted, lifted + normal) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0)
	if pData._diskHidden then
		pData._diskHidden = false
		ImpactDisk.write(pData, pData._diskLastT or 0)
	end
end

-- Graph writes at normalized life t (called from the bolt's stepped writeVisuals).
function ImpactDisk.write(pData, t)
	local disk = pData._impactDisk
	if not disk then return end
	pData._diskLastT = t
	if pData._diskHidden then return end
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local size = graphs.DiskSize and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.DiskSize, seeds.DiskSize) or 2
	local trans, bright
	if pData._diskMode == "Manual" then
		trans = graphs.DiskTransparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.DiskTransparency, seeds.DiskTransparency) or 0
		bright = graphs.DiskBrightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.DiskBrightness, seeds.DiskBrightness) or 1
	else
		trans = pData._curTrans or 0
		bright = pData._curBright or 1
		local thick0 = pData._diskThick0 or 0
		local thickRatio = thick0 > 1e-4 and (pData._curThick or thick0) / thick0 or 1
		size = size * thickRatio * math.clamp(1 - trans, 0, 1)
	end
	disk.Size = Vector3.new(DISK_THICKNESS, math.max(0.05, size), math.max(0.05, size))

	local base = graphs.Color and GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.Color) or pData._diskBaseColor or WHITE
	local tip = pData._diskTipTint
	local r, g, b = base.R * bright, base.G * bright, base.B * bright
	if tip then r, g, b = r * tip.R, g * tip.G, b * tip.B end
	local color = Color3.new(math.min(r, 1), math.min(g, 1), math.min(b, 1))
	local decal = pData._impactDecal
	if decal then
		decal.Transparency = trans
		decal.Color3 = color
	else
		disk.Transparency = trans
		disk.Color = color
	end
end

-- Create the disk for a bolt whose endpoints have already been rolled once (applyRoll at emit).
function ImpactDisk.attach(particle, pData, data)
	if not data.DiskEnabled or pData._impactDisk then return end
	local model = pData.VisualPart
	if not model or not model.Parent then return end
	local disk = Instance.new("Part")
	disk.Name = "ImpactDisk"
	disk.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	disk.Anchored = true
	disk.CanCollide = false
	disk.CanQuery = false
	disk.CanTouch = false
	disk.Massless = true
	disk.CastShadow = false
	disk.Locked = true
	disk.Archivable = false
	disk.Size = Vector3.new(DISK_THICKNESS, 1, 1)
	local baseColor = WHITE
	pcall(function()
		disk.Material = data.RenderTemplate.Material
		baseColor = data.RenderTemplate.Color
	end)
	local texture = data.DiskTexture
	if type(texture) == "string" and texture ~= "" then
		local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
		decal.Name = "Face"
		decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Right
		decal.Texture = texture
		decal.Parent = disk
		-- Textured disks show only the decal; the backing cylinder stays invisible.
		disk.Transparency = 1
		pData._impactDecal = decal
	end
	pData._impactDisk = disk
	pData._diskMode = data.DiskMode or "Follow"
	pData._diskOffset = data.DiskOffset or DISK_THICKNESS
	pData._diskThick0 = pData._curThick or 0.15
	pData._diskBaseColor = baseColor
	local gradient = pData.Graphs.Gradient
	pData._diskTipTint = gradient and GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(1, gradient) or nil
	pData._diskHidden = false
	pData._diskLastT = 0
	pData._diskRayPos = nil
	pData._diskNormal = nil
	pData._diskHitPos = nil
	pData.Graphs.DiskSize = data.DiskSize
	pData.Graphs.DiskTransparency = data.DiskTransparency
	pData.Graphs.DiskBrightness = data.DiskBrightness
	pData.Seeds.DiskSize = data.DiskSize and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.DiskSize) or {}
	pData.Seeds.DiskTransparency = data.DiskTransparency and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.DiskTransparency) or {}
	pData.Seeds.DiskBrightness = data.DiskBrightness and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.DiskBrightness) or {}
	if pData._endpointMode ~= "Seek" then buildRayFn(particle, pData) end
	disk.Parent = model.Parent
	ImpactDisk.place(pData, pData._lastStartPos, pData._lastEndPos)
	ImpactDisk.write(pData, 0)
end

function ImpactDisk.detach(pData)
	local disk = pData._impactDisk
	if disk then pcall(function() disk:Destroy() end) end
	pData._impactDisk = nil
	pData._impactDecal = nil
	pData._diskRayFn = nil
	pData._diskTipTint = nil
end

-- AnimateLoop cycle refresh: rebuild against the fresh data (DiskEnabled / DiskMode may have flipped).
function ImpactDisk.refresh(particle, pData, freshData)
	ImpactDisk.detach(pData)
	ImpactDisk.attach(particle, pData, freshData)
end

return ImpactDisk

--[[
	Lightning/PDataBuilder  -  per-bolt pData construction shared by Emit + Animate.
	Split from Lightning/init (500-line cap). Rolls every per-bolt range, composes
	the launch frame (RotXYZ + DirMode + Spread), samples spawn Pos/Shape, and seeds
	the origin-motion state. emitCtx carries per-burst EmitIndex/EvenOffset fields
	for even-distribution sampling.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.AxisLinks)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local TurbulenceMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Turbulence)
local EndpointsMod = require(script.Parent.Endpoints)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

local PDataBuilder = {}

-- Flat-zero sequences (the writeDefaults stamp) count as "no graph" so idle
-- emitters skip the per-frame motion accumulation entirely.
function PDataBuilder.liveGraph(seq)
	if not seq then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 0 then return nil end
	return seq
end

-- Static-white ColorSequence (the writeDefaults stamp) counts as "no gradient"
-- so default bolts keep the single-color fast path.
function PDataBuilder.liveColor(seq)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "ColorSequence" then return nil end
	local kp = seq.Keypoints
	if #kp <= 1 then
		local c = kp[1] and kp[1].Value
		if not c or (c.R > 0.999 and c.G > 0.999 and c.B > 0.999) then return nil end
	end
	return seq
end

-- Flat-one Taper profile (the writeDefaults stamp) counts as "no taper" so the
-- per-roll width pass is skipped.
function PDataBuilder.liveProfile(seq)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 1 then return nil end
	return seq
end

function PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx)
	-- Normalize motion graphs BEFORE seeding/aliasing so downstream flags see nil.
	data.ThicknessProfile = PDataBuilder.liveProfile(data.ThicknessProfile)
	data.Speed = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.Speed)
	data.PosOffsetX = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.PosOffsetX)
	data.PosOffsetY = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.PosOffsetY)
	data.PosOffsetZ = PDataBuilder.liveGraph(data.PosOffsetZ)
	data.Turbulence = TurbulenceMod.isLive(data.Turbulence)
	local seeds = {
		Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Thickness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Thickness),
		ThicknessProfile = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.ThicknessProfile),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX),
		PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY),
		PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Turbulence = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Turbulence),
	}
	-- Linked graph axes (PosOffset) adopt the primary's graph + seed.
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)
	local accel = data.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
	local growthSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.GrowthSpeed)
	local pData = {
		Type = "Lightning",
		VisualPart = model,
		_rig = rig,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		_sourceItem = item,

		Graphs = {
			Color = data.Color,
			Gradient = PDataBuilder.liveColor(data.Gradient),
			Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Thickness = data.Thickness,
			ThicknessProfile = data.ThicknessProfile,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
			Speed = data.Speed,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX,
			PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY,
			PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Turbulence = data.Turbulence,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),

		_endpointMode = data.TargetMode == "Seek" and "Seek"
			or ((data.TargetMode == "Point" and data.Target and data.Target.Parent) and "Point" or "Directional"),
		_target = data.Target,
		-- The authored Link (Link section). A top-level bolt's origin rides it by LinkMode; a
		-- nested bolt rides its parent clone instead (Endpoints.resolveEndpoints).
		_userLink = data.Link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		LinkAxes = data.LinkAxes,
		_seekRadius = math.max(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SeekRadius), 1),
		_seekRetarget = data.SeekRetarget == true,
		_seekBias = math.clamp(data.SeekBias or 0, 0, 1),
		_retargetSpeed = math.max(data.RetargetSpeed or 0, 0),
		-- Seek fires OnHit from its own scan (fireSeekHit); the generic
		-- Events.afterUpdate raycast + Collision actions must skip this pData.
		_ownsOnHit = true,
		_length = math.max(0.1, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Length)),
		-- Bolt-shape ranges roll ONCE per bolt (variety across a burst; stable within a bolt).
		_segCount = math.clamp(math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SegmentCount) + 0.5), 2, rig.mainSegs),
		_amplitude = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Amplitude),
		_decay = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.AmplitudeDecay),
		_forkChance = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ForkChance),
		_forkDepth = math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ForkDepth) + 0.5),
		_forkLenScale = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ForkLengthScale),
		_sag = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Sag),
		_sagShape = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SagShape),
		_shapeMode = data.ShapeMode or "Jitter",
		_scrollSpeed = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.ScrollSpeed),
		_waves = math.max(0.25, RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Waves)),
		_scrollPhase = 0,
		_noiseSeedA = math.random() * 1000,
		_noiseSeedB = 500 + math.random() * 1000,
		_jitterAccum = 0,
		_lSpeed = growthSpeed,
		_growReversed = growthSpeed < 0,
		_tipDist = 0,
		_revealPtr = 0,
		_nestedAlive = { true },

		-- Origin motion (Speed along launch dir + Acceleration + Drag) and PosOffset
		-- displacement graphs. Accumulated per frame in UpdateLightning; applied to
		-- the origin by resolveEndpoints each roll.
		_accel = accel,
		_drag = data.Drag or 0,
		_dispMode = data.DisplacementMode or "Global",
		_motionOffset = Vector3.zero,
		_motionAccelVel = Vector3.zero,
		_hasMotion = data.Speed ~= nil or accel.Magnitude > 0,
		_hasDisp = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,
		-- Origin turbulence: sampled per frame into _turbRaw by UpdateLightning,
		-- applied by resolveEndpoints in the _dispMode frame.
		_hasTurb = data.Turbulence ~= nil,
		_turbFreq = data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1,
		_turbSeed = math.random() * 997 + 0.5,
		_turbRaw = nil,
	}
	local jitterHz = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.JitterRate)
	pData._jitterInterval = jitterHz > 0 and 1 / jitterHz or math.huge

	-- Directional launch axis in SOURCE-local space: EmissionDirection rotated by
	-- RotXYZ (even-distribution aware) ± SpreadAngle. Spawn Pos offsets the origin
	-- in the origin frame (PosMode Global = world axes); applied live per roll by
	-- resolveEndpoints so moving sources/links carry the pattern.
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local localAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	local spread = data.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX or 0, rotS.RotY or 0, rotS.RotZ or 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, localAxis)
	-- Direction picks up RotXYZ only in DirMode=Local. RigidLocal (default) keeps the
	-- authored facing so Rot drives the Pos frame alone  -  rings keep their direction.
	if data.DirMode == "Local" then cf = cf * rotXYZ end
	if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
		cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
	end
	pData._dirLocalVec = cf.LookVector
	pData._dirGlobal = data.DirMode == "Global"
	-- Rotation applies BEFORE position offsets (Part-emitter order): Local Pos +
	-- displacement frames live in the per-bolt ROTATED frame (rings/spirals).
	pData._originRot = rotXYZ
	local posS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local px, py, pz = posS.PosX or 0, posS.PosY or 0, posS.PosZ or 0
	if px ~= 0 or py ~= 0 or pz ~= 0 then
		pData._originOffset = Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
		pData._originOffsetGlobal = data.PosMode == "Global"
	else
		pData._originOffset = nil
	end
	EndpointsMod.sampleShape(pData, data, item)
	return pData
end

return PDataBuilder

--[[
	Lightning/Rig  -  bolt Model + rig-buffer construction and pool acquire.
	Split from Lightning/init (500-line cap). Owns the weak-keyed Rigs map so
	buffers survive pool release/acquire cycles and gc with the model.
]]

local Pool = require(script.Parent.Parent.Pool)
local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local BoltGen = require(script.Parent.BoltGen)

local MAX_BOLT_PARTS = 64
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)

local Rig = {}

Rig.MAX_BOLT_PARTS = MAX_BOLT_PARTS
Rig.FAR_CFRAME = FAR_CFRAME

-- Weak-keyed by bolt Model.
Rig.Rigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- One segment part cloned from the RT. copyBare strips Transformed children (nested
-- source Part-Icles fire once per BOLT via NestedEmit.walk, never per segment).
-- Returns the first Decal/Texture child too: Transform hides RT decals (Transparency=1),
-- so writeVisuals must drive them alongside the part.
local function buildSegment(rt)
	local seg = Pool.copyBare(rt)
	seg.Anchored = true
	seg.CanCollide = false
	seg.CanQuery = false
	seg.CanTouch = false
	seg.Massless = true
	seg.Locked = true
	seg.Archivable = false
	seg.Transparency = 0
	local decal = seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture")
	return seg, decal
end

-- Rig layout sizes for the range MAXIMUMS; each bolt rolls its own values within
-- them and parks unused slots at FAR_CFRAME.
function Rig.layoutFor(data)
	return BoltGen.layout(data.SegmentCount.Max, data.ForkDepth.Max, data.ForkChance.Max, MAX_BOLT_PARTS)
end

-- Fresh bolt Model + rig with every buffer pre-sized. Called on pool miss or when
-- the defensive rig check fails on a pool hit.
function Rig.buildRig(data)
	local partCount, mainSegs, forkSegs, forkSlots = Rig.layoutFor(data)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "LightningBolt"
	model.Archivable = false
	-- Consumed by EmitPointLight: nested lights fan out per segment on bolt Models.
	model:SetAttribute("_lightningBolt", true)
	local rig = {
		partCount = partCount, mainSegs = mainSegs,
		forkSegs = forkSegs, forkSlots = forkSlots,
		parts = table.create(partCount),
		rollCFs = table.create(partCount),
		writeCFs = table.create(partCount),
		segLen = table.create(partCount),
		revealDist = table.create(partCount),
		revealOrder = table.create(partCount),
		widthScale = table.create(partCount),
		decals = table.create(partCount),
		slotDepth = table.create(math.max(forkSlots, 1)),
		ptBuf = table.create(mainSegs + 1),
		basePtBuf = table.create(mainSegs + 1),
		forkPtBuf = table.create(forkSegs + 1),
		forkAnchorPos = {}, forkAnchorDir = {}, forkAnchorReveal = {},
		forkAnchorSlot = {}, forkAnchorPtIdx = {},
		-- Per-slot fork retention for scroll-mode re-anchoring (BoltGen.applyScrollForks).
		forkOriginIdx = {}, forkParentSlot = {}, forkParentPtIdx = {},
		forkLen = {}, forkU = {}, forkV = {}, forkSeedU = {}, forkSeedV = {},
		-- Taper bookkeeping (Rig.applyTaper): where each fork leaves its parent's arc.
		forkStartReveal = {}, forkStartFrac = {},
		forkLocalPts = {}, forkWorldPts = {},
		-- Skip-write caches (BoltGen.diffLive / planSizes).
		prevLive = table.create(partCount),
		lastWrittenLen = table.create(partCount),
		sizeWriteIdx = table.create(partCount),
		newlyLiveIdx = table.create(partCount),
		-- Per-part spatial Gradient sample, recomputed each roll (arc positions move).
		gradColor = table.create(partCount),
		-- Per-part Taper multiplier on Thickness, recomputed each roll.
		taper = table.create(partCount),
	}
	for slot = 1, forkSlots do
		rig.forkLocalPts[slot] = table.create(forkSegs + 1)
		rig.forkWorldPts[slot] = table.create(forkSegs + 1)
		rig.forkOriginIdx[slot] = 0
		rig.forkParentSlot[slot] = 0
	end
	-- Slot depth is fixed at build: first half depth 1, remainder depth 2. Width per
	-- part is a build-time constant (main = 1, forks scale by ForkLengthScale^depth).
	local depth1Slots = forkSlots > 0 and math.max(1, math.ceil(forkSlots / 2)) or 0
	for slot = 1, forkSlots do
		rig.slotDepth[slot] = slot <= depth1Slots and 1 or 2
	end
	-- Fork WIDTH decouples from ForkLengthScale with a floor: at small length scales
	-- length-coupled widths shrink forks to invisible hairlines (0.4² x 0.15-stud
	-- thickness = 0.024 studs).
	local lenScale = math.max(0.45, data.ForkLengthScale and data.ForkLengthScale.Max or 0.4)
	for i = 1, partCount do
		local seg, decal = buildSegment(data.RenderTemplate)
		seg.Name = "Seg" .. i
		seg.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
		seg.Parent = model
		rig.parts[i] = seg
		rig.decals[i] = decal
		rig.rollCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
		rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
		rig.segLen[i] = 0.05
		rig.revealDist[i] = math.huge
		rig.revealOrder[i] = i
		rig.prevLive[i] = false
		-- Sentinel: first planSizes write is unconditional per part.
		rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = -1
		rig.taper[i] = 1
		if i <= mainSegs then
			rig.widthScale[i] = 1
		else
			local slot = math.floor((i - mainSegs - 1) / forkSegs) + 1
			rig.widthScale[i] = lenScale ^ (rig.slotDepth[slot] or 1)
		end
	end
	Rig.Rigs[model] = rig
	return model, rig
end

-- Per-part width multiplier from the Taper profile (arc 0 = source, 1 = tip). Main parts read
-- their arc fraction of the main polyline; fork parts continue the parent's fraction at the
-- branch point to 1 over the fork's own length. A changed multiplier stamps the planSizes
-- force sentinel so the next flush resizes that part. No profile = every multiplier 1.
function Rig.applyTaper(rig, profile, seed, mainLen)
	local invMain = 1 / math.max(mainLen or 0, 1e-4)
	for i = 1, rig.partCount do
		local revealDist = rig.revealDist[i]
		local value = 1
		if profile and revealDist ~= math.huge then
			local frac
			if i <= rig.mainSegs then
				frac = (revealDist + rig.segLen[i] * 0.5) * invMain
			else
				local slot = math.floor((i - rig.mainSegs - 1) / rig.forkSegs) + 1
				local startFrac = rig.forkStartFrac[slot] or 0
				local along = revealDist - (rig.forkStartReveal[slot] or 0) + rig.segLen[i] * 0.5
				local localFrac = math.clamp(along / math.max(rig.forkLen[slot] or 1, 1e-4), 0, 1)
				frac = startFrac + localFrac * (1 - startFrac)
			end
			value = math.max(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(math.clamp(frac, 0, 1), profile, seed), 0)
		end
		if value ~= rig.taper[i] then
			rig.taper[i] = value
			rig.lastWrittenLen[i] = -1
		end
	end
end

-- Rebuild the GrowthSpeed reveal mask against the current _tipDist over the freshly
-- sorted reveal order. reversed = negative GrowthSpeed: the strike travels from the
-- far end back toward the source (a segment shows once its far-end distance from
-- maxReveal falls within tipDist). Returns the new reveal pointer.
local function rebuildRevealMask(rig, tipDist, reversed)
	local ptr = 0
	local maxReveal = rig.maxReveal or 0
	for k = 1, rig.partCount do
		local idx = rig.revealOrder[k]
		local rd = rig.revealDist[idx]
		local visible
		if reversed then
			visible = rd ~= math.huge and (rd + rig.segLen[idx]) >= (maxReveal - tipDist)
		else
			visible = rd <= tipDist
		end
		if visible then
			rig.writeCFs[idx] = rig.rollCFs[idx]
			ptr = k
		else
			rig.writeCFs[idx] = FAR_CFRAME
		end
	end
	return ptr
end

-- Shared CFrame flush: reveal mask (GrowthSpeed) + batch write. atEmit runs before
-- the model is parented, so it writes CFrames directly (BulkMoveTo requires
-- workspace ancestry).
function Rig.flushCFrames(pData, atEmit)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local useReveal = pData._lSpeed ~= 0
	if useReveal then
		pData._revealPtr = rebuildRevealMask(rig, pData._tipDist or 0, pData._growReversed)
	end
	local cfs = useReveal and rig.writeCFs or rig.rollCFs
	if atEmit then
		for i = 1, rig.partCount do rig.parts[i].CFrame = cfs[i] end
	else
		workspace:BulkMoveTo(rig.parts, cfs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	end
end

-- Pool acquire with defensive rig re-check: a foreign / externally-mutilated model
-- or a layout change that slipped past the _PoolGen flush rebuilds fresh.
function Rig.acquireBolt(data)
	local expected = Rig.layoutFor(data)
	if data.Pool ~= false then
		local model = Pool.acquire(data.RenderTemplate, "Lightning")
		if model then
			local rig = Rig.Rigs[model]
			if rig and rig.partCount == expected and rig.parts[1] and rig.parts[1].Parent == model then
				model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
				return model, rig
			end
			pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
	local model, rig = Rig.buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return model, rig
end

return Rig

--[[
	LinkCF  -  the one place LinkMode semantics are applied.
	Modes (read in GetData.luau): Follow / Pivot inherit the link POSITION only; Weld /
	WeldWithoutRotation inherit the full frame; RigidLocal inherits the frame snapshotted at emit
	(pData._rigidLocalParentCF) and ignores live link motion. Follow and Pivot differ only at spawn:
	Follow drops the link rotation, Pivot composes it (spawnFrame).
	Every emit / update / replay / bounce / preview site composes through these helpers; no other
	file branches on the mode strings (LinkService keeps its own reduced Weld/Follow set).
	Per-axis inheritance (item attrs LinkPosX..Z / LinkRotX..Z, absent = on): a masked axis never takes
	the link's value. For a user link it keeps the emitter's own position / rotation from spawn onward; a
	nested link masks against the link frame captured at emit. Rotation splits on a fixed YXZ order.
]]

local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)

local LinkCF = {}

-- Link frame with the nested parent-node offset applied (NestedEmit sets pData/emitCtx._linkLocal).
local function linkFrame(link, linkLocal)
	local cf = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	if linkLocal then return cf * linkLocal end
	return cf
end

local LINK_AXIS_ATTRS = { "LinkPosX", "LinkPosY", "LinkPosZ", "LinkRotX", "LinkRotY", "LinkRotZ" }

-- Per-axis masks from the item; nil when every axis inherits (the common case, no per-frame cost).
function LinkCF.readAxes(item)
	local axes = nil
	for _, name in ipairs(LINK_AXIS_ATTRS) do
		local on = item:GetAttribute(name) ~= false
		if not on then axes = axes or {} end
		if axes then axes[name] = on end
	end
	if axes then
		for _, name in ipairs(LINK_AXIS_ATTRS) do
			if axes[name] == nil then axes[name] = true end
		end
	end
	return axes
end

-- Masked axes take the reference frame; enabled axes follow the live link.
local function maskFrame(liveCF, refCF, axes)
	local livePos, emitPos = liveCF.Position, refCF.Position
	local pos = Vector3.new(
		axes.LinkPosX and livePos.X or emitPos.X,
		axes.LinkPosY and livePos.Y or emitPos.Y,
		axes.LinkPosZ and livePos.Z or emitPos.Z)
	local rot = liveCF.Rotation
	if not (axes.LinkRotX and axes.LinkRotY and axes.LinkRotZ) then
		local lx, ly, lz = liveCF:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		local ex, ey, ez = refCF:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		rot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(axes.LinkRotX and lx or ex, axes.LinkRotY and ly or ey, axes.LinkRotZ and lz or ez)
	end
	return CFrame.new(pos) * rot
end

-- Reference frame for masked axes: the emitter's own frame for a user link, the link frame at emit
-- for a nested link (the source template's frame means nothing at the clone).
local function maskReference(pData, linkCF)
	local source = pData._sourceItem
	if pData._nestedDriven or not source or not source.Parent then return linkCF end
	return Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(source)
end

-- Emit-time reference for masked particles (RegisterEmit, after _nestedDriven). worldFrame captures lazily on replay.
function LinkCF.captureEmitFrame(pData)
	if pData.LinkAxes and pData.Link then
		pData._linkMaskRefCF = maskReference(pData, linkFrame(pData.Link, pData._linkLocal))
	end
end

-- Masks for the spawn-time helpers: user links only (nested links mask per frame against their emit frame).
function LinkCF.spawnAxes(data, emitCtx)
	if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil then return nil end
	return data.LinkAxes
end

-- Link frame with the spawn masks applied against the emitter's own frame.
local function maskedLinkFrame(link, linkLocal, axes, refCF)
	local frame = linkFrame(link, linkLocal)
	if axes and refCF then return maskFrame(frame, refCF, axes) end
	return frame
end

-- Follow / Pivot inherit position only; the Weld family inherits the full frame.
function LinkCF.positionOnly(mode)
	return mode == "Follow" or mode == "Pivot"
end

-- Motion is expressed in link space (VectorToObjectSpace) for the Weld family only.
function LinkCF.usesLinkSpace(mode, link)
	return (mode == "Weld" or mode == "WeldWithoutRotation" or mode == "RigidLocal") and link ~= nil
end

-- Reduce a link frame to what the mode inherits.
function LinkCF.applyPositionRule(mode, frame)
	if LinkCF.positionOnly(mode) then return CFrame.new(frame.Position) end
	return frame
end

-- Spawn frame under a link: Follow keeps the emitter's own rotation; a self-link IS the emitter
-- frame (composing both would apply its rotation twice); otherwise link rotation composes with the
-- emitter's rotation RELATIVE to its source parent (sourceParentCF, nested) or its world rotation.
-- Mirrored by MotionPreview so the preview matches the live spawn.
function LinkCF.spawnFrame(mode, link, emitter, sourceCF, linkLocal, sourceParentCF, axes)
	local linkCF = linkFrame(link, linkLocal)
	local frame
	if mode == "Follow" then
		frame = CFrame.new(linkCF.Position) * sourceCF.Rotation
	elseif link == emitter then
		frame = sourceCF
	else
		local relRot = sourceParentCF and (sourceParentCF.Rotation:Inverse() * sourceCF.Rotation) or sourceCF.Rotation
		frame = CFrame.new(linkCF.Position) * linkCF.Rotation * relRot
	end
	-- Masked axes spawn at the emitter's own pose (spawnAxes is nil for nested links).
	if axes then return maskFrame(frame, sourceCF, axes) end
	return frame
end

-- Origin frame for an emitter whose START rides a user link and is re-read through its life
-- (Lightning/Endpoints, every roll). Follow takes the link's position and keeps the emitter's own
-- rotation; Weld adds the link's rotation; Pivot takes that rotation once, at the first read;
-- RigidLocal stays where the link was at the first read. WeldWithoutRotation has no offset to
-- rotate here and reads as Follow. A link that is gone holds the last frame (nil if never read).
function LinkCF.originFrame(pData, link, emitter, sourceCF)
	local mode = pData.LinkMode
	if mode == "WeldWithoutRotation" then mode = "Follow" end
	if mode == "RigidLocal" and pData._originLinkCF then return pData._originLinkCF end
	if not link or link.Parent == nil then return pData._originLinkCF end
	local frame
	if mode == "Pivot" and pData._originPivotRot then
		local followed = LinkCF.spawnFrame("Follow", link, emitter, sourceCF, nil, nil, pData.LinkAxes)
		frame = CFrame.new(followed.Position) * pData._originPivotRot
	else
		frame = LinkCF.spawnFrame(mode, link, emitter, sourceCF, nil, nil, pData.LinkAxes)
		if mode == "Pivot" then pData._originPivotRot = frame.Rotation end
	end
	pData._originLinkCF = frame
	return frame
end

-- Parent frame from a LIVE link at emit time (no snapshot exists yet). Identity without a link.
function LinkCF.emitParentFrame(mode, link, linkLocal, axes, refCF)
	if not link then return CFrame.new() end
	return LinkCF.applyPositionRule(mode, maskedLinkFrame(link, linkLocal, axes, refCF))
end

-- Attachment visuals compose in their parent's space: a BasePart's CFrame, or an Attachment's
-- WorldCFrame (Animate visuals live under the source Attachment). Anything else is world space.
function LinkCF.toParentSpace(worldCF, visualParent)
	local convCF = CFrame.new()
	if visualParent then
		if visualParent:IsA("BasePart") then
			convCF = visualParent.CFrame
		elseif visualParent:IsA("Attachment") then
			convCF = visualParent.WorldCFrame
		end
	end
	return convCF:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
end

-- Attachment variant of emitParentFrame, in `visualParent`-local space.
function LinkCF.emitAttachmentParentFrame(mode, link, visualParent, linkLocal, axes, refCF)
	if not link then return CFrame.new() end
	return LinkCF.applyPositionRule(mode, LinkCF.toParentSpace(maskedLinkFrame(link, linkLocal, axes, refCF), visualParent))
end

-- RigidLocal snapshot taken at emit: the frame the particle stays welded to. nil for other modes.
function LinkCF.rigidSnapshot(mode, link, frame)
	if mode == "RigidLocal" and link then return frame end
	return nil
end

-- Attachment snapshots keep the WORLD link frame; per-frame readers convert to parent space.
function LinkCF.rigidWorldSnapshot(mode, link, linkLocal, axes, refCF)
	if mode == "RigidLocal" and link then return maskedLinkFrame(link, linkLocal, axes, refCF) end
	return nil
end

-- A link is live while it is parented and the pool has not recycled it since this particle
-- captured it (pData._linkGen, stamped by RegisterEmit).
function LinkCF.isValid(pData, link)
	if not link or link.Parent == nil then return false end
	return Pool.linkGen(link) == (pData._linkGen or 0)
end

-- Link lost: keep the last good frame so the particle carries on from where its parent died
-- instead of collapsing onto the world origin. Readers see the frozen frame through parentFrame.
function LinkCF.freeze(pData)
	pData._frozenLinkCF = pData._lastLinkCF or CFrame.new()
	pData.Link = nil
end

-- World frame of the link as this particle sees it: the emit snapshot for RigidLocal (never
-- freezes), the live link otherwise. Records the frame so freeze() can keep it.
function LinkCF.worldFrame(pData, link)
	if pData.LinkMode == "RigidLocal" then
		return pData._rigidLocalParentCF or CFrame.new()
	end
	local cf = linkFrame(link, pData._linkLocal)
	local axes = pData.LinkAxes
	if axes then
		if not pData._linkMaskRefCF then pData._linkMaskRefCF = maskReference(pData, cf) end
		cf = maskFrame(cf, pData._linkMaskRefCF, axes)
	end
	pData._lastLinkCF = cf
	return cf
end

-- Live, frozen or snapshot frame for the per-frame readers; nil when the particle never had a link.
local function currentFrame(pData)
	if pData.LinkMode == "RigidLocal" then return pData._rigidLocalParentCF end
	local link = pData.Link
	if link then
		if LinkCF.isValid(pData, link) then return LinkCF.worldFrame(pData, link) end
		LinkCF.freeze(pData)
	end
	return pData._frozenLinkCF
end

-- Per-frame parent frame for Part / Model. Returns (parentCF, useVOS); identity when there never was a link.
function LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
	local worldCF = currentFrame(pData)
	if not worldCF then return CFrame.new(), false end
	if LinkCF.positionOnly(pData.LinkMode) then return CFrame.new(worldCF.Position), false end
	return worldCF, true
end

-- Per-frame parent frame for Attachment, in visual-parent-local space. Returns (parentCF, useVOS, hasLink).
function LinkCF.attachmentParentFrame(pData)
	local worldCF = currentFrame(pData)
	if not worldCF then return CFrame.new(), false, false end
	local visualParent = pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent
	if not visualParent then return CFrame.new(), false, false end
	local linkLocalCF = LinkCF.toParentSpace(worldCF, visualParent)
	if LinkCF.positionOnly(pData.LinkMode) then return CFrame.new(linkLocalCF.Position), false, true end
	return linkLocalCF, true, true
end

-- LinkTrack reapply for Part / Model: WeldWithoutRotation rotates only the offset and keeps the
-- particle's own rotation; Follow / Pivot translate; Weld composes fully. Attachments have no
-- WeldWithoutRotation variant (LinkTrack applies applyPositionRule to them).
function LinkCF.reapplyFrame(mode, linkCF, localCF)
	if mode == "WeldWithoutRotation" then
		local worldOffset = linkCF:VectorToWorldSpace(localCF.Position)
		local rotOnly = localCF - localCF.Position
		return CFrame.new(linkCF.Position + worldOffset) * rotOnly
	end
	if LinkCF.positionOnly(mode) then return CFrame.new(linkCF.Position) * localCF end
	return linkCF * localCF
end

return LinkCF

--[[
	LinkService  -  standalone CFrame-tracking service.
	Users link arbitrary BaseParts / Models / Attachments to any target Instance
	(BasePart / Model / Attachment / Bone / Camera) using the same LinkMode dispatch
	as the particle runtime, without spawning particles.

	API:
	  LinkService:Activate()
	  LinkService:Deactivate()
	  LinkService:Link(part1, target, mode, duration)
	  LinkService:Clear(part1)
	  LinkService:IsLinked(part1) -> boolean

	mode: "Weld" | "Follow" | "Pivot" | "WeldWithoutRotation" (unknown -> "Weld")
	duration: optional number of seconds; nil = infinite. Entry auto-clears on expiry,
	          target destruction, or part1 destruction.

	Anchored is snapshotted at :Link time and forced true so Roblox physics does not
	fight per-frame CFrame writes; restored on :Clear / auto-expire.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

-- Resume in PreRender on client (after physics + attachment-transform propagation
-- complete; matches the Lifecycle.luau LOOP_YIELD_EVENT choice). Heartbeat on server
-- since PreRender is client-only.
local TICK_EVENT = RunService:IsClient() and RunService.PreRender or RunService.Heartbeat

local LinkService = {}

LinkService._active = false
LinkService._connection = nil
LinkService._links = {}
LinkService._anchorSnapshot = {}
LinkService._warnedNotActive = false

local VALID_MODES = {
	Weld = true,
	Follow = true,
	Pivot = true,
	WeldWithoutRotation = true,
}

local function _readPart1CF(part1)
	if part1:IsA("Model") then
		local ok, cf = pcall(part1.GetPivot, part1)
		if ok and cf then return cf end
		return CFrame.new()
	end
	if part1:IsA("Attachment") then return part1.WorldCFrame end
	return part1.CFrame
end

local function _classifyPart1(part1)
	if part1:IsA("Model") then return "Model" end
	if part1:IsA("Attachment") then return "Attachment" end
	return "Part"
end

-- Snapshot prior Anchored state + force true. Attachment has no Anchored  -  returns nil.
-- BasePart returns a bool. Model returns a table {[BasePart] = priorAnchored} so non-
-- PrimaryPart members do not free-fall under gravity while PivotTo drives PrimaryPart.
function LinkService:_captureAndAnchor(part1)
	if part1:IsA("BasePart") then
		local prior = part1.Anchored
		part1.Anchored = true
		return prior
	end
	if part1:IsA("Model") then
		local snapshot = {}
		for _, desc in ipairs(part1:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
				snapshot[desc] = desc.Anchored
				desc.Anchored = true
			end
		end
		return snapshot
	end
	return nil
end

function LinkService:_restoreAnchor(part1)
	local prior = self._anchorSnapshot[part1]
	self._anchorSnapshot[part1] = nil
	if prior == nil then return end
	if part1:IsA("BasePart") and part1.Parent then
		part1.Anchored = prior
		return
	end
	if part1:IsA("Model") and type(prior) == "table" then
		for desc, priorAnchored in pairs(prior) do
			if desc.Parent then desc.Anchored = priorAnchored end
		end
	end
end

-- Start the per-frame link-tracking loop. Idempotent.
function LinkService:Activate()
	if self._active then return end
	self._active = true
	self._connection = TICK_EVENT:Connect(function(dt)
		self:_tick(dt)
	end)
end

-- Stop tracking + clear every active link, restoring each part1's prior Anchored state.
function LinkService:Deactivate()
	if not self._active then return end
	self._active = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	for part1 in pairs(self._links) do
		self._links[part1] = nil
		self:_restoreAnchor(part1)
	end
end

-- Pin `part1`'s CFrame to follow `target` every frame using `mode` (Weld / Follow /
-- Pivot / WeldWithoutRotation). `duration` (optional seconds) auto-clears the link
-- when elapsed; nil = persist until Clear. Anchored is snapshotted+forced true so
-- physics does not fight the per-frame CFrame writes; restored on Clear.
function LinkService:Link(part1, target, mode, duration)
	if not part1 or not target then return end
	if part1 == target then return end
	if not (part1:IsA("BasePart") or part1:IsA("Model") or part1:IsA("Attachment")) then return end
	if not part1.Parent or not target.Parent then return end
	if not VALID_MODES[mode] then mode = "Weld" end
	if not self._active and not self._warnedNotActive then
		self._warnedNotActive = true
		Log.warn("[Part-Icles LinkService] Link called before Activate(); the link won't update until you call LinkService:Activate(). This warning fires once.")
	end

	local targetCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target)
	local part1CF = _readPart1CF(part1)

	-- Snapshot Anchored on first Link only; re-Link of same part1 keeps the original
	-- prior-state so a Clear after multiple Links restores the truly-authored value.
	if self._anchorSnapshot[part1] == nil and not self._links[part1] then
		self._anchorSnapshot[part1] = self:_captureAndAnchor(part1)
	else
		-- Re-arm anchor flag in case user toggled it between Link calls.
		self:_captureAndAnchor(part1)
	end

	self._links[part1] = {
		target = target,
		mode = mode,
		offsetCF = targetCF:ToObjectSpace(part1CF),
		rotation = part1CF.Rotation,
		expiresAt = duration and (os.clock() + duration) or nil,
		partKind = _classifyPart1(part1),
	}
end

-- Stop tracking `part1`; restore its prior Anchored state. No-op if not linked.
function LinkService:Clear(part1)
	if not self._links[part1] then return end
	self._links[part1] = nil
	self:_restoreAnchor(part1)
end

-- Returns true when `part1` has an active link entry.
function LinkService:IsLinked(part1)
	return self._links[part1] ~= nil
end

function LinkService:_tick(dt)
	local now = os.clock()
	for part1, entry in pairs(self._links) do
		if not part1.Parent or not entry.target.Parent then
			self:Clear(part1)
		elseif entry.expiresAt and now >= entry.expiresAt then
			self:Clear(part1)
		else
			local targetCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(entry.target)
			local newCF
			if entry.mode == "Weld" then
				newCF = targetCF * entry.offsetCF
			else
				-- Follow / Pivot / WeldWithoutRotation: position tracks the linked offset,
				-- rotation stays at the authored snapshot. WWR's mesh-frame variant from
				-- the particle pipeline doesn't apply outside emit; v1 treats it as Follow.
				newCF = CFrame.new((targetCF * entry.offsetCF).Position) * entry.rotation
			end
			if entry.partKind == "Model" then
				pcall(function() part1:PivotTo(newCF) end)
			elseif entry.partKind == "Attachment" then
				local parent = part1.Parent
				if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then
					part1.CFrame = parent.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
				end
			else
				part1.CFrame = newCF
			end
		end
	end
end

return LinkService

--[[
	LinkTrack Mixin  -  per-frame link transform reapply for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Runs every Heartbeat (outside the step gate) so linked particles track their link every frame.
	`pData._localWorldCF` is the link-relative composed CFrame stashed by UpdatePart/Model/Attachment.
	Attachment composes in actualParent-local space, mirroring getAttachmentLinkCF in Update.luau.
]]

local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame link-CFrame writer. Composes `pData._localWorldCF` against the live link
-- target and writes the result to `pData.VisualPart` so linked particles track their
-- link every Heartbeat. No-op when pData.Link is nil or destroyed.
function Particle:ReapplyLink(pData)
	local link = pData.Link
	if not link then return end
	-- Destroyed or pool-recycled link: freeze the last good frame (LinkCF) so per-step
	-- updates keep composing from where the parent died; nothing to reapply per frame.
	if not LinkCF.isValid(pData, link) then
		LinkCF.freeze(pData)
		return
	end
	local lcf = pData._localWorldCF
	if not lcf then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	if t == "Attachment" then
		local visualParent = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if not visualParent then return end
		-- Attachments compose in their parent's space and have no WeldWithoutRotation variant.
		local linkLocalCF = LinkCF.toParentSpace(LinkCF.worldFrame(pData, link), visualParent)
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = LinkCF.applyPositionRule(pData.LinkMode, linkLocalCF) * lcf
		return
	end

	local newCF = LinkCF.reapplyFrame(pData.LinkMode, LinkCF.worldFrame(pData, link), lcf)

	if t == "Model" then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

--[[
	Log  -  console output gate shared by the plugin and the Part runtime.

	Log.enabled (default true) gates Log.print / Log.warn; error() is never gated.
	Plugin: the Settings panel's "Console Output" toggle sets it (SettingsToggles.luau).
	Standalone module: `require(Part_Icles).Log.enabled = false` silences the runtime.
]]

local Log = {}

Log.enabled = true

function Log.print(...)
	if Log.enabled then print(...) end
end

function Log.warn(...)
	if Log.enabled then warn(...) end
end

return Log

--[[
	MeshFrames  -  mesh sequence playback for Part visuals (a flipbook of MeshParts).

	A MeshFrames Folder under the item holds frames named 1..N: MeshParts, or Parts with a SpecialMesh.
	Each frame carries a mesh id and, optionally, a texture id. The visual steps through them on the
	particle's own clock (pData._effectiveElapsed, so Timescale / Pause / FreezeTime / reverse apply);
	the Size graph keeps driving the visual's size and every frame is fitted into that box.

	Two routes, chosen by the visual:
	  MeshPart          MeshPart:ApplyMesh with the frame instance (the only runtime-legal mesh change).
	                    ApplyMesh copies TextureID with the mesh, so a textured frame wins and an untextured
	                    frame gets the visual's current texture written back after the swap. The frame
	                    instances must exist in the place; the folder under the item guarantees that.
	  Part + SpecialMesh  SpecialMesh.MeshId and the frame's texture are written together: the texture goes
	                    to the RenderTemplate's first Decal / Texture (so a Neon part keeps glowing), else to
	                    SpecialMesh.TextureId. DecalLayers leaves that first decal's flipbook to this module.
	data.MeshFramesTextured (any frame with a texture) tells Emit to skip the legacy texture flipbook.

	Config attributes: MeshFrameMode ("None" / OneShot / Loop / PingPong), MeshFrameFramerate
	(NumberRange), MeshFrameStartRandom, MeshFrameReverse.

	Mutates the clone (Emit) or the LIVE RT (Animate: a backup of the mesh and texture taken at attach,
	restore() puts it back on finish and cancel). refresh() re-reads the settings per AnimateLoop cycle.
	The frame task allocates nothing per tick.
]]

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

local MeshFrames = {}

local MODES = { OneShot = true, Loop = true, PingPong = true }
local preloadedCount = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
local warnedUnsupported = false

-- Shared with the plugin's Mesh Frames panel and inventory insert so all three agree on what a frame is.
local function isFrame(inst)
	return inst:IsA("MeshPart") or (inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh") ~= nil)
end
MeshFrames.isFrame = isFrame

local function firstDecal(part)
	for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then return child end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Mesh id and texture id a frame carries ("" when untextured).
local function frameIds(frame)
	if frame:IsA("MeshPart") then return frame.MeshId, frame.TextureID end
	local mesh = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
	local decal = firstDecal(frame)
	local texture = (decal and decal.Texture ~= "" and decal.Texture) or mesh.TextureId
	return mesh.MeshId, texture
end

-- Frames under the folder sorted by numeric name; preloaded whenever the count changes.
function MeshFrames.readFrames(folder)
	local frames = {}
	if not folder then return frames end
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
