			local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[emissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			baseDir = (worldCF * spreadRotation)[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		end

		localCFrames[step] = parentCF:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
	end

	return localCFrames, totalKeyFrames
end

-- Attachment variant: no Link param, attachment-local space (initialCF doubles as localCF).
function Particle:PreSimulateAttachmentForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, lifetime, previewMaxSteps, spawnEmitterRotation)
	local INVERT_MAX_STEPS = 500
	local totalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames)
	if previewMaxSteps and totalKeyFrames > previewMaxSteps then
		totalKeyFrames = previewMaxSteps
	elseif data.InvertMotion and totalKeyFrames > INVERT_MAX_STEPS then
		totalKeyFrames = INVERT_MAX_STEPS
	end
	local stepDT = lifetime / totalKeyFrames

	local localCF = initialCF
	local baseDir = baseDirection
	local emissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection
	local rotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife"
	local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = 0, 0, 0
	-- AccelerationTowardsInstance not integrated here (local-space mismatch with world target).
	-- Preview Attachment trajectories diverge from live emit when target accel is enabled.

	-- PosOffset trajectory state. Routes through Constants.resolveDisplacement with
	-- DisplacementMode + spawnEmitterRotation so cached frames match live Update path.
	local hasPosOffset = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil
	local spawnRotation = initialCF.Rotation
	local prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero

	-- Turbulence wander; seed handling mirrors PreSimulateForward above.
	local turbGraph = Turbulence.isLive(data.Turbulence)
	local prevTurbOff = Vector3.zero
	if turbGraph then
		seeds.Turbulence = seeds.Turbulence or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(turbGraph)
		seeds._turbSeed = seeds._turbSeed or (math.random() * 997 + 0.5)
		prevTurbOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(
			Turbulence.sampleRaw(turbGraph, seeds.Turbulence, seeds._turbSeed, data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1, lifetime, 0),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", spawnRotation, spawnEmitterRotation or spawnRotation)
	end

	local localCFrames = {}
	localCFrames[0] = initialCF

	for step = 1, totalKeyFrames do
		local steppedI = step / totalKeyFrames
		local elapsedSec = steppedI * lifetime

		local speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.Speed, seeds.Speed)
		local draggedSpeed = speed * math.exp(-data.ParticleData.Drag * elapsedSec)

		local accelVelocity = data.ParticleData.Acceleration * elapsedSec
		local displacement = (baseDir * draggedSpeed + accelVelocity) * stepDT

		if hasPosOffset then
			local oX = data.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetX, seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
			local oY = data.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetY, seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
			local oZ = data.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetZ, seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
			local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
				data.DisplacementMode or "Global", spawnRotation,
				spawnEmitterRotation or spawnRotation)
			displacement = displacement + (worldOff - prevWorldOff)
			prevWorldOff = worldOff
		end
		if turbGraph then
			local turbOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(
				Turbulence.sampleRaw(turbGraph, seeds.Turbulence, seeds._turbSeed, data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1, lifetime, steppedI),
				data.DisplacementMode or "Global", spawnRotation, spawnEmitterRotation or spawnRotation)
			displacement = displacement + (turbOff - prevTurbOff)
			prevTurbOff = turbOff
		end

		localCF = CFrame.new(displacement) * localCF

		-- Rotation
		local rotSpeedX = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedX, seeds.RotSpeedX)
		local rotSpeedY = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedY, seeds.RotSpeedY)
		local rotSpeedZ = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedZ, seeds.RotSpeedZ)

		local rotCF
		local rotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global"
		if rotMode == "Speed" then
			accRotX = accRotX + rotSpeedX * stepDT
			accRotY = accRotY + rotSpeedY * stepDT
			accRotZ = accRotZ + rotSpeedZ * stepDT
			rotCF = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ)
		else
			rotCF = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX, rotSpeedY, rotSpeedZ)
		end

		local worldCF = localCF * rotCF

		if data.VelocityVectored then
			local dirVecInfo = DirectionVectors[emissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			baseDir = (worldCF * spreadRotation)[dirVecInfo.vector] * dirVecInfo.multiplier
		end

		localCFrames[step] = worldCF
	end

	return localCFrames, totalKeyFrames
end

end

--[[
	RegisterEmit Mixin  -  Particle:_registerEmit, the universal pData insertion chokepoint.
	Every EmitX type funnels fresh pData through here: cap check, chain-id stamp, ActiveEmits
	insert, OnHit raycast seed, OnEmit fire. Also stamps the per-play "ghost" token
	(emitCtx._playToken) onto pData so AbsoluteEmitAt's PlayHandle can scope Disable /
	SetTimescale / GetParticles to one play, and inherits that play's live timescale window
	onto new emits without writing _tsOverride attributes to the shared source.

	Split out of Lifecycle.luau to keep that file under the 500-line code cap. Must be applied
	(require(script.RegisterEmit)(Particle)) before any emit runs.
]]

local Events = require(script.Parent.Events)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)

return function(Particle)

	-- Register fresh pData: stamp chain id + play token, insert ActiveEmits, seed OnHit raycast, fire OnEmit.
	function Particle:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
		-- Active-particle cap (counts ActiveEmits + linger visuals).
		local cap = self.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000
		if #self.ActiveEmits + (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= cap then
			-- 3D Animate uses LIVE source RT; can't destroy. Clone-Animate (Screen/ImageLabel) destroys.
			local liveRTAnimate = self:_isLiveRTAnimate(pData)
			if pData.IsAnimate and pData._sourceItem then self.ActiveAnimates[pData._sourceItem] = nil end
			-- Emitters create _nestedAlive before registering; flipping it here makes their nested walk a no-op.
			self:_reclaimPData(pData)
			if not liveRTAnimate and pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
				-- Cap-reject: route through _releaseOrDestroy so the visual enters the pool.
				self:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, pData.VisualPart)
			end
			return
		end
		-- Root emits with no incoming emitCtx still get a fresh ChainCtx so OnEmit /
		-- OnDeath / OnHit on the same particle share identity (otherwise OnDeath would fire
		-- under a NEW root chain and chain-tracking across lifetime would break).
		pData.EventChainCtx = (emitCtx and emitCtx.ChainCtx) or pData.EventChainCtx or Events.newChainCtx()

		-- Per-play ghost token: tags this particle so PlayHandle can sweep / timescale only
		-- this play. New emits during an active play-timescale window inherit it here, so the
		-- override never has to be written to the shared source item's attributes.
		local token = emitCtx and emitCtx._playToken
		if token then
			pData._playToken = token
			if token.TsOverride ~= nil and token.TsUntil and os.clock() < token.TsUntil then
				pData._tsOverride = token.TsOverride
				pData._tsOverrideUntil = token.TsUntil
			end
		end

		-- Play-scoped authoring survives AnimateLoop cycles (EngineReplay re-reads the source).
		if emitCtx then
			pData._playOverrides = emitCtx.Overrides
			pData._playLink = emitCtx._playLink
		end

		-- Link generation: the pool bumps it on every release, so a recycled clone stops being a
		-- valid link for particles that captured it earlier (LinkCF.isValid).
		if pData.Link then pData._linkGen = Pool.linkGen(pData.Link) end
		if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive ~= nil then pData._nestedDriven = true end
		LinkCF.captureEmitFrame(pData)
		table.insert(self.ActiveEmits, pData)
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit then
			pData.LastHitCheckPos = Events.getWorldPosition(pData)
			pData.HitParams = Events.makeHitParams(pData)
			pData._hitFired = false
		end
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnEmit then
			-- Build payload explicitly so EmitIndex (per-burst index) reaches user scripts.
			-- Events.fire's nil-payload fallback can't synthesize EmitIndex because it
			-- doesn't see emitCtx.
			local payload = Events.makePayload(self, pData, "OnEmit", emitCtx)
			Events.fire(self, pData, "OnEmit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
		end
	end

end

--[[
	Rocks Mixin  -  Emit + Animate + Update for debris bursts.

	FULLY PREDETERMINED playback (Rocks/Trajectory.luau) in edit AND running
	games: the complete path  -  arcs, bounces, roll-out, exact rest pose  -  is
	computed once at emit with ~a dozen raycasts per chunk; every frame just
	evaluates pose(t) and BulkMoveTo's. Nothing integrates, so jitter and
	unpredicted end poses are impossible, Timescale (including reverse) replays
	the path exactly, and the game's physics engine never touches the chunks.

	Path building is spread over frames (TRAJ_BUILD_BUDGET chunks per frame); a chunk flies a
	ballistic placeholder until its own path lands, so a 32-chunk burst never spikes one frame.

	OnHit fires from the precomputed first impact (once per burst, or per chunk with HitPerChunk). The generic Events.afterUpdate
	raycast must NOT run here: the Model pivot is the LIVE bounding-box center
	(no PrimaryPart), so it moves with the chunks — pData._ownsOnHit gates it off
	(set in Rocks/PDataBuilder; consumer check at the top of Events.afterUpdate).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Events)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Trajectory = require(script.Trajectory)
local PDataBuilder = require(script.PDataBuilder)

local MAX_CHUNKS = 32
-- Chunk paths built per frame; each build costs up to ~18 raycasts.
local TRAJ_BUILD_BUDGET = 8
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
-- Rested chunks sink through the floor over the last 15% of life (SinkOut).
local SINK_START = 0.85

-- Weak-keyed by burst Model so rig buffers survive pool release/acquire cycles.
local Rigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

return function(Particle)

-- Rocks discriminator; shared by init.luau Emit dispatch + Lifecycle EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isRocks(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsRocks") == true
end

-- One chunk part cloned from the RT. copyBare strips Transformed children (nested
-- source Part-Icles fire once per BURST via NestedEmit.walk, never per chunk).
-- Chunks stay ANCHORED for life  -  trajectory playback drives their CFrames.
local function buildChunk(rt)
	local chunk = Pool.copyBare(rt)
	chunk.Anchored = true
	chunk.CanCollide = false
	chunk.CanQuery = false
	chunk.CanTouch = false
	chunk.Massless = false
	chunk.Locked = true
	chunk.Archivable = false
	chunk.CastShadow = true
	chunk.Transparency = 0
	local decal = chunk:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or chunk:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture")
	return chunk, decal
end

local function chunkCapFor(data)
	return math.clamp(math.floor((data.ChunkCount and data.ChunkCount.Max or 10) + 0.5), 1, MAX_CHUNKS)
end

local function buildRig(data)
	local cap = chunkCapFor(data)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "RockBurst"
	model.Archivable = false
	local rig = {
		chunkCap = cap,
		parts = table.create(cap),
		decals = table.create(cap),
		baseSize = table.create(cap),
		halfExt = table.create(cap),
		bounciness = table.create(cap),
		gravity = table.create(cap),
		friction = table.create(cap),
		-- Trajectory seeds + playback buffers.
		launchVel = table.create(cap),
		launchAng = table.create(cap),
		spawnPos = table.create(cap),
		spawnRot = table.create(cap),
		trajs = table.create(cap),
		touched = table.create(cap),
		hitDone = table.create(cap),
		writeCFs = table.create(cap),
	}
	for i = 1, cap do
		local chunk, decal = buildChunk(data.RenderTemplate)
		chunk.Name = "Chunk" .. i
		chunk.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
		chunk.Parent = model
		rig.parts[i] = chunk
		rig.decals[i] = decal
		rig.baseSize[i] = chunk.Size
		rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
	end
	Rigs[model] = rig
	return model, rig
end

-- Pool acquire with defensive rig re-check (foreign / layout-drifted / engine-
-- destroyed-chunk models rebuild).
local function acquireRocks(data)
	local expected = chunkCapFor(data)
	if data.Pool ~= false then
		local model = Pool.acquire(data.RenderTemplate, "Rocks")
		if model then
			local rig = Rigs[model]
			if rig and rig.chunkCap == expected and rig.parts[1] and rig.parts[1].Parent == model then
				model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
				return model, rig
			end
			pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return model, rig
end

-- Step-gated visual write: transparency/color/brightness on every chunk + decal,
-- Scale graph multiplies baseSize.
local function writeVisuals(pData, t)
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local trans = graphs.Transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Transparency, seeds.Transparency) or 0
	if pData.SkipTransparency then trans = pData._curTrans or trans end
	local bright = graphs.Brightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Brightness, seeds.Brightness) or 1
	local color
	if graphs.Color and not pData.SkipColor then
		local c = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.Color)
		color = Color3.new(math.min(c.R * bright, 1), math.min(c.G * bright, 1), math.min(c.B * bright, 1))
	end
	local scale = graphs.Scale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Scale, seeds.Scale)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local scaleChanged = scale and scale ~= pData._curScale
	if scale then pData._curScale = scale end
	pData._curTrans = trans
	for i = 1, rig.chunkCap do
		local chunk = rig.parts[i]
		chunk.Transparency = trans
		if color then chunk.Color = color end
		local decal = rig.decals[i]
		if decal then
			decal.Transparency = trans
			if color then decal.Color3 = color end
		end
		if scaleChanged then
			chunk.Size = rig.baseSize[i] * math.max(scale, 0.01)
		end
	end
end

-- Edit-path raycast params: makeHitParams filter pattern (source/RT/EmitParent/
-- user OnHit cfg) + both engine folders by ancestry + RespectCanCollide so rocks
-- pass through non-collidable decoration.
local function buildRockParams(self, pData)
	local p = EventsMod.makeHitParams(pData)
	p.RespectCanCollide = true
	pcall(function()
		p:AddToFilter(self:GetFolder())
		p:AddToFilter(self:GetPoolFolder())
	end)
	pData._rockParams = p
	pData._raycastFn = function(origin, disp)
		return workspace:Raycast(origin, disp, p)
	end
end

-- Build the next `budget` chunk paths (all raycast cost lives here). Running first-impact /
-- rest accumulators finalize once every chunk is built; until then the write gate stays open.
local function buildTrajectories(pData, budget)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local rayFn = pData._raycastFn
	local scale = pData._curScale or 1
	local first = pData._trajBuilt + 1
	local last = math.min(pData._chunkCount, pData._trajBuilt + budget)
	for i = first, last do
		local traj = Trajectory.build(rig.spawnPos[i], rig.launchVel[i], rig.spawnRot[i], rig.launchAng[i],
			rig.halfExt[i], scale, rig.gravity[i], rig.bounciness[i], rig.friction[i], rayFn)
		rig.trajs[i] = traj
		if traj.impactT and traj.impactT < pData._firstImpactT then
			pData._firstImpactT = traj.impactT
			pData._firstHitInfo = traj.hit
		end
		-- A chunk that never rests (no ground in reach) must keep the write gate
		-- open for its whole life; latching at the max FINITE rest would freeze it
		-- mid-air and snap it far away when the sink phase re-opens the gate.
		if traj.restT == math.huge then
			pData._trajAnyEndless = true
		elseif traj.restT > pData._trajMaxRest then
			pData._trajMaxRest = traj.restT
		end
	end
	pData._trajBuilt = last
	if last >= pData._chunkCount then
		pData._maxRestT = (pData._trajMaxRest > 0 and not pData._trajAnyEndless) and pData._trajMaxRest or math.huge
	end
end

-- Per-burst path setup, shared by Emit / Animate / loop refresh: every chunk starts on a
-- ballistic placeholder, the first budget of real paths lands now, Update builds the rest.
local function startPhysics(self, pData)
	buildRockParams(self, pData)
	local rig = pData._rig
	pData._trajBuilt = 0
	pData._firstImpactT = math.huge
	pData._firstHitInfo = nil
	pData._trajMaxRest = 0
	pData._trajAnyEndless = false
	pData._maxRestT = math.huge
	pData._restWritten = false
	pData._hitsPending = pData._hitPerChunk and pData._chunkCount or 0
	for i = 1, pData._chunkCount do
		rig.trajs[i] = Trajectory.ballistic(rig.spawnPos[i], rig.launchVel[i], rig.spawnRot[i], rig.launchAng[i])
		rig.hitDone[i] = false
	end
	buildTrajectories(pData, TRAJ_BUILD_BUDGET)
end

local function fireChunkHit(self, pData, hit)
	local payload = EventsMod.makePayload(self, pData, "OnHit", nil)
	payload.HitInstance = hit.Instance
	payload.Other = hit.Instance
	payload.HitPosition = hit.Position
	payload.HitNormal = hit.Normal
	EventsMod.fire(self, pData, "OnHit", pData.EventChainCtx, payload)
end

-- Spawn one debris burst.
function Particle:EmitRocks(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = acquireRocks(data)
	local pData = PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	if data.Pool ~= false then
		pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Rocks"
	end

	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	startPhysics(self, pData)
	Pool.restoreTrails(model, "Rocks")
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: singleton looping burst per source (fresh rig, never pooled).
function Particle:EmitRocksAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	local pData = PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item
	pData._animateLink = link

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	startPhysics(self, pData)
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Per-frame update: evaluate the predetermined paths at effective time (any
-- Timescale, any direction) + one BulkMoveTo; idles once everything is at rest.
function Particle:UpdateRocks(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Lightning/init.luau UpdateLightning.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local newEff = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	local model = pData.VisualPart
	if not model or not model.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)

	if not isDying then
		local rig = pData._rig
		if pData._trajBuilt < pData._chunkCount then buildTrajectories(pData, TRAJ_BUILD_BUDGET) end
		local sinkPhase = pData._sinkOut and (newEff / lifeTime) > SINK_START
		if newEff < pData._maxRestT or sinkPhase or not pData._restWritten then
			local sinkEase = 0
			if sinkPhase then
				local e = ((newEff / lifeTime) - SINK_START) / (1 - SINK_START)
				sinkEase = e * e
			end
			for i = 1, pData._chunkCount do
				local traj = rig.trajs[i]
				if traj then
					local cf = Trajectory.evaluate(traj, newEff, rig.gravity[i])
					if sinkEase > 0 and newEff > traj.restT then
						-- Full burial along the rest surface normal: largest dimension
						-- (scaled) × 1.5 clears the surface with margin.
						local sz = rig.baseSize[i]
						local depth = math.max(sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z) * math.max(pData._curScale or 1, 0.01) * 1.5
						cf = cf.Rotation + (cf.Position - (traj.restNormal or Vector3.yAxis) * (depth * sinkEase))
					end
					rig.writeCFs[i] = cf
					-- InheritFloor lands the moment the path says it does.
					if pData._inheritFloor and not rig.touched[i] and traj.impactT and newEff >= traj.impactT and traj.hit then
						rig.touched[i] = true
						local part = rig.parts[i]
						pcall(function()
							part.Material = traj.hit.Instance.Material
							part.Color = traj.hit.Instance.Color
						end)
						pData.SkipColor = true
					end
				end
			end
			workspace:BulkMoveTo(rig.parts, rig.writeCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
			-- One flush past rest, then idle until sink or reversed time.
			pData._restWritten = newEff >= pData._maxRestT and not sinkPhase
		end
		-- OnHit from the precomputed impacts: once per burst at the earliest, or per chunk.
		if pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit then
			if pData._hitPerChunk then
				if pData._hitsPending > 0 then
					for i = 1, pData._chunkCount do
						local traj = rig.trajs[i]
						if not rig.hitDone[i] and traj.impactT and traj.hit and newEff >= traj.impactT then
							rig.hitDone[i] = true
							pData._hitsPending -= 1
							fireChunkHit(self, pData, traj.hit)
						end
					end
				end
			elseif not pData._hitFired and pData._trajBuilt >= pData._chunkCount
				and pData._firstHitInfo and newEff >= pData._firstImpactT then
				pData._hitFired = true
				fireChunkHit(self, pData, pData._firstHitInfo)
			end
		end
	end

	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		writeVisuals(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	end

	return isDying
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (EngineReplay dispatch): re-roll every chunk from
-- the source's CURRENT pose, rebuild paths, restart physics; rebuild the rig on
-- layout change.
function Particle:_refreshRocksAnimate(pData, freshData)
	-- Generic replay assigns pData.Link from freshData; Rocks never links post-emit.
	pData.Link = nil
	pData._sinkOut = freshData.SinkOut ~= false
	pData._inheritFloor = freshData.InheritFloor == true
	pData._hitPerChunk = freshData.HitPerChunk == true
	pData._hitFired = false
	pData.SkipColor = nil

	local expected = chunkCapFor(freshData)
	if expected ~= pData._rig.chunkCap and freshData.RenderTemplate then
		local oldModel = pData.VisualPart
		local parent = oldModel and oldModel.Parent
		local model, rig = buildRig(freshData)
		model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
		pData.VisualPart = model
		pData._rig = rig
		model.Parent = parent or self:GetFolder()
		if oldModel then pcall(function() oldModel:Destroy() end) end
	end

	local link = pData._animateLink
	local originCF
	if link and link.Parent then
		originCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	end
	local src = pData.AnimateItem
	if not originCF and src and src.Parent then originCF = src.CFrame end
	-- Rebuilt rigs need the same WorldPivot stamp PDataBuilder.build gives fresh ones.
	if originCF then pcall(function() pData.VisualPart.WorldPivot = originCF end) end

	local rig = pData._rig
	PDataBuilder.rollChunks(pData, freshData, rig, originCF or CFrame.new())
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	startPhysics(self, pData)
end

end

--[[
	Rocks/PDataBuilder  -  per-burst pData construction + chunk rolls, shared by
	Emit + Animate + the AnimateLoop refresh. rollChunks resets EVERY rig slot
	(including parked ones) so no state survives a pooled prior life: rolled
	Sizes/CFrames are written to the anchored parts, spawn poses + launch
	velocities land in rig buffers as trajectory seeds (Rocks/init.luau
	buildTrajectories).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)

local PDataBuilder = {}

local function rollRange(r)
	return RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(r)
end

-- EvenDistribution: chunk i of n samples a deterministic spread across the range.
local function rollAxis(r, even, i, n)
	if even and n > 0 then
		return r.Min + (r.Max - r.Min) * ((i - 0.5) / n)
	end
	return RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(r)
end

-- Random unit vector.
local function randomAxis()
	local v = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1)
	if v.Magnitude < 1e-3 then return Vector3.yAxis end
	return v.Unit
end

-- Launch direction for chunk i of n in the emitter frame, returned in WORLD space.
-- Directional: authored EmissionDirection ± SpreadAngle. Ring: even azimuth around
-- the EmissionDirection axis, elevated by SpreadAngle.X degrees (ground-slam ring).
local function launchDir(data, originCF, i, n)
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local axis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	if data.BurstMode == "Ring" then
		local u = axis:Cross(Vector3.xAxis)
		if u.Magnitude < 0.01 then u = axis:Cross(Vector3.zAxis) end
		u = u.Unit
		local v = axis:Cross(u)
		local az = ((i - 0.5) / n) * 2 * math.pi + (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2
		local elev = math.rad(data.SpreadAngle.X)
		local dirLocal = (u * math.cos(az) + v * math.sin(az)) * math.cos(elev) + axis * math.sin(elev)
		return originCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(dirLocal)
	end
	local spread = data.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, axis)
	if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
		cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
			math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
	end
	return originCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(cf.LookVector)
end

-- Roll + reset every chunk slot from the origin pose: spawn poses + launch
-- velocities are the SEEDS for the predetermined trajectories (Rocks/init.luau
-- buildTrajectories); rolled Sizes/CFrames are written to the anchored parts.
-- Slots past the rolled count park at FAR_CFRAME so pooled leftovers never show.
function PDataBuilder.rollChunks(pData, data, rig, originCF)
	local rtSize = (data.RenderTemplate and data.RenderTemplate:IsA("BasePart")) and data.RenderTemplate.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local count = math.clamp(math.floor(rollRange(data.ChunkCount) + 0.5), 1, rig.chunkCap)
	pData._chunkCount = count
	local scale0 = data.Scale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Scale, pData.Seeds.Scale) or 1
	pData._curScale = scale0
	for i = 1, rig.chunkCap do
		local chunk = rig.parts[i]
		if i <= count then
			local px = rollAxis(data.PosX, data.PosXEven, i, count)
			local py = rollAxis(data.PosY, data.PosYEven, i, count)
			local pz = rollAxis(data.PosZ, data.PosZEven, i, count)
			local pos
			if data.PosMode == "Global" then
				pos = originCF.Position + Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
			else
				pos = (originCF * CFrame.new(px, py, pz)).Position
			end
			rig.baseSize[i] = rtSize * rollRange(data.ChunkScale)
			rig.halfExt[i] = rig.baseSize[i] * 0.5
			-- Per-chunk launch speed: envelope seed = spawn-time variation.
			local speed = data.Speed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Speed, GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed)) or 0
			local launchV = launchDir(data, originCF, i, count) * speed
			local axis = randomAxis()
			local tumble = math.rad(rollRange(data.TumbleSpeed)) * (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1)
			local rot = CFrame.Angles(math.random() * 6.283, math.random() * 6.283, math.random() * 6.283)
			-- Trajectory seeds (Rocks/init.luau builds the full predetermined
			-- path from these at emit).
			rig.launchVel[i] = launchV
			rig.launchAng[i] = axis * tumble
			rig.spawnPos[i] = pos
			rig.spawnRot[i] = rot
			rig.trajs[i] = nil
			rig.bounciness[i] = math.clamp(rollRange(data.Bounciness), 0, 1)
			rig.gravity[i] = rollRange(data.Gravity)
			rig.friction[i] = math.clamp(rollRange(data.Friction), 0, 1)
			rig.touched[i] = false
			rig.writeCFs[i] = rot + pos
			pcall(function()
				chunk.Size = rig.baseSize[i] * math.max(scale0, 0.01)
				chunk.CFrame = rot + pos
			end)
		else
			pcall(function()
				chunk.Anchored = true
				chunk.CanCollide = false
				chunk.CanTouch = false
				chunk.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
			end)
			rig.launchVel[i] = Vector3.zero
			rig.launchAng[i] = Vector3.zero
			rig.spawnPos[i] = FAR_CFRAME.Position
			rig.spawnRot[i] = CFrame.identity
			rig.trajs[i] = nil
			rig.touched[i] = false
			rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
		end
	end
end

function PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)
	local seeds = {
		Scale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Scale),
		Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local pData = {
		Type = "Rocks",
		VisualPart = model,
		_rig = rig,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			Scale = data.Scale,
			Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
			Color = data.Color,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),
		_sinkOut = data.SinkOut ~= false,
		_inheritFloor = data.InheritFloor == true,
		_hitPerChunk = data.HitPerChunk == true,
		_hitFired = false,
		-- OnHit fires from the precomputed first impact (Rocks/init.luau); the
		-- generic Events.afterUpdate raycast + Collision actions must skip this pData.
		_ownsOnHit = true,
	}

	-- Origin: event override → live parent clone (nested emit) → source pose.
	-- Sampled ONCE at emit; chunks fly world-space and never track the source after.
	local originCF
	if emitCtx then
		local oCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then oCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		oCF = oCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if oCF then
			originCF = (emitCtx.UseFullOrigin and oCF) or CFrame.new(oCF.Position) * item.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	end
	if not originCF and link and link.Parent then
		originCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	end
	-- The rig Model has no PrimaryPart, so an unset WorldPivot tracks the live bbox, which the
	-- 1e9-parked slots drag away; stamp the burst origin so nested links read it (Lightning does the same).
	pcall(function() model.WorldPivot = originCF or item.CFrame end)
	PDataBuilder.rollChunks(pData, data, rig, originCF or item.CFrame)
	return pData
end

return PDataBuilder

--[[
	Rocks/Trajectory  -  FULLY PREDETERMINED debris paths (edit mode and running games alike;
	the physics engine never touches a chunk).

	The whole flight is computed ONCE at emit: ballistic arcs are raycast in
	slices to find each impact, bounces reflect analytically (restitution above
	BOUNCE_MIN, friction on the tangent, travel→tumble), the final roll-out is a
	closed-form deceleration, and the rest pose (nearest face flat, heading
	preserved) is exact. Playback = evaluate(traj, t)  -  a pure function of
	time, so jitter/vibration/unpredicted poses are impossible at ANY phase,
	reverse or scaled Timescale replays exactly, and the per-frame cost is a
	handful of vector ops per chunk. All raycast cost happens at emit
	(≤ ~18 rays per chunk).

	The raycast is INJECTED (raycastFn(origin, displacement) → RaycastResult-like
	or nil) so a Node harness can verify the builder + evaluator headless.
]]

-- Bounces slower than this along the normal don't rebound; the path rolls out.
local BOUNCE_MIN = 6
local MAX_BOUNCES = 3
-- Roll-out deceleration = friction · gravity · this factor (rolling resistance).
local ROLL_RESIST = 0.5
-- Arc raycast slicing.
local FIRST_ARC_SLICES = 6
local BOUNCE_ARC_SLICES = 4
local MAX_ARC_TIME = 6

local Trajectory = {}

-- OBB support distance: projection of the (scaled) half extents onto dir.
local function support(rot, halfExt, dir, scale)
	return (math.abs(rot.XVector:Dot(dir)) * halfExt.X
		+ math.abs(rot.YVector:Dot(dir)) * halfExt.Y
		+ math.abs(rot.ZVector:Dot(dir)) * halfExt.Z) * scale
end

local function spinCF(rot, w, dt)
	local mag = w.Magnitude
	if mag * dt < 1e-4 then return rot end
	return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(w * (1 / mag), mag * dt) * rot
end

-- Exact time the parabola center crosses n·center(t) = target. The swept chord
-- ray only DETECTS the surface; placing the impact on the chord would snap the
-- pose by the chord-parabola gap (grows with the arc window). Solving the
-- quadratic keeps evaluate() continuous through the impact by construction.
local function planeCrossTime(p, v, gVec, n, target, tMax)
	local a = 0.5 * gVec:Dot(n)
	local b = v:Dot(n)
	local c = p:Dot(n) - target
	if math.abs(a) < 1e-6 then
		if math.abs(b) < 1e-9 then return nil end
		local t = -c / b
		if t >= 0 and t <= tMax then return t end
		return nil
	end
	local disc = b * b - 4 * a * c
	if disc < 0 then return nil end
	local sq = math.sqrt(disc)
	local t1 = (-b - sq) / (2 * a)
	local t2 = (-b + sq) / (2 * a)
	if t1 > t2 then
		t1, t2 = t2, t1
	end
	if t1 >= 0 and t1 <= tMax then return t1 end
	if t2 >= 0 and t2 <= tMax then return t2 end
	return nil
end

-- Face-flat orientation on normal n, heading preserved. Alignment is weighted
-- by 1/halfExt so an elongated axis must be near-perfectly vertical to win:
-- debris settles onto its broad face (lowest center of mass) like real rubble
-- instead of standing on end. Returns (rotation, resting-face half extent).
local function restPose(rot, halfExt, n)
	local dx, dy, dz = rot.XVector:Dot(n), rot.YVector:Dot(n), rot.ZVector:Dot(n)
	local sx = math.abs(dx) / math.max(halfExt.X, 0.05)
	local sy = math.abs(dy) / math.max(halfExt.Y, 0.05)
	local sz = math.abs(dz) / math.max(halfExt.Z, 0.05)
	local axisVec, faceHalf
	if sx >= sy and sx >= sz then
		axisVec = rot.XVector * (dx >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		faceHalf = halfExt.X
	elseif sy >= sz then
		axisVec = rot.YVector * (dy >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		faceHalf = halfExt.Y
	else
		axisVec = rot.ZVector * (dz >= 0 and 1 or -1)
		faceHalf = halfExt.Z
	end
	local d = math.clamp(axisVec:Dot(n), -1, 1)
	local arc = axisVec:Cross(n)
	if arc.Magnitude > 1e-5 and d < 0.9999 then
		return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(arc.Unit, math.acos(d)) * rot, faceHalf
	end
	return rot, faceHalf
end

-- Spawn-state ballistic placeholder: what an unbuilt chunk flies until its full path lands
-- (Rocks/init spreads Trajectory.build over frames).
function Trajectory.ballistic(p0, v0, rot0, w0)
	return { segs = { { kind = 1, t0 = 0, p0 = p0, v0 = v0, rot0 = rot0, w = w0 } }, impactT = nil, hit = nil, restT = math.huge }
end

-- Build one chunk's complete path. Returns a trajectory table:
--   segs[]: {kind=1 ballistic|2 roll|3 rest, t0, p0, v0/dir, rot0, w/rotF, dur, ...}
--   impactT (first ground contact time or nil), hit (its RaycastResult), restT, restNormal.
function Trajectory.build(p0, v0, rot0, w0, halfExt, scale, gravity, bounciness, friction, raycastFn)
	local segs = {}
	local traj = { segs = segs, impactT = nil, hit = nil, restT = math.huge }
	local t, p, v, rot, w = 0, p0, v0, rot0, w0
	local gVec = Vector3.new(0, -gravity, 0)

	for bounce = 0, MAX_BOUNCES do
		-- Raycast the arc in slices until it hits or the window closes.
		local slices = bounce == 0 and FIRST_ARC_SLICES or BOUNCE_ARC_SLICES
		-- Arc window: generous time for the parabola to come back down.
		local upTime = math.max(v.Y, 0) / math.max(gravity, 1)
		local window = math.min(upTime * 2 + 1.5, MAX_ARC_TIME)
		local sliceDt = window / slices
		local hit, hitT = nil, nil
		local prevP = p
		for s = 1, slices do
			local st = s * sliceDt
			local sp = p + v * st + gVec * (0.5 * st * st)
			local seg = sp - prevP
			if seg.Magnitude > 1e-4 then
				local dirU = seg.Unit
				local reach = support(rot, halfExt, dirU, scale)
				local h = raycastFn(prevP, seg + dirU * reach)
				if h then
					hit = h
					-- Support extent toward the surface at the chord-estimate pose.
					local frac = math.clamp((h.Position - prevP).Magnitude / (seg.Magnitude + reach), 0, 1)
					local approxT = (s - 1) * sliceDt + sliceDt * frac
					local supEst = support(spinCF(rot, w, approxT), halfExt, h.Normal, scale)
					-- Exact crossing of the contact plane, seated at support height.
					local target = h.Position:Dot(h.Normal) + supEst
					hitT = planeCrossTime(p, v, gVec, h.Normal, target, window) or approxT
					break
				end
			end
			prevP = sp
		end

		if not hit then
			-- No ground in the window: fly ballistic until Lifetime ends.
			segs[#segs + 1] = { kind = 1, t0 = t, p0 = p, v0 = v, rot0 = rot, w = w }
			return traj
		end

		local n = hit.Normal
		local vImp = v + gVec * hitT
		local rotImp = spinCF(rot, w, hitT)
		local sup = support(rotImp, halfExt, n, scale)
		-- On-parabola impact position: matches evaluate() at t0+hitT exactly, so
		-- the ballistic→bounce/roll boundary never snaps.
		local pImp = p + v * hitT + gVec * (0.5 * hitT * hitT)

		segs[#segs + 1] = { kind = 1, t0 = t, p0 = p, v0 = v, rot0 = rot, w = w }
		t += hitT
		if not traj.impactT then
			traj.impactT = t
			traj.hit = hit
		end

		local vn = vImp:Dot(n)
		local vt = vImp - n * vn
		-- Bounce only when the REBOUND (post-restitution) speed clears the
		-- threshold  -  low Bounciness goes straight to the roll-out.
		if (-vn * bounciness) > BOUNCE_MIN and n.Y > 0.3 and bounce < MAX_BOUNCES then
			-- Rebound: restitution + impact friction + travel→tumble.
			v = vt * (1 - friction) + n * (-vn * bounciness)
			local axis = n:Cross(vt)
			if axis.Magnitude > 1e-4 and vt.Magnitude > 0.5 then
				w = axis.Unit * (vt.Magnitude / math.max(sup, 0.1))
			end
			p = pImp
			rot = rotImp
		else
			-- Roll-out: closed-form deceleration along the tangent, orientation
			-- blends to the exact rest pose, timed to finish with the slide.
			local speed = vt.Magnitude
			local decel = math.max(friction * gravity * ROLL_RESIST, 10)
			local dur = math.min(speed / decel, 2)
			local dir = speed > 1e-3 and vt.Unit or Vector3.xAxis
			local rotF, faceHalf = restPose(rotImp, halfExt, n)
			local d = hit.Position:Dot(n)
			-- Rest center sits exactly at face height on the contact plane.
			local function planeSeat(pt, height)
				return pt + n * ((d + height) - pt:Dot(n))
			end
			local rollP0 = planeSeat(pImp, sup)
			local rollP1 = planeSeat(rollP0 + dir * (speed * dur - 0.5 * decel * dur * dur), faceHalf * scale)
			segs[#segs + 1] = { kind = 2, t0 = t, dur = math.max(dur, 0.15),
				p0 = rollP0, p1 = rollP1, rot0 = rotImp, rotF = rotF }
			t += math.max(dur, 0.15)
			segs[#segs + 1] = { kind = 3, t0 = t, cf = rotF + rollP1 }
			traj.restT = t
			traj.restNormal = n
			return traj
		end
	end
	return traj
end

-- Evaluate the pose at time t (pure function; any t, any direction).
function Trajectory.evaluate(traj, t, gravity)
	local segs = traj.segs
	local seg = segs[1]
	for s = 2, #segs do
		if segs[s].t0 <= t then seg = segs[s] else break end
	end
	if seg.kind == 1 then
		local dt = math.max(t - seg.t0, 0)
		local p = seg.p0 + seg.v0 * dt + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * gravity * dt * dt, 0)
		return spinCF(seg.rot0, seg.w, dt) + p
	elseif seg.kind == 2 then
		local s = math.clamp((t - seg.t0) / seg.dur, 0, 1)
		local e = 1 - (1 - s) * (1 - s)
		return seg.rot0:Lerp(seg.rotF, e) + seg.p0:Lerp(seg.p1, e)
	end
	return seg.cf
end

return Trajectory

--[[
	Rope Mixin  -  Emit + Animate + Update for verlet-chain ropes. The chain is
	pure kinematic simulation (VerletSim.luau) driving anchored segment Parts
	via BulkMoveTo  -  identical cost in edit and running games, no engine
	physics involved.

	Timescale: verlet is not time-reversible  -  freeze/reverse holds the pose
	(physDt = 0) while color/transparency graphs keep playing backwards. Same
	rule as Rocks' native path; consumer note lives at the UpdateRope header.

	The rig Model stamps _lightningBolt so EmitPointLight fans nested lights out
	per segment (PointLight.luau reads it)  -  glowing rope for free.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local TurbulenceMod = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local VerletSim = require(script.VerletSim)
local Anchors = require(script.Anchors)
local PDataBuilder = require(script.PDataBuilder)

local MAX_ROPE_SEGMENTS = 48
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)

-- Weak-keyed by rig Model so buffers survive pool release/acquire cycles.
local Rigs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

return function(Particle)

-- Rope discriminator; shared by init.luau Emit dispatch + Lifecycle EmitAnimate dispatch.
function Particle._isRope(item)
	return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsRope") == true
end

-- One segment part cloned from the RT. copyBare strips Transformed children
-- (nested source Part-Icles fire once per ROPE via NestedEmit.walk).
local function buildSegment(rt)
	local seg = Pool.copyBare(rt)
	seg.Anchored = true
	seg.CanCollide = false
	seg.CanQuery = false
	seg.CanTouch = false
	seg.Massless = true
	seg.Locked = true
	seg.Archivable = false
	local decal = seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal") or seg:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Texture")
	return seg, decal
end

local function segCapFor(data)
	return math.clamp(math.floor((data.SegmentCount and data.SegmentCount.Max or 12) + 0.5), 2, MAX_ROPE_SEGMENTS)
end

local function buildRig(data)
	local cap = segCapFor(data)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "Rope"
	model.Archivable = false
	-- Consumed by EmitPointLight: nested lights fan out per segment (PointLight.luau).
	model:SetAttribute("_lightningBolt", true)
	local rig = {
		segCap = cap,
		partCount = cap,
		parts = table.create(cap),
		decals = table.create(cap),
		segLen = table.create(cap),
		widthScale = table.create(cap),
		writeCFs = table.create(cap),
		posBuf = table.create(cap + 1),
		prevPosBuf = table.create(cap + 1),
	}
	for i = 1, cap do
		local seg, decal = buildSegment(data.RenderTemplate)
		seg.Name = "Seg" .. i
		seg.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
		seg.Parent = model
		rig.parts[i] = seg
		rig.decals[i] = decal
		rig.segLen[i] = 0.05
		rig.widthScale[i] = 1
		rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
	end
	Rigs[model] = rig
	return model, rig
end

-- Pool acquire with defensive rig re-check (foreign / layout-drifted models rebuild).
local function acquireRope(data)
	local expected = segCapFor(data)
	if data.Pool == true then
		local model = Pool.acquire(data.RenderTemplate, "Rope")
		if model then
			local rig = Rigs[model]
			if rig and rig.segCap == expected and rig.parts[1] and rig.parts[1].Parent == model then
				model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
				return model, rig
			end
			pcall(function() model:Destroy() end)
		end
	end
	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return model, rig
end

-- Step-gated visual write: transparency/color/brightness/thickness over every
-- segment + decal. Size.Z comes from segLen (stretch handled by writeSegments).
local function writeVisuals(pData, t)
	local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
	local trans = graphs.Transparency and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Transparency, seeds.Transparency) or 0
	if pData.SkipTransparency then trans = pData._curTrans or trans end
	local bright = graphs.Brightness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Brightness, seeds.Brightness) or 1
	local color
	if graphs.Color and not pData.SkipColor then
		local c = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.Color)
		color = Color3.new(math.min(c.R * bright, 1), math.min(c.G * bright, 1), math.min(c.B * bright, 1))
	end
	local thick = graphs.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.Thickness, seeds.Thickness)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local thickChanged = thick and thick ~= pData._curThick
	if thick then pData._curThick = thick end
	pData._curTrans = trans
	for i = 1, rig.segCap do
		local seg = rig.parts[i]
		seg.Transparency = trans
		if color then seg.Color = color end
		local decal = rig.decals[i]
		if decal then
			decal.Transparency = trans
			if color then decal.Color3 = color end
		end
		if thickChanged then
			local w = math.max(0.05, thick * rig.widthScale[i])
			seg.Size = Vector3.new(w, w, rig.segLen[i])
		end
	end
end

-- Point buffers → segment CFrames + lengths. Size.Z tracks the ACTUAL point
-- distance so a stretched rope never shows gaps. atEmit writes CFrames direct
-- (model unparented; BulkMoveTo needs workspace ancestry).
local function writeSegments(pData, atEmit)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local pos = rig.posBuf
	local n = pData._segCount
	local thick = pData._curThick or 0.15
	for i = 1, n do
		local p0 = pos[i]
		local p1 = pos[i + 1]
		local seg = p1 - p0
		local len = seg.Magnitude
		local mid = (p0 + p1) * 0.5
		if len > 1e-4 then
			rig.writeCFs[i] = CFrame.lookAt(mid, p1)
		else
			rig.writeCFs[i] = CFrame.new(mid)
		end
		if math.abs(len - rig.segLen[i]) > 0.01 then
			rig.segLen[i] = math.max(len, 0.05)
			local w = math.max(0.05, thick * rig.widthScale[i])
			rig.parts[i].Size = Vector3.new(w, w, rig.segLen[i])
		end
	end
	for i = n + 1, rig.segCap do
		rig.writeCFs[i] = FAR_CFRAME
	end
	if atEmit then
		for i = 1, rig.segCap do
			rig.parts[i].CFrame = rig.writeCFs[i]
		end
	else
		workspace:BulkMoveTo(rig.parts, rig.writeCFs, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	end
end

-- Spawn one rope.
function Particle:EmitRope(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = acquireRope(data)
	local pData = PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	if data.Pool == true then
		pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Rope"
	end

	Anchors.seedPose(pData)
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	writeSegments(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	Pool.restoreTrails(model, "Rope")
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Animate mode: singleton persistent rope per source (fresh rig, never pooled).
function Particle:EmitRopeAnimate(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local model, rig = buildRig(data)
	model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	local pData = PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)
	pData.IsAnimate = true
	pData.AnimateItem = item

	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	Anchors.seedPose(pData)
	pData._curThick = data.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or 0.15
	writeSegments(pData, true)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
	model.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()
	ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(model, self:_makeAliveCheck())

	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, model, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Per-frame update: fixed-substep verlet with anchors re-pinned every substep.
-- Reverse Timescale: the chain simulates FORWARD while all authored inputs
-- (anchors, graphs, Speed drift, Launch arc) rewind; Timescale 0 freezes.
function Particle:UpdateRope(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Lightning/init.luau UpdateLightning.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local prevEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = prevEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	local model = pData.VisualPart
	if not model or not model.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)

	if not isDying then
		-- Reverse Timescale: the chain SIMULATES FORWARD (verlet isn't time-
		-- reversible) while every authored input rewinds — anchors, Displacement
		-- graphs, Turbulence, Speed drift (signed), the Launch arc. The rope
		-- physically reacts to its inputs playing backwards. Timescale 0 /
		-- freeze stops everything.
		local frozen = pData._timeFrozen == true
		local simDt = frozen and 0 or math.min(math.abs(dtTs), 0.25)
		-- Signed accumulation uses the CLAMPED effective-time delta: once the
		-- clock pins at 0 (or LifeTime) the drift stops instead of over-running.
		local motionDt = math.clamp(newEff - prevEff, -0.25, 0.25)
		local physDtEarly = simDt
		local li = math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1)
		-- Lifecycle length: GrowIn pays out over the first window, Retract reels
		-- back over the death window, Release drops every pin once.
		local lenFactor = 1
		if pData._growIn > 0 and li < pData._growIn then
			lenFactor = math.max(li / pData._growIn, 0.02)
		end
		if pData._deathMode == "Retract" then
			local deathStart = 1 - pData._deathWindow
			if li > deathStart then
				lenFactor = lenFactor * math.max(1 - (li - deathStart) / pData._deathWindow, 0.02)
			end
		elseif pData._deathMode == "Release" and not pData._released and li > 1 - pData._deathWindow then
			pData._released = true
			pData._pinStart = false
			pData._pinEnd = false
		end
		pData._restLenEff = pData._restLen * lenFactor

		-- Signed accumulation: reverse Timescale un-winds the Speed/Accel drift.
		if pData._hasMotion and motionDt ~= 0 then
			local sp = pData.Graphs.Speed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) or 0
			if pData._drag ~= 0 then sp = sp * math.exp(-pData._drag * newEff) end
			pData._motionAccelVel = pData._motionAccelVel + pData._accel * motionDt
			pData._motionOffset = pData._motionOffset
				+ (pData._speedDir or pData._motionDir) * (sp * motionDt)
				+ pData._motionAccelVel * motionDt
		end
		if pData._hasDisp or pData._hasTurb or pData._hasMotion then
			local off = Vector3.zero
			if pData._hasDisp then
				local graphs, seeds = pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds
				off = Vector3.new(
					graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, graphs.PosOffsetX, seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0,
					graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, graphs.PosOffsetY, seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0,
					graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(li, graphs.PosOffsetZ, seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0)
			end
			if pData._hasTurb then
				off = off + TurbulenceMod.sampleRaw(pData.Graphs.Turbulence, pData.Seeds.Turbulence,
					pData._turbSeed, pData._turbFreq, lifeTime, li)
			end
			if pData._dispMode ~= "Global" then
				off = Anchors.resolveStart(pData).Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(off)
			end
			if pData._hasMotion then
				off = off + pData._motionOffset
			end
			pData._anchorOffWorld = off
		else
			pData._anchorOffWorld = nil
		end
		if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
			-- The hook BITES once (latch is permanent — reverse Timescale rewinds
			-- only pre-bite flight, and AnimateLoop cycles keep the bite):
			-- aimed = live target on arrival; blind = the world point where the
			-- rope first went taut (source then swings from it — ODM gear).
			if pData._launchArrived then
				if pData._launchT then
					local target = pData._target
					if target and target.Parent then
						pData._launchPos = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target).Position
					end
				end
			elseif pData._launchT and newEff >= pData._launchT then
				pData._launchArrived = true
				local target = pData._target
				if target and target.Parent then
					pData._launchPos = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target).Position
				end
			else
				local delta = pData._launchVel * newEff + pData._gravity * (0.5 * newEff * newEff)
				if not pData._launchT then
					local maxLen = pData._restLen * pData._segCount
					if delta.Magnitude >= maxLen then
						delta = delta.Unit * maxLen
						pData._launchArrived = true
					end
				end
				pData._launchPos = pData._launchOrigin + delta
			end
		end

		local physDt = physDtEarly
		if physDt > 1e-6 then
			pData._windPhase = pData._windPhase + pData._windFreq * physDt
			local rig = pData._rig
			-- Slow Timescale SHRINKS the substep (smooth slow motion, one step
			-- per frame) instead of thinning the cadence, which would play
			-- full-speed steps rarely — a stutter that reads as "timescale
			-- ignored". Fast Timescale keeps 1/60 steps and adds more of them.
			-- VerletSim's time-corrected velocity handles the changing h.
			local h = math.min(physDt, VerletSim.SUBSTEP)
			local accum = pData._accum + physDt
			local steps = 0
			while accum >= h and steps < VerletSim.MAX_SUBSTEPS do
				Anchors.repin(pData)
				VerletSim.step(rig.posBuf, rig.prevPosBuf, pData._segCount, pData, h, pData._windPhase)
				accum -= h
				steps += 1
			end
			-- Drop excess at the cap: a hitch slows the rope, never explodes it.
			pData._accum = steps == VerletSim.MAX_SUBSTEPS and 0 or accum
			Anchors.repin(pData)
			writeSegments(pData, false)
		end
	end

	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		writeVisuals(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	end

	return isDying
end

-- AnimateLoop per-cycle refresh (EngineReplay dispatch). POSE-PRESERVING: the
-- point buffers survive when the chain layout (segCount + restLen) is
-- unchanged, so a looping rope never pops; layout change = full re-seed.
function Particle:_refreshRopeAnimate(pData, freshData)
	-- Generic replay assigns pData.Link from freshData; Rope resolves anchors itself.
	pData.Link = nil
	local oldSeg = pData._segCount
	local oldRest = pData._restLen

	local expected = segCapFor(freshData)
	local rebuilt = false
	if expected ~= pData._rig.segCap and freshData.RenderTemplate then
		local oldModel = pData.VisualPart
		local parent = oldModel and oldModel.Parent
		local model, rig = buildRig(freshData)
		model:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
		pData.VisualPart = model
		pData._rig = rig
		model.Parent = parent or self:GetFolder()
		if oldModel then pcall(function() oldModel:Destroy() end) end
		rebuilt = true
	end

	PDataBuilder.readRopeParams(pData, freshData, pData._rig)
	if rebuilt then pcall(function() pData.VisualPart.WorldPivot = Anchors.resolveStart(pData) end) end
	pData._accum = 0
	pData._released = false
	pData.SkipColor = nil

	-- Launch is pose-preserving too: a bitten hook stays bitten across cycles
	-- (persistent grapple / ODM); per-cast re-throws come from Emit mode. The
	-- latch (_launchArrived / _launchPos) deliberately survives the refresh.
	if rebuilt or pData._segCount ~= oldSeg or math.abs((pData._restLen or 0) - (oldRest or 0)) > 1e-4 then
		Anchors.seedPose(pData)
		pData._launchArrived = false
		pData._launchPos = nil
	end
	pData._curThick = freshData.Thickness and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, freshData.Thickness, pData.Seeds.Thickness) or pData._curThick
	writeSegments(pData, false)
	writeVisuals(pData, 0)
end

end

--[[
	Rope/Anchors  -  live anchor resolution + pinning for the verlet chain.

	Start anchor: parent-clone link (nested emit) → source item → frozen last
	pose. End anchor (PinMode BothEnds): the Target ObjectValue's instance;
	Target destroyed mid-life degrades to StartOnly with a velocity kill so the
	freed end swings from its current pose instead of snapping.

	repin runs before EVERY substep (moving source/Target drags the rope  -  the
	core feature). A start-anchor jump > TELEPORT_DIST in one repin rigid-
	translates the whole chain (no cross-map whip).
]]

local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local VerletSim = require(script.Parent.VerletSim)

local TELEPORT_DIST = 50

local Anchors = {}

-- Spawn offset in the chosen frame: Local = base rotation × spawn RotXYZ
-- (rings/fans rotate the offset), Global = world axes.
local function applySpawnOff(pData, cf)
	local off = pData._spawnOff
	if not off or off.Magnitude == 0 then return cf end
	if pData._spawnOffMode == "Global" then
		return cf + off
	end
	local rot = pData._spawnRot
	if rot then
		return cf + (cf.Rotation * rot):VectorToWorldSpace(off)
	end
	return cf * CFrame.new(off)
end

-- Current start-anchor CFrame: override → live link → source → frozen last,
-- then the rolled spawn offset when SpawnTarget is Start. _lastStartCF caches
-- the PRE-offset base so per-cycle offset re-rolls apply against the live pose.
function Anchors.resolveStart(pData)
	local cf
	if pData._startCFOverride then
		cf = pData._startCFOverride
	else
		local link = pData._parentLink
		if link and link.Parent then
			cf = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		else
			local src = pData._sourceItem
			cf = (src and src.Parent) and src.CFrame or (pData._lastStartCF or CFrame.new())
		end
		pData._lastStartCF = cf
	end
	if pData._spawnTarget ~= "End" then
		cf = applySpawnOff(pData, cf)
	end
	return cf
end

-- Current end-anchor position, or nil when unpinned. Launch mode pins to the
-- ballistic point (UpdateRope's closed-form _launchPos, clamped at full rope
-- extension) and never degrades. Destroyed Target flips the rope to StartOnly
-- permanently (velocity killed once at the flip).
function Anchors.resolveEnd(pData)
	if not pData._pinEnd then return nil end
	if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
		return pData._launchPos or pData._launchOrigin
	end
	local target = pData._target
	if target and target.Parent then
		local cf = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(target)
		if pData._spawnTarget == "End" then
			cf = applySpawnOff(pData, cf)
		end
		pData._lastEndPos = cf.Position
		return cf.Position
	end
	pData._pinEnd = false
	local rig = pData._rig
	VerletSim.calm(rig.posBuf, rig.prevPosBuf, pData._segCount)
	return nil
end

-- Pin anchor points into the buffers; teleport-guard on the start anchor.
-- The MotionTarget anchor gets _anchorOffWorld added (whips drive the START;
-- End with StartOnly is a no-op — nothing is pinned to offset).
function Anchors.repin(pData)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local pos = rig.posBuf
	local prev = rig.prevPosBuf
	local n = pData._segCount
	local off = pData._anchorOffWorld

	-- Release death mode: no pins at all — the whole rope falls free.
	if pData._pinStart ~= false then
		local startPos = Anchors.resolveStart(pData).Position
		if off and pData._motionTarget == "Start" then
			startPos = startPos + off
		end
		local jump = startPos - pos[1]
		if jump.Magnitude > TELEPORT_DIST then
			VerletSim.translate(pos, prev, n, jump)
		end
		pos[1] = startPos
		prev[1] = startPos
	end

	local endPos = Anchors.resolveEnd(pData)
	if endPos then
		if off and pData._motionTarget == "End" then
			endPos = endPos + off
		end
		pos[n + 1] = endPos
		prev[n + 1] = endPos
	end
end

-- Seed the initial pose: straight line start→end with a slack belly, a
-- straight hang for StartOnly, or a compressed coil along the launch direction
-- (unfolds cleanly as the end flies; stacking every point at one spot would
-- make relaxation explode in random directions). prev := pos = spawn calm.
function Anchors.seedPose(pData)
	local rig = pData._rig
	local pos = rig.posBuf
	local n = pData._segCount
	local startPos = Anchors.resolveStart(pData).Position

	-- GrowIn: seed as a compressed coil at the start — the animated rest length
	-- pays the rope out over the grow window.
	if (pData._growIn or 0) > 0 and pData._pinMode ~= "Launch" then
		local dir = pData._motionDir or Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
		local spacing = pData._restLen * 0.02
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			pos[i] = startPos + dir * (spacing * (i - 1))
		end
		VerletSim.calm(pos, rig.prevPosBuf, n)
		return
	end

	if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
		local dir = pData._launchVel
		dir = (dir and dir.Magnitude > 1e-4) and dir.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
		local spacing = pData._restLen * 0.05
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			pos[i] = startPos + dir * (spacing * (i - 1))
		end
		VerletSim.calm(pos, rig.prevPosBuf, n)
		return
	end

	local endPos = Anchors.resolveEnd(pData)

	if endPos then
		local chord = endPos - startPos
		-- Belly depth from the length surplus over the straight chord.
		local surplus = math.max(pData._restLen * n - chord.Magnitude, 0)
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			local t = (i - 1) / n
			pos[i] = startPos + chord * t - Vector3.new(0, surplus * 0.5 * 4 * t * (1 - t), 0)
		end
	else
		-- StartOnly: seed EXTENDED along EmissionDirection ± SpreadAngle — the
		-- rope bursts out along it, then gravity settles it (whip spawn).
		local dir = pData._motionDir or Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
		for i = 1, n + 1 do
			pos[i] = startPos + dir * (pData._restLen * (i - 1))
		end
	end
	VerletSim.calm(pos, rig.prevPosBuf, n)
end

return Anchors

--[[
	Rope/PDataBuilder  -  per-rope pData construction, shared by Emit + Animate
	+ the AnimateLoop refresh (refresh re-reads via readRopeParams so live edits
	apply each cycle). Rope length: RopeLength <= 0 = auto (anchor distance ×
	Slack; 10 × Slack when unpinned/no Target).
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.Range)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.PartConstants)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Parent.Turbulence)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.Parent.AxisLinks)
local Anchors = require(script.Parent.Anchors)

local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

local PDataBuilder = {}

-- Flat-zero displacement graphs read as "no motion" so idle ropes skip sampling.
local function liveGraph(seq)
	if not seq then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 0 then return nil end
	return seq
end

-- Rope-parameter block, written onto pData. Refresh calls this too, so every
-- field here must be safe to overwrite mid-life.
function PDataBuilder.readRopeParams(pData, data, rig, emitCtx)
	pData._pinMode = data.PinMode or "BothEnds"
	pData._target = data.Target
	pData._pinStart = true
	pData._pinEnd = (pData._pinMode == "BothEnds" and data.Target ~= nil) or pData._pinMode == "Launch"
	pData._segCount = math.clamp(math.floor(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.SegmentCount) + 0.5), 2, rig.segCap)
	pData._stiffness = math.clamp(math.floor((data.Stiffness or 4) + 0.5), 1, 10)
	pData._bendStiffness = math.clamp(data.BendStiffness or 0, 0, 1)
	pData._damping = math.clamp(data.Damping or 0.03, 0, 0.5)
	pData._gravity = data.Gravity or Vector3.new(0, -40, 0)
	pData._windAmp = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.WindAmplitude)
	pData._windFreq = data.WindFrequency or 2

	-- Lifecycle: GrowIn pays the rope out over the first fraction of life;
	-- DeathMode ends it (Retract reels back in, Release drops all pins).
	pData._growIn = math.clamp(data.GrowIn or 0, 0, 0.9)
	pData._deathMode = data.DeathMode or "None"
	pData._deathWindow = math.clamp(data.DeathWindow or 0.2, 0.05, 0.9)

	-- Taper: ThicknessProfile sampled along the ARC (0 = root, 1 = tip) into the
	-- per-segment width scale; writeVisuals/writeSegments multiply Thickness by it.
	local profile = data.ThicknessProfile
	local flatProfile = not profile or GraphMod.IsStatic(profile)
	local profileSeed = (not flatProfile) and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(profile) or nil
	for i = 1, rig.segCap do
		if flatProfile then
			rig.widthScale[i] = profile and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(profile, 1) or 1
		else
			rig.widthScale[i] = math.max(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime((i - 0.5) / rig.segCap, profile, profileSeed), 0.05)
		end
	end

	-- Anchor motion: Displacement graphs + Turbulence aimed at one anchor.
	pData._motionTarget = data.MotionTarget or "Start"
	pData._dispMode = data.DisplacementMode or "Global"
	local ox = liveGraph(data.PosOffsetX)
	local oy = liveGraph(data.PosOffsetY)
	local oz = liveGraph(data.PosOffsetZ)
	pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX = ox
	pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY = oy
	pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ = oz
	pData._hasDisp = (ox or oy or oz) ~= nil
	if ox then pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX = pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(ox) end
	if oy then pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY = pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(oy) end
	if oz then pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ = pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(oz) end
	local turb = Turbulence.isLive(data.Turbulence)
	pData.Graphs.Turbulence = turb
	pData._hasTurb = turb ~= nil
	if turb then
		pData.Seeds.Turbulence = pData.Seeds.Turbulence or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(turb)
		pData._turbFreq = data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1
		pData._turbSeed = pData._turbSeed or (math.random() * 997 + 0.5)
	end

	-- Spawn frame (Lightning parity): RotXYZ rolled per rope (even-distribution
	-- aware via emitCtx + rolling cycles) rotates the AIM and the Local spawn
	-- offset frame — rings, fans, crowns. Pos offset applies to the SpawnTarget
	-- anchor (Anchors resolves it; Local = source × RotXYZ frame, Global = world).
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX", "RotY", "RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", rotS.RotX or 0, rotS.RotY or 0, rotS.RotZ or 0)
	pData._spawnRot = rotXYZ
	local posS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"PosX", "PosY", "PosZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	pData._spawnOff = Vector3.new(posS.PosX or 0, posS.PosY or 0, posS.PosZ or 0)
	pData._spawnOffMode = data.PosMode or "Local"
	pData._spawnTarget = data.SpawnTarget or "Start"

	-- Emit-frame origin: needed for auto rope length + direction composition.
	local originCF = Anchors.resolveStart(pData)

	-- Aim = EmissionDirection in the RotXYZ-rotated frame ± SpreadAngle, world-
	-- composed at emit and FROZEN (a thrown hook doesn't re-aim when the source
	-- moves afterwards). Seeds StartOnly poses + aims Launch throws. Speed gets
	-- its OWN MotionDirection axis in the same rotated frame.
	local spread = data.SpreadAngle or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local function composeDir(normalId)
		local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[normalId] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Front]
		local axis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, axis) * rotXYZ
		if spread.X > 0 or spread.Y > 0 then
			cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.X),
				math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread.Y), 0)
		end
		return originCF.Rotation:VectorToWorldSpace(cf.LookVector)
	end
	pData._motionDir = composeDir(data.EmissionDirection)
	pData._speedDir = composeDir(data.MotionDirection or data.EmissionDirection)

	-- Speed-along-direction + Acceleration drift + Drag, accumulated per frame
	-- by UpdateRope into _motionOffset (Lightning origin-motion pattern).
	local speedGraph = liveGraph(data.Speed)
	pData.Graphs.Speed = speedGraph
	if speedGraph then
		pData.Seeds.Speed = pData.Seeds.Speed or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(speedGraph)
	end
	pData._accel = data.Acceleration or Vector3.zero
	pData._drag = data.Drag or 0
	pData._hasMotion = speedGraph ~= nil or pData._accel.Magnitude > 0
	pData._motionOffset = Vector3.zero
	pData._motionAccelVel = Vector3.zero

	-- Launch: ballistic end anchor. With a Target the velocity is SOLVED so the
	-- arc passes through the target at T = distance / LaunchSpeed  -  the hook
	-- flies there and attaches (UpdateRope pins to the live target after T).
	-- Without a Target it throws blind along the composed direction.
	if pData._pinMode == "Launch" then
		local speed = math.max(RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.LaunchSpeed), 1)
		pData._launchOrigin = originCF.Position
		pData._launchT = nil
		local targetPos
		if data.Target then
			local ok, endCF = pcall(Constants.resolveLinkCFrame, data.Target)
			if ok and endCF then targetPos = endCF.Position end
		end
		if targetPos then
			local delta = targetPos - originCF.Position
			local T = math.max(delta.Magnitude / speed, 0.05)
			pData._launchVel = delta * (1 / T) - pData._gravity * (0.5 * T)
			pData._launchT = T
		else
			pData._launchVel = pData._motionDir * speed
		end
	end

	-- Rest length needs the anchor span; resolve start/end the cheap way here
	-- (Anchors owns the live per-substep version).
	local ropeLen = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.RopeLength)
	if ropeLen <= 0 then
		local slack = math.max(data.Slack or 1.2, 1)
		local span = 10
		if (pData._pinMode == "BothEnds" or pData._pinMode == "Launch") and data.Target then
			local ok, endCF = pcall(Constants.resolveLinkCFrame, data.Target)
			if ok and endCF then
				span = math.max((endCF.Position - originCF.Position).Magnitude, 1)
			end
		end
		ropeLen = span * slack
	end
	pData._restLen = math.max(ropeLen / pData._segCount, 0.05)
end

function PDataBuilder.build(item, data, model, rig, lifeTime, emitCtx, link)
	local seeds = {
		Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		Thickness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Thickness),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	local pData = {
		Type = "Rope",
		VisualPart = model,
		_rig = rig,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		_sourceItem = item,
		Graphs = {
			Color = data.Color,
			Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency,
			Thickness = data.Thickness,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, lifeTime),
		_parentLink = link,
		_accum = 0,
		_windPhase = 0,
		_windSeedA = math.random() * 1000,
		_windSeedB = 500 + math.random() * 1000,
	}

	-- Event-origin override freezes the start anchor at the event's frame.
	if emitCtx then
		local oCF
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then oCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		oCF = oCF or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
		if oCF then
			pData._startCFOverride = (emitCtx.UseFullOrigin and oCF) or CFrame.new(oCF.Position) * item.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	end

	PDataBuilder.readRopeParams(pData, data, rig, emitCtx)
	-- The rig Model has no PrimaryPart, so an unset WorldPivot tracks the live bbox, which the
	-- 1e9-parked slots drag away; stamp the start anchor so nested links read it (Lightning does the same).
	pcall(function() model.WorldPivot = Anchors.resolveStart(pData) end)
	-- Fresh emit = un-bitten hook + unreleased pins. The AnimateLoop refresh
	-- calls readRopeParams WITHOUT resetting these so the states survive cycles.
	pData._launchArrived = false
	pData._released = false
	return pData
end

return PDataBuilder

--[[
	Rope/VerletSim  -  position-verlet chain over the rope rig point buffers.
	Pure math, no Roblox services  -  the Node harness runs this file headless.

	step() integrates every FREE point (pos += (pos - prev)·(1 - damping) +
	(gravity + wind)·h²) then runs K Jakobsen relaxation iterations over the
	adjacent-point distance constraints. Pinned points (start always; end when
	pinEnd) have weight 0  -  their correction goes fully to the free neighbor.
	Projection cannot add energy, so a hanging rope settles dead still.

	Caller contract (Rope/init.luau UpdateRope): fixed-substep accumulator at
	SUBSTEP, at most MAX_SUBSTEPS per frame, input dt clamped, EXCESS ACCUM
	DROPPED at the cap  -  a hitch slows the rope, it never explodes. Anchors
	re-pin before every substep (Rope/Anchors.luau).
]]

local VerletSim = {}

VerletSim.SUBSTEP = 1 / 60
VerletSim.MAX_SUBSTEPS = 3

-- Wind sample for normalized arc position s: 2-octave noise on world X/Z.
local function windAccel(s, amp, phase, seedA, seedB)
	local x1 = s * 3 - phase
	local x2 = s * 8.1 - phase * 1.6
	return Vector3.new(
		(math.noise(x1, seedA) + 0.5 * math.noise(x2, seedA + 37.1)) * amp,
		0,
		(math.noise(x1, seedB) + 0.5 * math.noise(x2, seedB + 37.1)) * amp)
end

-- One fixed substep h. pos/prev hold n+1 points; params reads pData fields:
-- _damping, _gravity (Vector3), _restLen (or animated _restLenEff), _stiffness,
-- _pinStart (nil/true = pinned; false = free, Release death), _pinEnd,
-- _bendStiffness (0..1 second-neighbor constraints — cable/tentacle rigidity),
-- _windAmp + _windFreq seeds. windPhase advanced by the caller in effective time.
function VerletSim.step(pos, prev, n, params, h, windPhase)
	-- Time-corrected Verlet: the implicit velocity (pos - prev) is in units of
	-- the PREVIOUS step, so a changing h (Timescale slow-mo shrinks the step)
	-- must rescale it by h/hPrev or momentum jumps at every speed change.
	local hPrev = params._lastH or h
	params._lastH = h
	-- Damping normalized per SUBSTEP of simulated time: slow-mo (smaller h,
	-- more steps per sim-second) must not over-damp the rope.
	local damp = 1 - (params._damping or 0)
	if h ~= VerletSim.SUBSTEP and damp < 1 and damp > 0 then
		damp = damp ^ (h / VerletSim.SUBSTEP)
	end
	local keep = damp * (h / hPrev)
	local g = params._gravity
	local windAmp = params._windAmp or 0
	local pinStart = params._pinStart ~= false
	local pinEnd = params._pinEnd
	local firstFree = pinStart and 2 or 1
	local lastFree = pinEnd and n or (n + 1)

	for i = firstFree, lastFree do
		local p = pos[i]
		local acc = g
		if windAmp ~= 0 then
			acc = acc + windAccel((i - 1) / n, windAmp, windPhase, params._windSeedA, params._windSeedB)
		end
		pos[i] = p + (p - prev[i]) * keep + acc * (h * h)
		prev[i] = p
	end

	local restLen = params._restLenEff or params._restLen
	local bend = params._bendStiffness or 0
	local iterations = params._stiffness or 4
	for _ = 1, iterations do
		for i = 1, n do
			local a = pos[i]
			local b = pos[i + 1]
			local d = b - a
			local len = d.Magnitude
			if len > 1e-6 then
				local off = d * ((len - restLen) / len)
				local aPinned = pinStart and i == 1
				local bPinned = pinEnd and (i + 1 == n + 1)
				if aPinned then
					if not bPinned then
						pos[i + 1] = b - off
					end
				elseif bPinned then
					pos[i] = a + off
				else
					local half = off * 0.5
					pos[i] = a + half
					pos[i + 1] = b - half
				end
			end
		end
		if bend > 0 then
			-- Neighbor-midpoint straightening (cloth/hair-sim bend): pull each
			-- INTERIOR point toward its neighbors' midpoint — directly fights
			-- curvature, far stronger than second-neighbor distance constraints
			-- for gentle curves. Endpoints never move, so pins stay exact; the
			-- distance pass restores segment lengths each iteration.
			local k = bend * 0.5
			for i = 2, n do
				local mid = (pos[i - 1] + pos[i + 1]) * 0.5
				pos[i] = pos[i] + (mid - pos[i]) * k
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Rigid-translate the whole chain (teleport guard) without adding velocity.
function VerletSim.translate(pos, prev, n, offset)
	for i = 1, n + 1 do
		pos[i] = pos[i] + offset
		prev[i] = prev[i] + offset
	end
end

-- Kill all velocities in place (prev := pos)  -  spawn calm / degrade calm.
function VerletSim.calm(pos, prev, n)
	for i = 1, n + 1 do
		prev[i] = pos[i]
	end
end

return VerletSim

-- ScreenEmit  -  Emit / Animate / Update for Blur, Bloom, ColorCorrection, Atmosphere.
-- Property-only animation, clone-per-emit. Animate mode is singleton (re-emits while active drop).

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)

return function(Particle)

-- EmitParent override wins, else the local camera (Atmosphere: Lighting). Source location never used as default.
local function resolveScreenParent(data, kind)
	if data.EmitParent then return data.EmitParent end
	return VisualHost.screenEffectParent(kind)
end

-- Atmosphere uses AtmTimescale attr; normalize to Graphs.Timescale here.
local function buildGraphs(kind, data)
	if kind == "Blur" then
		return { BlurSize = data.BlurSize, Timescale = data.Timescale }
	elseif kind == "Bloom" then
		return { BloomIntensity = data.BloomIntensity, BloomSize = data.BloomSize, BloomThreshold = data.BloomThreshold, Timescale = data.Timescale }
	elseif kind == "CC" then
		return { CCBrightness = data.CCBrightness, CCContrast = data.CCContrast, CCSaturation = data.CCSaturation, CCTintColor = data.CCTintColor, Timescale = data.Timescale }
	elseif kind == "Atmosphere" then
		return { AtmDensity = data.AtmDensity, AtmOffset = data.AtmOffset, AtmGlare = data.AtmGlare, AtmHaze = data.AtmHaze, AtmColor = data.AtmColor, AtmDecay = data.AtmDecay, Timescale = data.AtmTimescale }
	end
	return {}
end

-- ColorSequences skip seeds.
local function buildSeeds(graphs)
	local seeds = {}
	for k, g in pairs(graphs) do
		if typeof(g) == "NumberSequence" then seeds[k] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(g) end
	end
	return seeds
end

-- Write a graph/color sample to the visual; kind routes to the property name.
-- skipColor / skipTransparency gate respective channel writes (sourced from pData
-- via payload.SetSkipColor / SetSkipTransparency in user Module scripts).
local function writeSample(kind, visual, graphs, seeds, t, skipColor, skipTransparency)
	if kind == "Blur" and graphs.BlurSize then
		visual.Size = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BlurSize, seeds.BlurSize)
	elseif kind == "Bloom" then
		if graphs.BloomIntensity then visual.Intensity = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BloomIntensity, seeds.BloomIntensity) end
		if graphs.BloomSize then visual.Size = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BloomSize, seeds.BloomSize) end
		if graphs.BloomThreshold then visual.Threshold = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.BloomThreshold, seeds.BloomThreshold) end
	elseif kind == "CC" then
		if graphs.CCBrightness and not skipTransparency then visual.Brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.CCBrightness, seeds.CCBrightness) end
