		if graphs.CCContrast then visual.Contrast = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.CCContrast, seeds.CCContrast) end
		if graphs.CCSaturation then visual.Saturation = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.CCSaturation, seeds.CCSaturation) end
		if graphs.CCTintColor and not skipColor then visual.TintColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.CCTintColor) end
	elseif kind == "Atmosphere" then
		if graphs.AtmDensity then visual.Density = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmDensity, seeds.AtmDensity) end
		if graphs.AtmOffset then visual.Offset = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmOffset, seeds.AtmOffset) end
		if graphs.AtmGlare then visual.Glare = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmGlare, seeds.AtmGlare) end
		if graphs.AtmHaze then visual.Haze = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, graphs.AtmHaze, seeds.AtmHaze) end
		if graphs.AtmColor and not skipColor then visual.Color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.AtmColor) end
		if graphs.AtmDecay and not skipColor then visual.Decay = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(t, graphs.AtmDecay) end
	end
end

-- Atmosphere has no Enabled; PostProcessEffect kinds do.
local function kindHasEnabled(kind)
	return kind ~= "Atmosphere"
end

-- Emit-mode: clone RT, apply initial sample BEFORE Parent (avoid 1-frame pop), push pData.
local function emitClone(self, kind, item, link, emitCtx)
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate:Clone()
	visual.Archivable = false
	if kindHasEnabled(kind) then visual.Enabled = true end
	visual:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)

	local safeLife = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLife <= 0 then safeLife = 0.001 end

	local graphs = buildGraphs(kind, data)
	local seeds = buildSeeds(graphs)
	writeSample(kind, visual, graphs, seeds, 0)

	visual.Parent = resolveScreenParent(data, kind)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Screen", Kind = kind,
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames or 100), CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLife, PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		Graphs = graphs, Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(graphs.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLife),
		_sourceItem = item,
	}
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Singleton Animate: clone, play, destroy on end. Re-emits while active are no-ops.
local function emitAnimateInternal(self, kind, item, link, emitCtx)
	if self.ActiveAnimates[item] then return end

	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate:Clone()
	visual.Archivable = false
	if kindHasEnabled(kind) then visual.Enabled = true end
	visual:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)

	local safeLife = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLife <= 0 then safeLife = 0.001 end

	local graphs = buildGraphs(kind, data)
	local seeds = buildSeeds(graphs)
	writeSample(kind, visual, graphs, seeds, 0)

	visual.Parent = resolveScreenParent(data, kind)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Screen", Kind = kind,
		VisualPart = visual,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames or 100), CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLife, PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		Graphs = graphs, Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(graphs.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLife),
		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = item,
	}
	pData._sourceItem = item
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)
	self.ActiveAnimates[item] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

-- Per-kind public entry points (dispatched from Emit / EmitAnimate)

function Particle:EmitBlur(item, link, emitCtx) emitClone(self, "Blur", item, link, emitCtx) end

-- Per-frame update; returns true when lifetime ends (Heartbeat culls via swap-and-pop).
function Particle:UpdateScreen(pData, dt, currentTime)
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end

	-- Timescale v2 (signed reverse): see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsed = newEff
	local i = elapsed / lifeTime
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	if i > 1 then i = 1 end
	if i < 0 then i = 0 end

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local t = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		writeSample(pData.Kind, pData.VisualPart, pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds, t, pData.SkipColor, pData.SkipTransparency)
	end

	return isDying
end

end

-- ScreenHost  -  lazy singleton ScreenGui for ImageLabel emitters without an EmitParent.

local GuiHost = require(script.Parent.GuiHost)

local ScreenHost = {}
local _gui = nil

function ScreenHost.get()
	if _gui and _gui.Parent then return _gui end
	local host = GuiHost.resolveContainer()
	if not host then return nil end  -- server context: caller skips
	_gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	_gui.Name = "PartIclesScreenHost"
	_gui.Archivable = false
	_gui.DisplayOrder = -10 -- below plugin UI (default 0)
	_gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	_gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	_gui.Parent = host
	return _gui
end

function ScreenHost.destroy()
	if _gui then pcall(_gui.Destroy, _gui); _gui = nil end
end

function ScreenHost.exists() return _gui and _gui.Parent ~= nil end

return ScreenHost

--[[
	Sound Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Sound emitters (native Sound instance as the RenderTemplate).

	Each emit plays a copy of the RT: positional under Emit Into, the link clone (a Model resolves
	to its middle part) or a carrier mirroring the source's parent; Local2D copies play through
	SoundService instead. In Studio edit mode every copy plays non-positionally under the plugin's
	audio widget (VisualHost.getEditAudioHost), the only parent Studio plays plugin Sounds from.
	Volume / PlaybackSpeed are stepped envelopes over Lifetime; Lifetime 0
	runs until the clip ends. Timescale drives the clip as well as the envelopes: the copy
	plays at the envelope's speed times the timescale and pauses while time stands still or
	runs backwards. Animate-less like Lights (a sound has no in-place state to loop).
	Every copy is destroyed on release (LifecycleRelease._releaseVisual: no pool kind).
]]

local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)

-- Lifetime 0 with a clip whose length is not known (still loading, or looped): the Ended signal
-- ends the particle, this only bounds it. A loading clip's real length replaces it on load.
local UNBOUNDED_LIFETIME = 3600
-- Below this timescale the clip is paused: a Sound cannot play backwards, and a PlaybackSpeed
-- of 0 still advances TimePosition in Studio.
local MIN_PLAY_RATE = 0.01

return function(Particle)

function Particle._isSound(item)
	return item:IsA("Sound")
end

-- Emit Into > link clone > carrier mirroring the source's parent (mirrors EmitPointLight).
local function resolveHost(item, data, link)
	local host = data.EmitParent or link
	local carrier = nil
	if not host then
		local anchor = item.Parent
		if anchor and (anchor:IsA("BasePart") or anchor:IsA("Attachment")) then
			carrier = VisualHost.acquireCarrier(anchor)
			host = carrier
		else
			host = anchor
		end
	end
	if host and host:IsA("Model") then
		local parts = nil
		for _, child in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				parts = parts or {}
				parts[#parts + 1] = child
			end
		end
		if parts then host = parts[math.ceil(#parts / 2)] end
	end
	return host, carrier
end

function Particle:UpdateSound(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale header: see Update.luau UpdatePart.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local newEff = (pData._effectiveElapsed or 0) + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt * ts)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff

	local sound = pData.VisualPart
	if not sound or not sound.Parent then return true end
	if pData._parentAlive and not pData._parentAlive[1] then return true end
	if pData._clipEnded then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local isDying = real_i >= 1 and (newEff >= lifeTime or newEff <= 0)

	local targetStep = math.floor(math.min(math.max(newEff / lifeTime, 0), 1) * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		if pData.Graphs.SndVolume then
			sound.Volume = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SndVolume, pData.Seeds.SndVolume)
		end
		if pData.Graphs.SndPlaybackSpeed then
			pData._envelopeSpeed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SndPlaybackSpeed, pData.Seeds.SndPlaybackSpeed)
		end
	end

	-- Every frame, not per keyframe: the timescale (graph or SetTimescale) moves between steps.
	local rate = ts
	if pData._timeFrozen then
		rate = 0
	end
	if rate < MIN_PLAY_RATE then
		-- _started: the copy plays only once its clip has loaded, and is not paused before that.
		if pData._started and not pData._heldByTimescale then
			pData._heldByTimescale = true
			sound:Pause()
		end
	else
		local speed = pData._envelopeSpeed * rate
		if speed ~= pData._appliedSpeed then
			pData._appliedSpeed = speed
			sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed
		end
		if pData._heldByTimescale then
			pData._heldByTimescale = false
			sound:Resume()
		end
	end
	return isDying
end

function Particle:EmitSound(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(item, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local sound = Instance.fromExisting(data.RenderTemplate)
	sound.Archivable = false
	sound.Playing = false
	sound.Looped = data.Looped == true
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = data.RollOffMin or 10
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = data.RollOffMax or 10000
	pcall(function() sound:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true) end)

	local seedVolume = data.SndVolume and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SndVolume) or {}
	local seedSpeed = data.SndPlaybackSpeed and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SndPlaybackSpeed) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SndTimescale)
	local speed0 = data.SndPlaybackSpeed and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SndPlaybackSpeed, seedSpeed) or 1
	if data.SndVolume then sound.Volume = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.SndVolume, seedVolume) end
	sound.PlaybackSpeed = speed0

	-- Lifetime 0 = the clip's own length at the starting speed; unknown until loaded.
	local lifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	local clipBound = lifeTime <= 0
	if clipBound then
		local length = sound.IsLoaded and sound.TimeLength or 0
		lifeTime = (length > 0 and not sound.Looped) and (length / math.max(speed0, 0.01)) or UNBOUNDED_LIFETIME
	end
	if lifeTime <= 0 then lifeTime = 0.001 end

	local editAudioHost = VisualHost.getEditAudioHost()
	local host, carrier = nil, nil
	if editAudioHost then
		host = editAudioHost
	elseif data.Local2D then
		host = SoundService
	else
		host, carrier = resolveHost(item, data, link)
	end
	if not host then return end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Sound",
		VisualPart = sound,
		_carrier = carrier,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = -1,
		LifeTime = lifeTime,
		PartLife = 0,
		Graphs = {
			SndVolume = data.SndVolume,
			SndPlaybackSpeed = data.SndPlaybackSpeed,
			Timescale = data.SndTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			SndVolume = seedVolume,
			SndPlaybackSpeed = seedSpeed,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.SndTimescale, seedTimescale, lifeTime),
		-- The envelope's playback speed; UpdateSound multiplies it by the timescale.
		_envelopeSpeed = speed0,
		_appliedSpeed = speed0,
		_started = false,
		_heldByTimescale = false,
	}
	pData._sourceItem = item
	-- Riding an emitted parent clone: die with it (see UpdatePointLight).
	if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive and not data.EmitParent then
		pData._parentAlive = emitCtx._parentAlive
	end
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, item)

	sound.Parent = host
	local function play()
		if not sound.Parent then return end
		-- A copy is rarely loaded at emit, so its clip length was unknown there. The lifetime the
		-- envelopes and the timescale graph run over is the clip's, set here and counted from here.
		if clipBound and pData.LifeTime == UNBOUNDED_LIFETIME and sound.TimeLength > 0 and not sound.Looped then
			pData.LifeTime = sound.TimeLength / math.max(speed0, 0.01)
			pData._effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.SndTimescale, seedTimescale, pData.LifeTime)
		end
		pData.StartTime = os.clock()
		sound.TimePosition = data.StartOffset or 0
		if data.Local2D and not editAudioHost then
			SoundService:PlayLocalSound(sound)
		else
			sound:Play()
		end
		pData._started = true
	end
	if clipBound then
		sound.Ended:Once(function() pData._clipEnded = true end)
	end
	-- Play gates on the clip being loaded so the first note is never cut.
	if sound.IsLoaded then
		play()
	else
		sound.Loaded:Once(play)
	end

	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

end

-- StaticPass  -  detect constant-valued NumberSequence graphs at emit / AnimateLoop
-- replay time. Constant graphs nil out of pData.Graphs and their value stamps onto
-- pData._static<Name>. Per-frame Update sites read the static value, skipping the
-- QueryPointsWithTime call. Idempotent: clears stale static fields before re-detecting,
-- so a graph switched from static→dynamic mid-cycle correctly re-arms the per-frame
-- sample path.
--
-- ColorSequence not handled  -  Graph.IsStatic is NumberSequence-only. Color graphs
-- remain per-frame sampled (cost is real but step-quantized).
local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local StaticPass = {}

-- Per-type list of { graphName, staticFieldName, default }.
-- Add a graph here, then add `pData._static<Name> or ` to the matching Update sample
-- site. Field name must match between the table entry and the Update read.
local FIELDS = {
	Part = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "Brightness",    "_staticBrightness",    1 },
		{ "Transparency",  "_staticTransparency",  0 },
		{ "SizeX",         "_staticSizeX",         1 },
		{ "SizeY",         "_staticSizeY",         1 },
		{ "SizeZ",         "_staticSizeZ",         1 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
		{ "AccelStrength", "_staticAccelStrength", 0 },
	},
	Attachment = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
	},
	Model = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "Scale",         "_staticScale",         1 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
	},
	ImageLabel = {
		{ "ImageTransparency",      "_staticImageTransparency",      0 },
		{ "BackgroundTransparency", "_staticBackgroundTransparency", 0 },
		{ "ImgSpeed",               "_staticImgSpeed",               0 },
		{ "ImgRotSpeed",            "_staticImgRotSpeed",            0 },
		{ "SizeScaleX",             "_staticSizeScaleX",             1 },
		{ "SizeScaleY",             "_staticSizeScaleY",             1 },
	},
	-- Beam props live under pData.BeamProps / pData.AnimatedProps, not pData.Graphs.
	-- Beam keeps its inline static-pass in Emit.luau / EmitAnimate.luau / Engine.luau.
}

-- Walk the type's FIELDS table. For each entry: if pData.Graphs[name] is a constant
-- NumberSequence, stamp pData[staticField] and nil the graph. Otherwise clear any
-- stale static field (covers graph→dynamic transitions between AnimateLoop cycles).
function StaticPass.apply(pData)
	if not pData or not pData.Type then return end
	local list = FIELDS[pData.Type]
	if not list then return end
	local g = pData.Graphs
	if not g then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		local graphName, staticField, default = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]
		local seq = g[graphName]
		if seq and Graph.IsStatic(seq) then
			pData[staticField] = Graph.GetStaticValue(seq, default)
			g[graphName] = nil
		else
			-- Graph absent or dynamic: clear stale static field from prior cycle.
			pData[staticField] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- AnimateLoop replay support. Prior cycle's StaticPass.apply nil'd constant graphs
-- from pData.Graphs. AxisLinks.refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds iterates `pairs(pData.Graphs)`,
-- so nil keys aren't repopulated from freshData. Call this BEFORE refresh to put the
-- absent keys back, then refresh runs normally, then StaticPass.apply re-detects.
function StaticPass.restoreFromFreshData(pData, freshData)
	if not pData or not freshData or not pData.Type then return end
	local list = FIELDS[pData.Type]
	if not list then return end
	local g = pData.Graphs
	if not g then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		local graphName = entry[1]
		if g[graphName] == nil and freshData[graphName] then
			g[graphName] = freshData[graphName]
		end
	end
end

return StaticPass

-- TexturePin  -  keeps texture assets resident in GPU memory so they don't redecode on first use.
-- 1×1 ImageLabel at ImageTransparency=0.99 parented to a hidden ScreenGui keeps the asset decoded
-- (fully transparent / invisible images get evicted). Owner-counted: pin survives until last owner
-- releases. Ref: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/preloading-images-and-keeping-them-loaded/2998098

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local GuiHost = require(script.Parent.GuiHost)

local TexturePin = {}

local _gui = nil            -- hidden ScreenGui hosting every pin ImageLabel
local _pinned = {}          -- assetId -> ImageLabel
local _ownersOf = {}        -- assetId -> {[owner]=true,...}
local _assetsByOwner = {}   -- owner   -> {[assetId]=true,...}  reverse index for O(pins held) release
local _ANON = newproxy()    -- sentinel for pin() without owner; only clear() releases anonymous pins

local function ensureGui()
	if _gui and _gui.Parent then return _gui end
	local host = GuiHost.resolveContainer()
	if not host then return nil end  -- server context: pin no-ops
	_gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	_gui.Name = "PartIclesTexturePin"
	_gui.Archivable = false
	_gui.DisplayOrder = -999
	_gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	_gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	_gui.Parent = host
	return _gui
end

-- Resolve string ID or texture-bearing Instance to a Content ID; nil means skip.
local function _resolveAssetId(entry)
	if typeof(entry) == "string" then return entry ~= "" and entry or nil end
	if typeof(entry) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
	if entry:IsA("Decal") or entry:IsA("Texture") or entry:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or entry:IsA("Beam") or entry:IsA("Trail") then
		local t = entry.Texture; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("ImageLabel") or entry:IsA("ImageButton") then
		local t = entry.Image; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
		-- SpecialMesh.TextureId (lowercase d).
		local t = entry.TextureId; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("MeshPart") then
		-- MeshPart.TextureID (uppercase D); checked AFTER Beam etc.
		local t = entry.TextureID; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	end
end

-- SurfaceAppearance carries 4 PBR slots; pin all four. Other entries use _resolveAssetId.
local function _appendAssetIds(entry, list)
	if entry:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
		for _, prop in ipairs({"ColorMap", "NormalMap", "MetalnessMap", "RoughnessMap"}) do
			local ok, t = pcall(function() return entry[prop] end)
			if ok and t and t ~= "" then table.insert(list, t) end
		end
		return
	end
	local id = _resolveAssetId(entry)
	if id then table.insert(list, id) end
end

-- Pin one or many assets for `owner`. De-duped via `_pinned`; owner defaults to anonymous.
function TexturePin.pin(input, owner)
	if not input then return end
	owner = owner or _ANON
	local items = (type(input) == "table") and input or { input }
	local newPins = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(items) do
		local assetId = _resolveAssetId(entry)
		if assetId then
			if not _pinned[assetId] then
				local gui = ensureGui()
				if not gui then break end  -- server context: skip remaining pins entirely
				local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				img.Name = "Pin"; img.Image = assetId
				img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1); img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
				img.BackgroundTransparency = 1; img.ImageTransparency = 0.99 -- 1.0 culls and evicts
				img.BorderSizePixel = 0; img.ZIndex = 1
				img.Parent = gui
				_pinned[assetId] = img
				table.insert(newPins, img)
			end
			local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]; if not owners then owners = {}; _ownersOf[assetId] = owners end
			owners[owner] = true
			local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]; if not assets then assets = {}; _assetsByOwner[owner] = assets end
			assets[assetId] = true
		end
	end
	if #newPins > 0 then task.spawn(function() pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, newPins) end) end
end

-- Pin every texture-bearing descendant of `root`; owner = root.
function TexturePin.pinSubtree(root)
	if not root then return end
	local ids = {}
	_appendAssetIds(root, ids)
	local ok, descendants = pcall(root.GetDescendants, root)
	if ok then
		for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do _appendAssetIds(d, ids) end
	end
	if #ids > 0 then TexturePin.pin(ids, root) end
end

function TexturePin.isPinned(assetId) return _pinned[assetId] ~= nil end

function TexturePin.count()
	local n = 0; for _ in pairs(_pinned) do n += 1 end; return n
end

-- Drop owner's claim. Pin destroyed only when zero owners remain.
function TexturePin.unpin(input, owner)
	if not input then return end
	owner = owner or _ANON
	local items = (type(input) == "table") and input or { input }
	for _, entry in ipairs(items) do
		local assetId = _resolveAssetId(entry)
		if assetId and _pinned[assetId] then
			local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]
			if owners then owners[owner] = nil end
			local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]
			if assets then assets[assetId] = nil end
			local anyOwner = false; if owners then for _ in pairs(owners) do anyOwner = true; break end end
			if not anyOwner then
				pcall(_pinned[assetId].Destroy, _pinned[assetId])
				_pinned[assetId] = nil; _ownersOf[assetId] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Release every pin this owner holds; hooked into DescendantRemoving for auto-cleanup.
function TexturePin.releaseOwner(owner)
	if not owner then return end
	local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]; if not assets then return end
	for assetId in pairs(assets) do
		local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]
		if owners then owners[owner] = nil end
		local anyOwner = false; if owners then for _ in pairs(owners) do anyOwner = true; break end end
		if not anyOwner and _pinned[assetId] then
			pcall(_pinned[assetId].Destroy, _pinned[assetId])
			_pinned[assetId] = nil; _ownersOf[assetId] = nil
		end
	end
	_assetsByOwner[owner] = nil
end

-- Mirror of pinSubtree; other owners' shares persist.
function TexturePin.unpinSubtree(root)
	if not root then return end
	local ids = {}
	_appendAssetIds(root, ids)
	local ok, descendants = pcall(root.GetDescendants, root)
	if ok then
		for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do _appendAssetIds(d, ids) end
	end
	if #ids > 0 then TexturePin.unpin(ids, root) end
end

-- Destroy every pin + the host ScreenGui. Called on plugin toggle-off / Deactivate.
function TexturePin.clear()
	_pinned = {}; _ownersOf = {}; _assetsByOwner = {}
	if _gui then pcall(_gui.Destroy, _gui); _gui = nil end
end

return TexturePin

--[[
	Timescale Mixin  -  runtime timescale override for live particles + raw ParticleEmitters.

	Public API (after :Activate):
	  :SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
	     scale      -  0 = time stop, <0 = reverse, >0 = speed multiplier.
	     duration   -  seconds before revert to original (ignored when permanent).
	     permanent  -  true → never expires (duration ignored); false → timed via duration;
	                 false + duration=0 collapses to :ClearTimescale so toggling off uses one method.
	  :ClearTimescale(item)
	  :AbsoluteSetTimescale / :AbsoluteClearTimescale (recursive, mirrors AbsoluteEnable).

	Dispatch:
	  - Transformed (Part-Icles) items: write `_tsOverride` + `_tsOverrideUntil` attrs;
	    SetTimescale walks `Particle.ActiveEmits` to flip existing pData; emit mixins call
	    `Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, src)` so new emits during the window inherit; Update
	    mixins gate on `currentTime < pData._tsOverrideUntil` and fall back to `Graphs.Timescale`.
	  - Raw `ParticleEmitter` instances: write `.TimeScale` directly. Original value stashed
	    in `_origTimeScale` so concurrent SetTimescale calls don't lose it. `_tsGen` invalidates
	    stale `task.delay` restore closures so newer calls win.
]]

return function(Particle)

	-- Emit-site seeder. Stale attrs on src are harmless: Update mixin gate expires them lazily.
	function Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, src)
		if not src then return end
		pData._tsOverride = src:GetAttribute("_tsOverride")
		pData._tsOverrideUntil = src:GetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil")
	end

	-- Native ParticleEmitter path. Stash original once, write override, schedule restore.
	local function _setNativePE(pe, scale, duration, permanent)
		if pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale") == nil then
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", pe.TimeScale) end)
		end
		pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = scale end)
		-- Generation token: bump invalidates any pending stale restore closure.
		local gen = (pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") or 0) + 1
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", gen) end)
		if permanent == true then return end
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if not pe.Parent then return end
			if pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") ~= gen then return end
			local orig = pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale")
			if orig ~= nil then
				pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = orig end)
				pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", nil) end)
			end
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", nil) end)
		end)
	end

	local function _clearNativePE(pe)
		local orig = pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale")
		if orig ~= nil then
			pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = orig end)
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", nil) end)
		end
		-- Bump + clear gen so any pending task.delay closure from a prior timed call bails.
		local gen = (pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") or 0) + 1
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", gen) end)
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", nil) end)
	end

	-- Apply a timescale override to a Transformed item or raw ParticleEmitter. See file header
	-- for scale / duration / permanent semantics + dispatch table.
	function Particle:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
		if not item then return end
		if typeof(scale) ~= "number" then return end
		local effectiveDuration
		if permanent == true then
			effectiveDuration = nil
		elseif typeof(duration) == "number" and duration > 0 then
			effectiveDuration = duration
		else
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			_setNativePE(item, scale, effectiveDuration, permanent)
			return
		end
		local until_ = (permanent == true) and math.huge or (os.clock() + effectiveDuration)
		pcall(function()
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverride", scale)
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil", until_)
		end)
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for i = 1, #active do
			local pData = active[i]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				pData._tsOverride = scale
				pData._tsOverrideUntil = until_
			end
		end
	end

	-- Remove timescale override from a Transformed item or raw ParticleEmitter. Inverse of
	-- SetTimescale; restores `Graphs.Timescale` (Transformed) or `_origTimeScale` (native PE).
	function Particle:ClearTimescale(item)
		if not item then return end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			_clearNativePE(item)
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverride", nil)
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil", nil)
		end)
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for i = 1, #active do
			local pData = active[i]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				pData._tsOverride = nil
				pData._tsOverrideUntil = nil
			end
		end
	end

	-- Recurse like AbsoluteEnable. Transformed items + raw ParticleEmitters both terminal.
	function Particle:AbsoluteSetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			self:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
			return
		end
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteSetTimescale(child, scale, duration, permanent)
		end
	end

	-- Recursive ClearTimescale across `item` + transformed descendants.
	function Particle:AbsoluteClearTimescale(item)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteClearTimescale(child)
		end
	end

end

--[[
	TrailEmitter Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Trail particles (emitter mode, post-Transform-as-Emitter).
	Mirrors Beam emitter pattern: static spatial position (welded to existing Attachment0/Attachment1),
	animation entirely via graphs. Width / Transparency / Color drive through TrailGraphBlender;
	Brightness / LightEmission / LightInfluence / TextureLength / MinLength / MaxLength are
	per-frame scalar graphs sampled at the current step's i.

	Cross-file invariants:
	  - pData.Type = "TrailEmitter"  -  Heartbeat dispatch routes to UpdateTrail
	  - Lifecycle.cancelAnimation reads pData.TrailEmitterSnapshot to restore live RT (animate mode)
	  - PoolHide kind "TrailEmitter" → Enabled=false on release / true on acquire
	  - data.RenderTemplate is the cloned Trail; clones share its Attachment0/Attachment1 references
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local EMPTY_SEED = {}
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local TrailGraphBlender = require(script.Parent.TrailGraphBlender)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local MeshFlipbook = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-particle scalar graphs sampled at each step. Keep aligned with TrailEmitterProperties.
local SCALAR_GRAPHS = {"Brightness", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "TextureLength", "MinLength", "MaxLength"}

local function _writeBlenderState(visual, propName, states, mergedTimesList, lastIdxField, pData, t)
	if not states or #states == 0 then return end
	if #states == 1 then
		visual[propName] = states[1].Graph
		return
	end
	local lastIdx = pData[lastIdxField] or 1
	if t < states[lastIdx].Time then lastIdx = 1 end
	local pairIdx = #states - 1
	for idx = lastIdx, #states - 1 do
		if t >= states[idx].Time and t <= states[idx + 1].Time then
			pairIdx = idx; break
		end
	end
	pData[lastIdxField] = pairIdx
	local lower = states[pairIdx]
	local upper = states[pairIdx + 1] or states[#states]
	local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
	local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
	if upper.Transition then segmentAlpha = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(segmentAlpha, upper.Transition, EMPTY_SEED) end
	local mergedTimes = mergedTimesList and mergedTimesList[pairIdx]
	if mergedTimes then
		if propName == "Color" then
			visual[propName] = GraphMod.LerpColorGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
		else
			visual[propName] = GraphMod.LerpGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
		end
	end
end

-- Per-frame Heartbeat update for TrailEmitter particles. Width / Transparency / Color drive
-- through TrailGraphBlender; scalar graphs (Brightness / LightEmission / etc) sample per frame.
function Particle:UpdateTrail(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale support: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	-- Width / Transparency / Color blender (continuous-time, FPS-independent).
	local t = i
	if not pData.SkipColor then
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "WidthScale",   pData.WidthStates, pData.WidthMergedTimes, "_lastWidthIdx", pData, t)
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "Color",        pData.ColorStates, pData.ColorMergedTimes, "_lastColorIdx", pData, t)
	end
	if not pData.SkipTransparency then
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "Transparency", pData.TransStates, pData.TransMergedTimes, "_lastTransIdx", pData, t)
	end

	-- Step-quantized scalar graphs (Brightness / LightEmission / LightInfluence / TextureLength / MinLength / MaxLength).
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames > 0 then
		local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
		if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
				local graph = pData.Graphs[key]
				if graph then
					pData.VisualPart[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, graph, pData.Seeds[key])
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

local function _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(graphBlender)
	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates = TrailGraphBlender.CollectStates(graphBlender)
	local widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = {}, {}, {}
	for idx = 1, #widthStates - 1 do widthMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes(widthStates[idx].Graph, widthStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	for idx = 1, #transStates - 1 do transMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes(transStates[idx].Graph, transStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	for idx = 1, #colorStates - 1 do colorMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(colorStates[idx].Graph, colorStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	return widthStates, transStates, colorStates, widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes
end

local function _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	local graphs = { Timescale = data.TEmitTimescale }
	local seeds = { Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.TEmitTimescale) }
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		local g = data["TEmit" .. key] or data[key]
		if g then
			graphs[key] = g
			seeds[key] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(g)
		end
	end
	return graphs, seeds
end

-- Spawn a TrailEmitter particle: clones RenderTemplate, applies authored Width / Color graphs,
-- registers in ActiveEmits. Trail inherits Attachment0/Attachment1 references from the clone source.
function Particle:EmitTrail(trail, link, emitCtx)
	if not trail or not trail.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(trail, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "TrailEmitter", data.Pool)
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Enabled = true
	-- Static props (Texture/TextureMode/FaceCamera) come from the cloned RT directly; no
	-- attribute-side mirror, so no override needed here.

	-- Bind the ends from the AUTHORED RT references (a pooled visual still carries a previous
	-- parent's clone attachments): the parent clone's copy when one exists, else the source.
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	local a0, a1 = data.RenderTemplate.Attachment0, data.RenderTemplate.Attachment1
	local c0 = map and a0 and map[a0]
	local c1 = map and a1 and map[a1]
	visual.Attachment0 = (c0 and c0.Parent) and c0 or a0
	visual.Attachment1 = (c1 and c1.Parent) and c1 or a1

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	-- visual.Lifetime is the Trail's segment fade duration, separate from particle Lifetime.
	local trailLifeRange = data.TrailLife or data.Lifetime
	local trailLifeVal = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(trailLifeRange)
	if trailLifeVal <= 0 then trailLifeVal = 0.001 end
	visual.Lifetime = trailLifeVal

	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates,
		widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(data.GraphBlender)

	if #widthStates > 0 then visual.WidthScale = widthStates[1].Graph end
	if #transStates > 0 then visual.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visual.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	local graphs, seeds = _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		if graphs[key] then
			visual[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graphs[key], seeds[key])
		end
	end

	visual.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	local pData = {
		Type = "TrailEmitter",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		WidthStates = widthStates, TransStates = transStates, ColorStates = colorStates,
		WidthMergedTimes = widthMergedTimes, TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes, ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,
		Graphs = graphs,
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.TEmitTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = trail
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, trail)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "TrailEmitter" end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Flipbook: cycle visual.Texture through TrailFlipbooks/Decals. FlipBeam is generic over any
	-- target with a Texture property (Trail qualifies); reuse rather than fork a TrailFlipbook
	-- runtime. Mode/framerate/etc. live in the TEmitFlipbook* attrs read by GetData.
	if data.TrailFlipbookMode and data.TrailFlipbooks then
		local decals = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedBeamTextures(data.TrailFlipbooks)
		if #decals > 0 then
			local spec = {
				FlipbookMode = data.TrailFlipbookMode,
				FlipbookFramerate = data.TrailFlipbookFramerate,
				FlipbookStartRandom = data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom,
				FlipbookReverse = data.TrailFlipbookReverse,
			}
			MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, spec, decals, visual, safeLifeTime)
		end
	end
end

-- Animate mode: operate on the LIVE RenderTemplate. cancelAnimation/finishAnimate restore the
-- snapshotted intrinsic Trail props and disable the trail when the cycle ends.
function Particle:EmitTrailAnimate(trail, link, emitCtx)
	if not trail or not trail.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[trail] then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(trail, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source, not a clone

	-- Snapshot BEFORE mutating so cancelAnimation restores authored values (mirrors Beam pattern).
	local snapshot = {
		Lifetime = visual.Lifetime,
		Brightness = visual.Brightness,
		LightEmission = visual.LightEmission,
		LightInfluence = visual.LightInfluence,
		TextureLength = visual.TextureLength,
		MinLength = visual.MinLength,
		MaxLength = visual.MaxLength,
		Texture = visual.Texture,
		TextureMode = visual.TextureMode,
		FaceCamera = visual.FaceCamera,
		WidthScale = visual.WidthScale,
		Transparency = visual.Transparency,
		Color = visual.Color,
		Enabled = visual.Enabled,
	}

	visual.Enabled = true
	-- Static props (Texture/TextureMode/FaceCamera) come from the live source directly (no clone).

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	local trailLifeRange = data.TrailLife or data.Lifetime
	local trailLifeVal = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(trailLifeRange)
	if trailLifeVal <= 0 then trailLifeVal = 0.001 end
	visual.Lifetime = trailLifeVal

	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates,
		widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(data.GraphBlender)

	if #widthStates > 0 then visual.WidthScale = widthStates[1].Graph end
	if #transStates > 0 then visual.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visual.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	local graphs, seeds = _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		if graphs[key] then
			visual[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graphs[key], seeds[key])
		end
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "TrailEmitter",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = trail,
		TrailEmitterSnapshot = snapshot,
		WidthStates = widthStates, TransStates = transStates, ColorStates = colorStates,
		WidthMergedTimes = widthMergedTimes, TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes, ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,
		Graphs = graphs,
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.TEmitTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = trail
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, trail)
	self.ActiveAnimates[trail] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	if data.TrailFlipbookMode and data.TrailFlipbooks then
		local decals = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedBeamTextures(data.TrailFlipbooks)
		if #decals > 0 then
			local spec = {
				FlipbookMode = data.TrailFlipbookMode,
				FlipbookFramerate = data.TrailFlipbookFramerate,
				FlipbookStartRandom = data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom,
				FlipbookReverse = data.TrailFlipbookReverse,
			}
			MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, spec, decals, visual, safeLifeTime)
		end
	end
end

end

--[[
	TrailGraphBlender  -  multi-state interpolation for Trail emitter properties.
	Mirrors Graph.CollectGraphStates structure but adds a third Width track alongside
	Transparency + Color. Configuration children under the GraphBlender folder each
	carry Time + Width + Transparency + Color attributes; this collector returns three
	sorted state lists. The actual per-frame pair-state interpolation reuses Graph's
	PrecomputeMergedTimes + LerpGraphFast / LerpColorGraphFast.
]]

local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local TrailGraphBlender = {}

-- Collect blender states from a GraphBlender folder into three time-sorted lists
-- (width / transparency / color). Returned lists feed Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes + LerpGraphFast
-- at runtime for per-frame interpolation between authored Configuration states.
function TrailGraphBlender.CollectStates(graphBlender)
	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates = {}, {}, {}
	if not graphBlender then return widthStates, transStates, colorStates end

	for _, child in pairs(graphBlender:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("Configuration") then continue end
		local time = child:GetAttribute("Time")
		if time == nil then
			local num = tonumber(string.match(child.Name, "%d+"))
			time = num and (num - 1) or 0
		end
		local transition = child:GetAttribute("Transition")
		if typeof(transition) ~= "NumberSequence" then transition = nil end
		local width = child:GetAttribute("Width")
		if width and typeof(width) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(widthStates, {Time = time, Graph = width, Transition = transition})
		end
		local trans = child:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		if trans and typeof(trans) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(transStates, {Time = time, Graph = trans, Transition = transition})
		end
		local color = child:GetAttribute("Color")
		if color and typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then
			table.insert(colorStates, {Time = time, Graph = color, Transition = transition})
		end
	end

	-- Sort each list by Time + normalize fallback values into 0-1 range.
	for _, states in ipairs({widthStates, transStates, colorStates}) do
		table.sort(states, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
		if #states > 1 and states[#states].Time > 1 then
			local maxTime = states[#states].Time
			if maxTime > 0 then for _, s in ipairs(states) do s.Time = s.Time / maxTime end end
		end
	end

	return widthStates, transStates, colorStates
end

-- Reuse Graph's existing math; Trail blender doesn't need new sequence-merge primitives.
TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes = Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes
TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes = Graph.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes
TrailGraphBlender.LerpGraphFast = Graph.LerpGraphFast
TrailGraphBlender.LerpColorGraphFast = Graph.LerpColorGraphFast

return TrailGraphBlender
